zh.tag: 真实工程师的 AI 技能包，小而可组合
zh.what: 这是一个面向真实工程实践的 AI 代理技能集合，来自作者日常使用的 .agents 目录。它强调可组合、易修改，而非大而全的流程框架，旨在帮助开发者用 AI 完成实际编码任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个技能文件，每个技能针对特定工程任务（如代码审查、调试等），并附带安装脚本和说明文档。支持通过 Claude Code 插件或 npx 安装，可选择性安装到不同代理。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Shell 脚本，依赖 Claude Code 插件系统或 npx 工具，兼容多种 AI 代理（如 Codex）。
zh.hot: 24.7k stars 且日增 1601，位居日榜第二，因其提供了一种轻量、可控的 AI 工程实践方式，区别于流行的重流程框架，受到开发者欢迎。
uses: 希望用 AI 辅助实际编码但不想被复杂流程束缚的开发者
需要可定制、可组合技能来适配不同项目的工程师
对 Claude Code 或 Codex 等代理工具感兴趣，想扩展其能力的用户

en.tag: AI skills for real engineers, small and composable
en.what: A collection of AI agent skills for real engineering work, sourced from the author's daily .agents directory. It emphasizes composability and adaptability over monolithic frameworks, helping developers use AI for practical coding tasks.
en.content: The repo contains multiple skill files, each targeting a specific engineering task (e.g., code review, debugging), along with installation scripts and documentation. It can be installed via Claude Code plugin or npx, with selective installation to different agents.
en.stack: Primarily Shell scripts, leveraging Claude Code plugin system or npx tool, compatible with various AI agents (e.g., Codex).
en.hot: With 247k stars and +1601 today, ranking #2 on daily trending, it's popular for offering a lightweight, controllable approach to AI engineering, contrasting with heavy process frameworks.
uses: Developers who want AI assistance for real coding without being constrained by heavy workflows
Engineers needing customizable, composable skills to fit different projects
Users interested in extending the capabilities of agent tools like Claude Code or Codex

zh.tag: 为 Claude Code 等 AI 编码代理打造的性能优化与安全增强系统
zh.what: ECC 是一个代理工具链（harness）优化系统，为 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理提供技能、直觉、记忆、安全与研究优先的开发能力。它通过统一的配置与插件机制，增强代理在复杂任务中的表现与可控性。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 JavaScript 库、CLI 工具、GitHub App（ecc-tools）、文档（多语言 README）以及示例配置，支持通过 npm 包（ecc-universal）集成。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js，依赖 npm 生态，提供 CLI 与 GitHub App 集成，支持多代理框架（Claude Code、Codex 等）。
zh.hot: 凭借 24.4 万 Star 和今日新增 235 星，ECC 成为 AI 代理工具链领域的明星项目，其跨代理兼容性和性能优化特性吸引了大量开发者关注。
uses: AI 编码代理用户：希望增强 Claude Code、Codex 等代理的记忆、安全与技能，提升开发效率。
团队与组织：需要统一管理多个 AI 代理的配置、权限与安全策略，确保合规与可控。
开发者工具链爱好者：对代理性能优化、插件机制和 GitHub App 集成感兴趣，可扩展自定义功能。

en.tag: Performance optimization and security enhancement system for AI coding agents like Claude Code
en.what: ECC is an agent harness optimization system that provides skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development capabilities for AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, and Cursor. It enhances agent performance and control through unified configuration and plugin mechanisms.
en.content: The repository includes core JavaScript libraries, CLI tools, a GitHub App (ecc-tools), multi-language documentation, and example configurations, integrable via the npm package (ecc-universal).
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, leveraging the npm ecosystem, offering CLI and GitHub App integration, compatible with multiple agent frameworks (Claude Code, Codex, etc.).
en.hot: With 244k stars and 235 new stars today, ECC has become a star project in the AI agent toolchain space, attracting developers with its cross-agent compatibility and performance optimization features.
uses: AI coding agent users: Enhance memory, security, and skills for agents like Claude Code and Codex to boost development productivity.
Teams and organizations: Need unified management of configurations, permissions, and security policies across multiple AI agents for compliance and control.
Developer toolchain enthusiasts: Interested in agent performance optimization, plugin mechanisms, and GitHub App integration for custom extensions.

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理像最懒的高级工程师一样写最少代码
zh.what: Ponytail 是一个 JavaScript 库/技能包，注入到 AI 代理中，使其倾向于生成极简代码，避免过度工程。它通过内置的“懒人”提示和规则，让代理在实现功能时优先使用浏览器原生能力或现有依赖，从而大幅减少代码量、成本和延迟。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库、CLI 工具、基准测试脚本和文档。核心是注入到代理的提示词和规则集，支持 20 多种代理；基准测试展示了在真实仓库上的代码量减少（平均 54%，最高 94%）。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 JavaScript，通过 npm 分发，兼容多种 AI 代理（如 Claude Code）。依赖较少，核心是提示词工程。
zh.hot: 11 万星且日增近千，因为直击 AI 编程痛点：过度工程。它用幽默的“懒人”形象，承诺减少代码量、成本和延迟，且保持安全，引发开发者共鸣。
uses: AI 编程工具使用者：希望减少 AI 生成的冗余代码，提升代码质量。
团队技术负责人：想降低维护成本，让 AI 代理产出更简洁的代码。
对提示工程感兴趣者：学习如何通过提示词约束 AI 行为。

en.tag: Makes your AI agent write minimal code like a lazy senior dev
en.what: Ponytail is a JavaScript library/skill pack that injects a 'lazy senior dev' mindset into AI agents, pushing them to write minimal code and avoid over-engineering. It uses built-in prompts and rules to make agents prefer native browser features or existing dependencies, cutting code volume, cost, and latency.
en.content: The repo contains the core library, CLI tools, benchmark scripts, and docs. The core is a set of prompts and rules injected into agents, supporting 20+ agents; benchmarks show code reduction (mean 54%, up to 94%) on real repos.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, distributed via npm, compatible with 20+ AI agents (e.g., Claude Code). Minimal dependencies, core is prompt engineering.
en.hot: 111k stars with ~1k daily, because it hits the pain point of AI coding: over-engineering. With a humorous 'lazy dev' persona, it promises less code, lower cost, and faster execution while staying safe, resonating with developers.
uses: AI coding tool users: want to reduce redundant code and improve code quality.
Tech leads: aim to lower maintenance costs and get cleaner code from AI agents.
Prompt engineering enthusiasts: learn how to constrain AI behavior via prompts.

zh.tag: 自我进化的 AI 代理，跨平台、跨会话持续学习
zh.what: Hermes Agent 是一款由 Nous Research 构建的自我进化 AI 代理，内置学习循环，能从经验中创建技能、在应用中改进技能，并持续构建用户模型。它支持在多种平台（Telegram、Discord、Slack 等）和多种模型提供商之间无缝运行，且不锁定特定环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的代理代码库、终端 TUI 界面、跨平台网关、技能创建与改进机制、记忆管理、定时自动化（cron）、以及多语言 README 和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖包括 FTS5 搜索、LLM 集成（支持 Nous Portal、OpenRouter、OpenAI 等）、以及 Honcho 用户建模库。
zh.hot: 凭借 24 万+ 星标和日增 774 星，其独特的自我改进学习循环和跨平台、跨会话的持久记忆能力引发了广泛关注，成为 AI 代理领域的热门项目。
uses: 开发者和 AI 爱好者希望部署一个能自主学习和适应用户行为的个人 AI 代理。
需要跨平台（如 Telegram、Discord）与 AI 交互并保持对话连续性的团队或个人。
研究者探索代理记忆、技能自动化和用户建模等前沿方向。

en.tag: Self-improving AI agent that learns from experience across sessions and platforms
en.what: Hermes Agent is a self-improving AI agent built by Nous Research, featuring a built-in learning loop that creates skills from experience, improves them during use, and builds a deepening model of the user. It runs seamlessly across platforms (Telegram, Discord, Slack, etc.) and model providers without lock-in.
en.content: The repository contains the full agent codebase, a terminal TUI, cross-platform gateway, skill creation and improvement mechanisms, memory management, scheduled automations (cron), and multilingual READMEs and docs.
en.stack: Primarily Python, with dependencies on FTS5 search, LLM integrations (Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI, etc.), and the Honcho user modeling library.
en.hot: With over 240K stars and 774 stars added today, its unique self-improving learning loop and persistent cross-session memory have captured attention, making it a trending project in the AI agent space.
uses: Developers and AI enthusiasts seeking a personal AI agent that autonomously learns and adapts to user behavior.
Teams or individuals needing cross-platform AI interaction (e.g., Telegram, Discord) with conversation continuity.
Researchers exploring cutting-edge topics like agent memory, skill automation, and user modeling.

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 格式化库，快速安全的 printf/iostream 替代品
zh.what: {fmt} 是一个开源格式化库，提供快速且安全的 C stdio 和 C++ iostreams 替代方案。它实现了 C++20 的 std::format 和 C++23 的 std::print，并支持类似 Python 的格式字符串语法。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的库源码、文档、示例和测试，核心文件包括 base.h、format.h 等，支持用户自定义类型和可移植的 Unicode。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 实现，依赖少，支持 C++11 及以上标准，使用 Dragonbox 算法进行快速浮点格式化。
zh.hot: 今日新增 963 星，总星数达 25081，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。作为 C++ 标准库格式化功能的基础，其高性能和安全性备受开发者青睐。
uses: C++ 开发者需要比 printf 或 iostream 更安全、更快速的格式化输出时使用
库作者希望实现或扩展 C++20/23 格式化功能，或为自定义类型提供格式化支持
需要高精度浮点格式化且要求正确舍入和往返保证的数值计算场景

en.tag: A modern C++ formatting library, fast and safe alternative to printf and iostreams
en.what: {fmt} is an open-source formatting library providing a fast and safe alternative to C stdio and C++ iostreams. It implements C++20's std::format and C++23's std::print, with a format string syntax similar to Python's.
en.content: The repository contains full library source code, documentation, examples, and tests, with core files like base.h and format.h, supporting user-defined types and portable Unicode.
en.stack: Pure C++ implementation with minimal dependencies, supports C++11 and later, uses the Dragonbox algorithm for fast floating-point formatting.
en.hot: With 963 stars added today and 25,081 total, it tops the GitHub Trending daily chart. As the foundation for C++ standard formatting, its high performance and safety are widely appreciated.
uses: For C++ developers needing safer and faster formatting than printf or iostreams
For library authors implementing or extending C++20/23 formatting, or adding formatting support for custom types
For numerical computing scenarios requiring high-precision floating-point formatting with correct rounding and round-trip guarantees

en.tag: Official Agent Skills examples and spec for Claude
en.what: This is Anthropic's official repository containing example implementations of Agent Skills for Claude, covering creative, technical, and enterprise workflows. Each skill is a folder with a SKILL.md file and resources that enable Claude to perform specialized tasks more effectively.

Enterprise teams referencing business skills like branded document creation and communication workflows.
AI enthusiasts exploring creative skills for art, music, and design.
Technical teams leveraging document skill source code for production AI integrations.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编程助手提供 38 种编辑级图表模板
zh.what: 这是一个为 AI 编程助手（如 Claude Code、Codex 和 Pi）设计的技能包，提供 38 种编辑级质量的图表类型。它生成自包含的 HTML+SVG 文件，无需构建步骤或外部依赖，并强调无阴影、无 Mermaid 风格的设计。
zh.content: 仓库包含 38 种图表类型的定义，每种都有浅色、深色和全编辑三种静态变体，以及文档和截图。还包含语义模式系统，可将行为与布局分离，并支持从 draw.io 或 Mermaid 源重绘图表。
zh.stack: 主要基于 HTML 和 SVG，无 JavaScript 或外部图像依赖。设计为与 Claude Code、Codex、Pi 等 AI 代理兼容，并支持 Agent Skills 标准。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得超过 30.9k 星标，今日新增 437 星。它解决了 AI 生成图表质量差的痛点，提供了设计师认可的高质量模板，并持续更新新图表类型。
uses: 开发者使用 Claude Code 或 Codex 生成架构图、流程图等，避免手动调整样式
内容创作者需要快速制作编辑级图表，用于博客、文档或演示
团队希望统一图表风格，通过读取网站自动匹配品牌视觉

en.tag: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi
en.what: A skill pack for AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Codex, and Pi, offering 38 editorial-quality diagram types. It generates self-contained HTML+SVG files with no build step or external dependencies, emphasizing a clean design without shadows or Mermaid-style output.
en.content: The repo contains definitions for 38 diagram types, each with minimal light, minimal dark, and full-editorial static variants, plus docs and screenshots. It also includes a semantic pattern system that separates behavior from layout, and can redraw draw.io or Mermaid sources.
en.stack: Primarily HTML and SVG, with no JavaScript or external image dependencies. Designed to work with AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Pi, and compatible with Agent Skills.
en.hot: The repo has gone viral on GitHub with over 30.9k stars and 437 stars today. It addresses the pain point of low-quality AI-generated diagrams by offering designer-approved templates, and it continuously adds new diagram types.
uses: Developers using Claude Code or Codex to generate architecture diagrams, flowcharts, etc., without manual styling
Content creators needing quick editorial-quality diagrams for blogs, docs, or presentations
Teams wanting consistent diagram styling, with automatic brand matching by reading a website

en.tag: Open-source AI coding agent with terminal & desktop apps
en.what: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent that autonomously completes coding tasks in the terminal, supporting multiple models. It offers a Claude Code-like interactive experience and a desktop app (beta).
en.content: The repo includes the core agent engine, terminal UI (packages/web), desktop app (packages/console), and install scripts supporting various package managers.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on Node.js ecosystem, distributed via npm/bun/pnpm, with multi-platform installers (brew, scoop, pacman, etc.).
en.hot: With 204k stars and +345 daily, OpenCode leads open-source AI coding agents, attracting developers with its terminal-native experience and desktop app.

Teams needing a self-hostable AI coding assistant with multiple model providers.
Tech enthusiasts tracking active open-source AI coding tools.

zh.tag: 公开漏洞 PoC 与漏洞研究合集，吸引新人入行

zh.tag: POSIX 兼容的 Node.js 版本管理器

zh.tag: AI 代理技能安全扫描器，安装前检测漏洞与恶意模式

安全团队集成到 CI/CD 流程，自动扫描技能仓库

en.tag: Security scanner for AI agent skills, detecting vulnerabilities before install

en.stack: Built on Python 3.12+, uses AST analysis, YARA signatures, OSV.dev API, optional LLM semantic evaluation, and supports SARIF report output.
en.hot: As the AI agent skill ecosystem explodes, security concerns rise; SkillSpector fills the gap for skill scanning, backed by NVIDIA, with stars quickly growing to 16k.
uses: Developers quickly verify safety before installing third-party AI skills
Security teams integrate into CI/CD to automatically scan skill repos
AI agent users assess trustworthiness of skills for Claude Code, Codex, etc.

en.stack: Built with Python 3.10+, uses baostock for market data, SQLite for storage, Pydantic-settings for config, and supports installation via uv or pip.
en.hot: Gained 512 stars today, total 6489, ranking #8 on GitHub Trending for Python. It attracts attention for offering a free, automated stock screening tool for A-share retail investors, with clean design and easy deployment.
uses: A-share retail investors: automatically get technical pattern screening results daily, saving review time.
Quant enthusiasts: can reference its strategy implementations and data architecture for further development or learning.
Teams needing automated notifications: can integrate Feishu bot for scheduled task alerts.

zh.tag: 600+语言零样本语音克隆与语音设计TTS
zh.what: OmniVoice 是一个大规模多语言零样本文本转语音（TTS）模型，支持超过600种语言。它采用扩散语言模型风格架构，能生成高质量语音，并支持语音克隆和语音设计。
zh.content: 仓库包含模型代码、安装指南、快速上手示例、Python API、命令行工具、训练与评估脚本，以及完整的语言列表和演示页面。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 和 PyTorch，支持 NVIDIA GPU、Apple Silicon 和 Intel Arc GPU（XPU），可通过 pip 或 uv 安装。
zh.hot: 凭借超广的语言覆盖和先进的语音克隆质量，OmniVoice 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 128 星，总星数近万，位列 Python 趋势榜第 9。
uses: 内容创作者：快速生成多语言配音或克隆自己的声音，用于视频、播客等。
开发者：集成 TTS 功能到应用，利用 Python API 或命令行工具实现语音合成。
语言学习者：通过任意语言的文本转语音练习发音，或自定义语音属性。
研究人员：探索扩散语言模型架构在语音合成中的应用，并基于预训练模型进行微调。

en.tag: Zero-shot TTS with voice cloning & design for 600+ languages
en.what: OmniVoice is a massively multilingual zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) model supporting over 600 languages. Built on a diffusion language model-style architecture, it generates high-quality speech and supports voice cloning and voice design.
en.content: The repository includes model code, installation guide, quick start examples, Python API, command-line tools, training and evaluation scripts, as well as a full language list and demo page.
en.stack: Built with Python and PyTorch, supporting NVIDIA GPUs, Apple Silicon, and Intel Arc GPUs (XPU), installable via pip or uv.
en.hot: With its broad language coverage and state-of-the-art voice cloning quality, OmniVoice has gained rapid popularity on GitHub, adding 128 stars today and reaching nearly 10k stars, ranking #9 on the Python trending list.
uses: Content creators: quickly generate multilingual voiceovers or clone their own voice for videos, podcasts, etc.
Developers: integrate TTS into applications using the Python API or command-line tools for speech synthesis.
Language learners: practice pronunciation with text-to-speech in any language, or customize voice attributes.
Researchers: explore diffusion language model architectures for speech synthesis and fine-tune the pretrained model.

zh.tag: AI 数据集一站式加载与预处理工具
zh.what: Hugging Face Datasets 是一个轻量级库，提供一行代码下载和预处理 Hugging Face Hub 上的海量公共数据集（文本、图像、音频、视频等），并支持高效的数据预处理功能，如 map、filter 等操作，便于机器学习模型的训练和评估。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 库的源代码、文档、测试和示例，核心功能是 load_dataset 和 Dataset.map 等 API，支持多种数据格式和与主流框架的集成。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 NumPy、Pandas、PyArrow 等，支持 PyTorch、TensorFlow、JAX 等深度学习框架，可处理 CSV、JSON、Parquet 等格式。
zh.hot: 作为 Hugging Face 生态的核心组件，它已成为 AI 数据处理的标配工具，拥有 2.1 万+ Star，今日仍上榜 Trending，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: 机器学习工程师快速加载公开数据集进行模型训练与评估
数据科学家对本地或云端数据进行高效预处理和清洗
研究人员探索多模态数据集（图像、音频、3D 等）以开展实验
教育者用于教学演示，简化数据集获取流程

en.tag: One-stop dataset loading and preprocessing for AI
en.what: Hugging Face Datasets is a lightweight library that provides one-line dataloaders for many public datasets on the Hugging Face Hub, including text, image, audio, video, and more. It also offers efficient data preprocessing tools like map and filter, making it easy to prepare data for ML training and evaluation.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, tests, and examples for the Python library. Core features include load_dataset and Dataset.map APIs, supporting various data formats and integration with major frameworks.
en.stack: Built on Python with dependencies like NumPy, Pandas, and PyArrow, it integrates with PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, and supports formats like CSV, JSON, Parquet.
en.hot: As a core part of the Hugging Face ecosystem, it has become a standard tool for AI data processing, with over 21.9k stars and still trending today, showing sustained developer interest.
uses: ML engineers quickly load public datasets for model training and evaluation
Data scientists efficiently preprocess and clean local or cloud data
Researchers explore multimodal datasets (image, audio, 3D, etc.) for experiments
Educators use it in teaching to simplify dataset acquisition

zh.tag: 企业级 LLM/VLM 后训练强化学习框架
zh.what: Miles 是一个面向企业的大规模模型后训练强化学习框架，支持 LLM 和 VLM，与 SGLang 和 Megatron-LM 深度集成，提供高性能的 rollout 和训练能力。它从 slime 分叉而来，并与 slime 共同演进。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架源码、文档、快速入门指南、模型支持列表，以及多个博客文章链接，涵盖 v0.1 发布、Blackwell 原生 8-bit/4-bit RL、Kimi K3 支持等。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 SGLang 进行 rollout，Megatron-LM 进行训练，支持多种硬件（如 AMD Instinct MI355X）和模型（如 DeepSeek-V4、Kimi K3）。
zh.hot: 作为企业级 RL 框架，Miles 在 GitHub Trending 日榜排名第 14，今日新增 64 星，总星数达 2551，反映了社区对生产级后训练工具的高度关注。
uses: 企业 AI 团队需要大规模模型后训练，追求生产级稳定性和性能。
研究人员探索 LLM/VLM 的强化学习算法，需要与 SGLang 和 Megatron 无缝集成的框架。
开发者希望快速上手 RL 训练，利用 Miles 的文档和模型支持列表进行部署。

en.tag: Enterprise-grade RL framework for LLM/VLM post-training
en.what: Miles is an enterprise-facing reinforcement learning framework for large-scale model post-training, supporting LLMs and VLMs. It integrates tightly with SGLang for high-throughput rollout and Megatron-LM for training, forked from and co-evolving with slime.
en.content: The repo includes full framework source code, documentation, quick start guides, supported model lists, and links to blog posts covering v0.1 release, Blackwell-native 8-bit/4-bit RL, Kimi K3 support, and more.
en.stack: Built on Python, leverages SGLang for rollout and Megatron-LM for training, supports various hardware (e.g., AMD Instinct MI355X) and models (e.g., DeepSeek-V4, Kimi K3).
en.hot: As an enterprise-grade RL framework, Miles ranks #14 on GitHub Trending daily, gaining 64 stars today to reach 2551 total, reflecting strong community interest in production-grade post-training tools.
uses: Enterprise AI teams needing production-grade stability and performance for large-scale model post-training.
Researchers exploring RL algorithms for LLMs/VLMs, requiring seamless integration with SGLang and Megatron.
Developers seeking quick start with RL training, leveraging Miles' docs and supported model lists for deployment.

zh.tag: 为 Claude Code 打造的全流程学术研究技能套件
zh.what: 这是一套为 Claude Code 设计的学术研究技能包，覆盖从研究到发表的完整流程，包括文献检索、写作、评审、修订和定稿。它强调人机协作，AI 作为副驾驶，帮助处理引用格式化、数据验证等繁琐工作，而研究者专注于核心思考。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个技能模块，如研究规划、写作质量检查、风格校准、评审等，并提供了详细的文档和参考材料，包括 AI 研究失败模式清单。安装简单，支持 CLI、VS Code 和 JetBrains。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Python，作为 Claude Code 的插件使用，依赖 Claude Code 的插件系统。
zh.hot: 凭借近 4.5 万星标和日增 193 星，它精准切中学术写作痛点，提供人机协作而非全自动的方案，受到研究者和 AI 工具用户的广泛关注。
uses: 学术研究者：希望利用 AI 辅助论文写作，但保持对研究过程和内容的掌控。
学生和学者：需要高效管理参考文献、检查逻辑一致性，并提升写作质量。
AI 工具爱好者：探索 Claude Code 在专业领域的深度应用，学习如何构建技能插件。

en.tag: A comprehensive suite of Claude Code skills for the full academic research pipeline
en.what: This is a suite of skills for Claude Code covering the full academic research pipeline from research to publication, including literature search, writing, review, revision, and finalization. It emphasizes human-AI collaboration, with AI as a copilot handling grunt work like citation formatting and data verification, while researchers focus on core thinking.
en.content: The repository contains multiple skill modules such as research planning, writing quality check, style calibration, and review, along with detailed documentation and reference materials including a list of AI research failure modes. Installation is simple, supporting CLI, VS Code, and JetBrains.
en.stack: Primarily based on Python, used as a plugin for Claude Code, relying on Claude Code's plugin system.
en.hot: With nearly 45k stars and 193 new stars today, it precisely addresses academic writing pain points, offering a human-in-the-loop rather than fully automated approach, gaining wide attention from researchers and AI tool users.
uses: Academic researchers who want AI assistance in paper writing while maintaining control over the research process and content.
Students and scholars needing efficient reference management, logical consistency checks, and writing quality improvement.
AI tool enthusiasts exploring deep applications of Claude Code in professional domains and learning to build skill plugins.

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理自动完成工作的开源平台
zh.what: AutoGPT 是一个开源平台，允许用户用自然语言描述任务，然后自动构建、部署和运行 AI 代理来执行完整的工作流程。它旨在让每个人都能轻松使用和构建 AI 代理，无需深入编程知识。
zh.content: 仓库包含 AutoGPT 的核心代码、可视化构建器、AutoPilot 聊天界面、代理仪表盘，以及自托管和部署的文档与示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，依赖多种 AI 模型和工具，支持自托管和云平台部署。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 18.7 万星标，因其开创性的自主 AI 代理概念而备受关注，并获得了 Andrej Karpathy 等知名人士的推荐。
uses: 开发者：希望构建和部署自定义 AI 代理以自动化复杂工作流程的开发者。
非技术用户：希望通过自然语言描述任务来利用 AI 完成工作，无需编程技能。
企业团队：需要自动化业务流程、节省时间并提高效率的团队。

en.tag: Open-source platform for AI agents that finish the work
en.what: AutoGPT is an open-source platform that lets users describe tasks in plain English, then automatically builds, deploys, and runs AI agents to execute complete workflows. It aims to make AI agents accessible to everyone, both to use and to build on, without requiring deep coding knowledge.
en.content: The repository contains the core code for AutoGPT, a visual builder, AutoPilot chat interface, agent dashboard, and documentation and examples for self-hosting and deployment.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python, it leverages various AI models and tools, and supports both self-hosted and cloud platform deployment.
en.hot: With over 187k stars, it has gained massive attention for its pioneering autonomous AI agent concept, and has been endorsed by notable figures like Andrej Karpathy.
uses: Developers: who want to build and deploy custom AI agents to automate complex workflows.
Non-technical users: who want to leverage AI to complete tasks by describing them in natural language, without coding skills.
Enterprise teams: needing to automate business processes, save time, and increase efficiency.

zh.tag: 用 NumPy 从零实现机器学习算法，透明可读的教学仓库
zh.what: 这是一个从零开始用 Python 和 NumPy 实现经典机器学习模型与算法的仓库，覆盖线性回归到深度学习。项目目的不是追求性能优化，而是以透明易懂的方式展示算法内部工作原理。
zh.content: 仓库包含监督学习（如回归、分类）、无监督学习（如聚类、关联分析）、强化学习和深度学习（如 CNN、RBM）的实现，并附有可运行的示例脚本和可视化结果。
zh.stack: 主要依赖 Python 和 NumPy，部分示例可能使用 matplotlib 进行可视化，安装简单（setup.py）。
zh.hot: 该仓库长期受关注，累计 3.2 万星标，因其教学价值高，帮助学习者理解算法本质，今日新增 26 星，仍保持热度。
uses: 机器学习初学者：通过阅读源码理解算法内部机制，而非仅调用黑盒库。
教学与培训场景：作为课程补充材料，展示从零构建模型的完整过程。
面试准备者：快速复习经典模型的数学与实现细节。

en.tag: Bare-bones NumPy implementations of ML models for transparent, accessible learning
en.what: This repository provides bare-bones NumPy implementations of fundamental ML models and algorithms, from linear regression to deep learning. It prioritizes transparency and accessibility over computational efficiency to reveal how algorithms work internally.
en.content: It contains implementations for supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement, and deep learning (e.g., CNN, RBM), along with runnable example scripts and visualizations.
en.stack: Primarily Python with NumPy; some examples use matplotlib for visualization. Installation is straightforward via setup.py.
en.hot: With 32.6k stars and steady daily gains, it remains popular for its high educational value in demystifying ML algorithms.
uses: ML beginners who want to understand algorithms by reading source code instead of using black-box libraries.
Educators and trainers seeking supplementary material to demonstrate model building from scratch.
Job seekers preparing for interviews by reviewing mathematical and implementation details of classic models.

zh.tag: AI 编码代理的上下文优化层，削减 98% 工具输出
zh.what: Context Mode 是专为 AI 编码代理设计的上下文窗口优化工具。它通过沙箱化工具输出（减少 98% 的 token 占用）、持久化会话记忆，并借助 MCP 和 hooks 在 17 个平台间强制路由，从而解决 AI 编程中的“上下文另一半”问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 核心库、MCP 服务器、编辑器/平台扩展（如 VS Code、JetBrains）、CLI 工具、hooks 示例及文档。提供 npm 包、GitHub Marketplace 集成，并附带统计徽章与使用指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，依赖 MCP（Model Context Protocol）与平台 hooks，支持 npm 分发与 GitHub Marketplace 安装。
zh.hot: GitHub 星标超 2 万，今日新增 35，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 6。因解决 AI 编码代理的上下文溢出痛点，且被 Microsoft、Google 等大厂团队采用，并登上 Hacker News 榜首。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程工具的开发者，希望减少上下文浪费、提升长任务稳定性。
团队需要跨平台统一管理 AI 代理的上下文与记忆，适用于多 IDE 或 CI 环境。
对 MCP 生态感兴趣，想通过 hooks 定制工具输出过滤与路由的进阶用户。

en.tag: Context optimization layer for AI coding agents, cutting tool output by 98%
en.what: Context Mode is a context window optimization tool for AI coding agents. It sandboxes tool output (98% token reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP and hooks, addressing the 'other half' of the context problem in AI coding.
en.content: The repo contains a TypeScript core library, MCP server, editor/platform extensions (VS Code, JetBrains, etc.), CLI tools, hooks examples, and docs. Includes npm package, GitHub Marketplace integration, with stats badges and usage guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, relies on MCP (Model Context Protocol) and platform hooks, distributed via npm and GitHub Marketplace.
en.hot: With 20k+ stars and +35 today, ranking #6 on TypeScript daily trending. It solves context overflow for AI coding agents, adopted by teams at Microsoft, Google, etc., and hit #1 on Hacker News.
uses: Developers using AI coding tools like Claude Code or Cursor who want to reduce context waste and improve long-task stability.
Teams needing unified context and memory management across platforms, suitable for multi-IDE or CI environments.
Advanced users interested in MCP ecosystem, wanting to customize tool output filtering and routing via hooks.

zh.tag: 终端 AI 编程代理，内置 IDE 能力
zh.what: oh-my-pi 是一个终端 AI 编程代理，将 IDE 的编辑能力集成到命令行中。它支持哈希锚定的编辑、优化的工具集、LSP、Python、浏览器和子代理等功能，旨在提供开箱即用且高度可定制的编码体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Rust 代码库（约 8 万行）、TypeScript 编写的编码代理包，以及安装脚本和文档。提供 60+ 提供商、31 个内置工具、14 个 LSP 操作和 28 个 DAP 操作。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 和 TypeScript，运行时支持 Bun（推荐），并支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。依赖包括 LSP 和 DAP 协议，以及多种 AI 提供商。
zh.hot: 作为 Pi 的 fork，它提供了更强大的代理表面，并持续根据真实使用进行调优。本周新增 1739 星，总星数达 22525，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 16 名，反映了开发者对终端 AI 编码工具的高度关注。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中直接获得 AI 辅助编码，无需切换 IDE
需要高度可定制和可扩展的 AI 代理，支持多种提供商和工具
喜欢使用 Rust 和 TypeScript 构建高性能命令行工具的技术爱好者
希望利用 LSP 和 DAP 集成进行代码导航和调试的开发者

en.tag: Terminal AI coding agent with IDE wired in
en.what: oh-my-pi is a terminal AI coding agent that integrates IDE capabilities into the command line. It supports hash-anchored edits, an optimized tool harness, LSP, Python, browser, and subagents, aiming to provide an out-of-the-box yet deeply customizable coding experience.
en.content: The repository contains a core Rust codebase (~80k lines), a TypeScript coding agent package, and installation scripts and docs. It offers 60+ providers, 31 built-in tools, 14 LSP ops, and 28 DAP ops.
en.stack: Primarily Rust and TypeScript, with Bun as the recommended runtime, supporting macOS, Linux, and Windows. It leverages LSP and DAP protocols and integrates with multiple AI providers.
en.hot: As a fork of Pi, it offers a more capable agent surface and is continuously tuned by real-world use. With 1,739 stars added this week and a total of 22,525, ranking #16 on the TypeScript weekly trending, it reflects high developer interest in terminal AI coding tools.
uses: Developers who want AI-assisted coding directly in the terminal without switching IDEs
Those needing a highly customizable and extensible AI agent with multiple providers and tools
Tech enthusiasts interested in building high-performance CLI tools with Rust and TypeScript
Developers who want to leverage LSP and DAP integration for code navigation and debugging

zh.tag: GitHub Actions 工作流产物上传官方 Action
zh.what: 这是 GitHub 官方提供的 Action，用于将工作流运行中生成的文件或目录作为 Artifacts 上传，供后续步骤、作业或工作流下载使用。它支持单个文件、整个目录、通配符模式以及多路径排除等灵活配置，并允许自定义压缩级别和保留期限。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Action 的源代码、README 文档（详细说明用法、输入输出、示例和限制）以及发布说明。主要代码为 TypeScript，基于 @actions/artifact 包实现。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，依赖 @actions/artifact 包，用于与 GitHub Actions 运行时交互。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub Actions 的核心组件，几乎所有需要保存构建产物的工作流都会用到它。虽然今日新增 star 不多，但持续保持高关注度，且 v4 版本更新和旧版本弃用提醒使其频繁出现在 Trending 上。
uses: CI/CD 工程师：在持续集成流程中上传构建产物（如安装包、测试报告）供后续步骤或外部下载。
开源项目维护者：配置工作流以保存和共享构建输出，方便用户获取最新构建版本。
需要跨作业共享数据的开发者：通过 Artifacts 在不同作业之间传递文件，实现多阶段流水线。

en.tag: Official GitHub Action to upload workflow artifacts
en.what: This is an official GitHub Action that uploads files or directories generated during a workflow run as Artifacts, making them available for subsequent steps, jobs, or workflows. It supports individual files, entire directories, wildcard patterns, and multiple paths with exclusions, and allows customizing compression level and retention period.
en.content: The repository contains the Action's source code, a comprehensive README with usage, inputs/outputs, examples, and limitations, plus release notes. The code is in TypeScript and powered by the @actions/artifact package.
en.stack: Developed in TypeScript, relying on the @actions/artifact package to interact with the GitHub Actions runtime.
en.hot: As a core component of GitHub Actions, it is used by nearly every workflow that needs to save build artifacts. Although today's star increase is modest, it maintains high visibility, and the v4 update with deprecation notices for older versions keeps it trending.
uses: CI/CD engineers: upload build artifacts (e.g., binaries, test reports) in continuous integration pipelines for later steps or external download.
Open-source maintainers: configure workflows to store and share build outputs, making it easy for users to get the latest builds.
Developers needing cross-job data sharing: use Artifacts to pass files between jobs in multi-stage pipelines.

zh.tag: 跨设备、跨平台的个人 AI 助手，连接模型、工具与聊天渠道
zh.what: OpenClaw 是一个运行在你自己的设备上、并能在你常用的聊天渠道中与你交互的 AI 助手。它通过一个网关将模型、工具、消息渠道和可选的配套应用连接起来，既可以作为单人的个人助理，也可以作为团队成员共享的部署。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、安装脚本、文档（包括快速入门、团队部署指南、架构说明等），以及用于展示的示例。主要组件是一个基于 TypeScript 的网关，负责协调模型、工具和渠道。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，基于 Node.js 运行时（要求 Node 22.22.3+ 等），支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。通过 npm 发布，并支持 Docker 和 Nix 部署。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上已获得近 39 万星标，今日新增 156，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 9。其“真正做事”的 AI 助手定位和跨平台、跨渠道的灵活性吸引了大量关注。
uses: 个人用户：希望拥有一个能自主操作设备、在聊天中完成任务的 AI 助手。
团队协作：需要共享一个可信的 AI 网关，让成员在各自渠道中协同使用。
开发者：想扩展或定制 AI 助手，连接自定义工具和模型。

en.tag: A cross-device, cross-platform personal AI assistant connecting models, tools, and chat channels
en.what: OpenClaw is an AI assistant that runs on your own devices and interacts with you in the chat channels you already use. It connects models, tools, messaging channels, and optional companion apps through a single gateway, serving as a personal assistant for one person or a shared deployment for a trusted team.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, installation scripts, documentation (including quick start, team deployment guide, architecture explanation), and examples. The main component is a TypeScript-based gateway that orchestrates models, tools, and channels.
en.stack: Written primarily in TypeScript, built on Node.js (requires Node 22.22.3+ etc.), supporting macOS, Linux, and Windows. Published via npm, with Docker and Nix deployment options.
en.hot: With nearly 389k stars and 156 added today, ranking #9 on the TypeScript daily trending list, its positioning as an AI that 'really does things' and its cross-platform, cross-channel flexibility have attracted massive attention.
uses: Individual users: want an AI assistant that can autonomously operate devices and complete tasks in chat.
Team collaboration: need a shared trusted AI gateway for members to use across their channels.
Developers: want to extend or customize the AI assistant to connect custom tools and models.

zh.tag: 多智能体协作桌面应用，让 AI 团队自主完成任务
zh.what: Agent Teams AI 是一个桌面应用，让用户扮演老板角色，管理多个 AI 代理组成的团队。代理们自主处理任务、相互通信并审查彼此的工作，用户只需通过看板下达高层指令。支持多种 AI 提供商和模型，包括免费无需认证的模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用源码、文档、截图和 CI 配置。应用提供任务看板、代理执行日志、代码审查界面、提供商和模型选择、令牌使用和成本分析等功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，可能基于 Electron 或类似框架构建桌面应用。依赖多个 AI 提供商的 API，支持 200+ 模型和 75+ LLM 提供商。
zh.hot: GitHub 日榜 TypeScript 第 10 名，2 天新增 17 星，总星数 2069。其多代理协作理念和广泛的模型支持吸引了开发者，尤其是免费模型无需认证的便利性。
uses: 适合希望自动化复杂项目任务、减少人工干预的开发者或团队。
适用于需要同时使用多个 AI 提供商（如 Claude、Codex、Copilot）进行编码和项目工作的场景。
适合对 AI 代理协作和自主工作流感兴趣的研究者或爱好者。

en.tag: Desktop app for AI agent teams that autonomously handle tasks, message, and review each other's work
en.what: Agent Teams AI is a desktop app that lets users act as the boss, managing a team of AI agents. Agents autonomously handle tasks, message each other, and review each other's work, while users just watch the kanban board and give high-level commands. It supports multiple AI providers and models, including free models with no authentication.
en.content: The repository contains desktop app source code, docs, screenshots, and CI config. The app features a task kanban board, agent execution logs, code review UI, provider/model selection, and token usage/cost analytics.
en.stack: Primarily developed in TypeScript, likely built on Electron or similar framework for desktop. Integrates APIs from multiple AI providers, supporting 200+ models and 75+ LLM providers.
en.hot: Ranked #10 on GitHub Trending TypeScript daily, gaining 17 stars in a day to reach 2069 total. Its multi-agent collaboration concept and broad model support attract developers, especially the convenience of free models without auth.
uses: For developers or teams wanting to automate complex project tasks and reduce manual intervention.
For scenarios needing to use multiple AI providers (e.g., Claude, Codex, Copilot) for coding and project work simultaneously.
For researchers or enthusiasts interested in AI agent collaboration and autonomous workflows.

zh.tag: 全球公开 IPTV 频道播放列表合集
zh.what: 这是一个收集全球公开 IPTV 频道播放列表的仓库，提供多种格式的 m3u 播放列表，用户可直接在支持直播的播放器中打开使用。仓库还提供 EPG 电子节目指南、频道数据库和 API 接口。
zh.content: 仓库包含主播放列表 index.m3u、分类播放列表（如按国家/语言/类别）、EPG 数据、频道数据库（iptv-org/database）以及 API 文档（iptv-org/api）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 GitHub Actions 自动更新，数据存储于 iptv-org/database，通过 GitHub Pages 托管播放列表。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 13.7 万 star，每日新增约 127，长期位居 GitHub 趋势榜，因其提供免费、便捷的全球电视直播资源而广受欢迎。
uses: 希望免费观看全球电视直播的用户，可直接将播放列表链接粘贴到 VLC 等播放器。
开发者可基于其 API 和数据库构建自定义 IPTV 应用或服务。
需要 EPG 节目指南的爱好者，可下载数据用于个人媒体中心。

en.tag: Collection of publicly available IPTV channels from all over the world
en.what: This repository collects publicly available IPTV channel playlists from around the world, offering m3u playlists in various formats that can be directly opened in any live-streaming-capable player. It also provides EPG (Electronic Program Guide), a channel database, and an API.
en.content: The repository includes the main playlist index.m3u, categorized playlists (by country/language/category), EPG data, a channel database (iptv-org/database), and API documentation (iptv-org/api).
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, with GitHub Actions for automated updates, data sourced from iptv-org/database, and playlists hosted via GitHub Pages.
en.hot: With over 137k stars and ~127 new stars daily, it consistently ranks on GitHub Trending, popular for providing free and easy access to global live TV channels.
uses: Users who want to watch free global live TV can paste the playlist link into VLC or other players.
Developers can build custom IPTV apps or services using its API and database.
Enthusiasts needing EPG data can download it for personal media centers.

zh.tag: 本地离线音视频转录工具，支持多模型与多格式导出
zh.what: Vibe 是一款完全离线的音视频转录应用，支持多种语言和模型（Whisper、Nemotron 等），确保数据不出设备。它提供实时预览、批量转录、翻译、摘要等功能，并支持从 YouTube 等网站转录音频。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（支持 macOS/Windows/Linux）、CLI 工具、HTTP API（带 Swagger 文档），以及模型下载和集成功能。代码结构包括前端界面、后端处理逻辑、模型管理、文档和构建指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 Tauri 或 Electron 构建桌面应用，集成 Whisper.cpp 等推理引擎，支持 GPU 加速（Vulkan/CoreML），并可选集成 Ollama 和 Claude API。
zh.hot: 今日新增 45 stars，总星数 7335，在 GitHub Trending 日榜（TypeScript）排名第 12。其强调隐私的本地转录功能在数据敏感时代极具吸引力，且功能丰富，支持多种模型和导出格式。
uses: 注重隐私的个人用户，希望在不泄露数据的情况下转录会议、讲座或采访。
内容创作者和记者，需要快速转录视频或音频并生成字幕（SRT/VTT）或摘要。
开发者或研究者，需要本地批量转录或通过 CLI/API 集成转录功能到自己的工作流。
多语言用户，需要将转录结果翻译成英文或进行多语言摘要。

en.tag: On-device audio/video transcription with privacy, multi-model support, and rich exports
en.what: Vibe is a fully offline transcription app for audio and video, supporting multiple languages and models (Whisper, Nemotron, etc.) with ultimate privacy. It offers real-time preview, batch transcription, translation, summarization, and can transcribe audio from popular websites.
en.content: The repository contains a desktop app (macOS/Windows/Linux), CLI tool, HTTP API with Swagger docs, and model download/integration features. Code includes frontend UI, backend processing, model management, docs, and build guides.
en.stack: Built primarily with TypeScript, likely using Tauri or Electron for the desktop app, integrating inference engines like Whisper.cpp, with GPU acceleration (Vulkan/CoreML), and optional Ollama and Claude API integration.
en.hot: Gained 45 stars today, total 7335, ranking #12 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript). Its privacy-focused on-device transcription is highly appealing in a data-sensitive era, plus rich features like multi-model support and export formats.
uses: Privacy-conscious individuals who want to transcribe meetings, lectures, or interviews without data leaving their device.
Content creators and journalists needing quick transcription of videos/audio and subtitle generation (SRT/VTT) or summaries.
Developers/researchers who need local batch transcription or want to integrate transcription via CLI/API into their workflows.
Multilingual users who need translation of transcripts to English or multilingual summarization.

zh.tag: 轻量级高性能金融图表库
zh.what: TradingView 官方开源的轻量级金融图表库，基于 HTML5 Canvas 构建，提供高性能的交互式图表。它体积小、加载快，适合在网页中展示金融数据，可替代静态图片图表。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库源码、文档、示例和插件示例。核心库提供丰富的图表功能，并支持通过插件扩展。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 HTML5 Canvas。可通过 npm 或 CDN 安装使用。
zh.hot: 作为 TradingView 官方库，拥有 17k+ stars，是金融图表领域的热门选择。其轻量高性能的特性吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 网页开发者需要快速集成金融图表，如股票、加密货币等行情展示。
需要替代静态图片图表，提升交互性和加载性能的场景。
开发者希望基于插件机制定制图表功能，满足特定业务需求。

en.tag: Lightweight and performant financial charts library
en.what: TradingView's official open-source lightweight financial charting library built with HTML5 Canvas, offering high-performance interactive charts. It is small and fast, suitable for displaying financial data on web pages, and can replace static image charts.
en.content: The repository contains the core library source code, documentation, demos, and plugin examples. The core library offers rich charting features and supports extension via plugins.
en.stack: Written primarily in TypeScript, relying on HTML5 Canvas. Can be installed via npm or CDN.
en.hot: As an official TradingView library with 17k+ stars, it is a popular choice in financial charting. Its lightweight and high-performance features attract many developers.
uses: Web developers needing to quickly integrate financial charts for stocks, crypto, etc.
Scenarios requiring replacement of static image charts with interactive ones for better performance.
Developers wanting to customize chart features via plugin mechanism for specific business needs.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理设计循环系统的模式库与 CLI 工具
zh.what: Loop Engineering 是一个模式库和 CLI 工具集，帮助开发者设计系统来提示和编排 AI 编码代理，而不是手动输入下一个提示词。它受 Addy Osmani 和 Boris Cherny 的启发，提供循环审计、初始化和成本估算等工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含模式文档（如 PR Babysitter）、快速入门指南、重构路径、GitHub Actions 薄循环启动器，以及一个交互式模式选择器。CLI 工具通过 npx 安装，支持多种代理工具。
zh.stack: TypeScript 编写的 CLI 工具，通过 npm 分发，支持 Claude、Grok、Codex 和 Opencode 等代理。文档站点使用 GitHub Pages 托管。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编码代理的普及，开发者需要系统化的编排方法。该仓库提供了实用模式和工具，star 数在一天内增长 16，达到 1.1 万，登上 TypeScript 趋势榜。
uses: 希望自动化日常仓库维护（如 issue 分类、CI 监控）的开发者
需要系统化编排 AI 代理来完成功能开发或重构的团队
对 AI 代理工作流设计感兴趣，想学习模式库的技术爱好者

en.tag: Pattern library & CLI tools for designing loops that orchestrate AI coding agents
en.what: Loop Engineering is a pattern library and CLI toolkit for designing systems that prompt and orchestrate AI coding agents, instead of typing the next prompt yourself. Inspired by Addy Osmani and Boris Cherny, it includes tools like loop-audit, loop-init, and loop-cost.
en.content: The repo contains pattern docs (e.g., PR Babysitter), quickstart guides, refactor paths, a thin GitHub Action loop starter, and an interactive pattern picker. CLI tools are installed via npx and support multiple agent tools.
en.stack: CLI tools written in TypeScript, distributed via npm, supporting agents like Claude, Grok, Codex, and Opencode. Docs site is hosted on GitHub Pages.
en.hot: As AI coding agents become mainstream, developers need systematic orchestration. This repo offers practical patterns and tools, gaining 16 stars in a day to reach 11k, trending in TypeScript.
uses: Developers wanting to automate routine repo maintenance like issue triage and CI monitoring
Teams needing systematic orchestration of AI agents for feature development or refactoring
Tech enthusiasts interested in AI agent workflow design and pattern libraries

zh.tag: 为复杂代码库打造的 Codex 代理框架，集成项目记忆、规划与验证。
zh.what: LazyCodex 是一个为 Codex 设计的代理框架，旨在处理复杂代码库。它提供项目记忆、规划、执行和验证完成等功能，确保代理在大型项目中高效且可靠地工作。
zh.content: 仓库包含安装脚本、配置模块、代理角色定义，以及基于 OmO 的集成。通过 npx 命令或 Codex 插件市场安装，提供无 TUI 的自主模式。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，依赖 OmO（oh-my-openagent）框架，并集成了 Codex 插件系统。使用 npx 进行分发，无需全局安装。
zh.hot: 作为 Codex 的代理框架，它借力 OmO 的 60K Stars 热度，为 Codex 用户提供高质量代理体验。GitHub 日榜 TypeScript 类第 15 名，Star 数达 3396。
uses: 使用 Codex 进行复杂代码库开发的开发者，希望提升代理的规划与执行能力。
需要项目记忆和验证完成功能的团队，确保代理在大型项目中可靠运行。
喜欢 OmO 但希望更简单安装方式的用户，可通过 npx 快速部署。

en.tag: The agent harness for complex codebases, bringing project memory, planning, and verified completion to Codex.
en.what: LazyCodex is an agent harness for Codex, designed to handle complex codebases. It provides project memory, planning, execution, and verified completion, ensuring agents work efficiently and reliably in large projects.
en.content: The repository includes installation scripts, configuration blocks, agent role definitions, and an integration based on OmO. It can be installed via npx or from the Codex plugin marketplace, with a no-TUI autonomous mode.
en.stack: Developed in TypeScript, it relies on the OmO (oh-my-openagent) framework and integrates with the Codex plugin system. Distributed via npx, requiring no global installation.
en.hot: As an agent harness for Codex, it leverages the popularity of OmO (60K stars) to offer a high-quality agent experience for Codex users. Ranked #15 on GitHub Trending for TypeScript today, with 3,396 stars.
uses: Developers using Codex for complex codebases, seeking enhanced planning and execution capabilities.
Teams that need project memory and verified completion to ensure reliable agent performance in large projects.
Users who like OmO but prefer a simpler installation, can deploy quickly via npx.

zh.tag: AI 智能体工具链：统一 LLM API、代理循环、TUI 与编程代理 CLI
zh.what: 提供模块化 AI 代理开发框架，整合多厂商 LLM API、代理运行时与终端交互界面。内置可自扩展的编程代理 CLI，支持工具调用、状态管理与交互式编码任务。
zh.content: 仓库采用 monorepo 结构，包含 pi-ai（统一 LLM 接口）、pi-agent-core（代理运行时）、pi-coding-agent（交互式编码 CLI）和 pi-tui（差分渲染终端 UI）四个核心包。README 还提供了容器化与沙箱隔离方案，以及面向人类和代理的协作规范。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，使用 npm 管理 monorepo 依赖与生命周期脚本。支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等主流 LLM 提供商，并可通过 Docker 或 Gondolin micro-VM 进行容器化隔离。
zh.hot: 一周内新增 2,741 Star 使其冲上 TypeScript 周榜第 17 名，目前总 Star 数已突破 7.2 万。开发者对统一 LLM 接口与自扩展编程代理的结合表现出强烈兴趣。
uses: 需要构建多模型 AI 代理的开发者——统一接口降低集成成本
追求终端原生体验的 CLI 用户——内置 TUI 与差分渲染提升交互效率
关注代码安全隔离的团队——提供 Docker、micro-VM 等多种沙箱方案
希望人机与 AI 代理协作的项目维护者——贡献指南同时面向人类与 Agent

en.tag: AI agent toolkit with unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI and coding agent CLI
en.what: A modular AI agent development framework that unifies multi-provider LLM APIs, agent runtime, and terminal UI. It features a self-extensible coding agent CLI with tool calling, state management, and interactive coding capabilities.
en.content: The monorepo houses four core packages: pi-ai (unified LLM API), pi-agent-core (agent runtime), pi-coding-agent (interactive CLI), and pi-tui (diff-rendered terminal UI). It also includes containerization guides and contribution rules for both humans and agents.
en.stack: Built on TypeScript with npm-based monorepo tooling and lifecycle scripts. Supports major LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and offers containerization via Docker or Gondolin micro-VM.
en.hot: It gained 2,741 stars this week, landing at #17 on GitHub's TypeScript Weekly Trending with over 72.2k total stars. The combination of a unified LLM API and a self-extensible coding agent has drawn strong developer interest.
uses: Developers building multi-model AI agents — unified API reduces integration overhead
CLI users preferring terminal-native experiences — built-in TUI with diff rendering
Teams requiring secure isolation — supports Docker, micro-VM, and sandbox patterns
Project maintainers enabling human and AI co-contribution — guidelines cover both humans and agents

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的高品质 React UI 组件库
zh.what: Libraries.dev 是一套为 AI 代理设计的精美 React UI 组件库，包含动态边框光束、液态变形效果和点状思考球加载器等组件。每个组件都配有独立的演示站点，方便开发者预览和体验。
zh.content: 仓库采用 npm workspaces 管理，包含多个独立的 npm 包（如 border-beam、liquid-gooey、thinking-orbs），每个包有独立的 README 和许可证。同时提供多个演示站点（beam、gooey、orbs）和一个总览站点 libraries.dev。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 和 React，使用 npm workspaces 管理多包，通过 GitHub Actions 和 Cloudflare Pages 部署，支持热重载开发。
zh.hot: 在 AI 代理 UI 组件需求增长背景下，该项目以高质量设计和易用性迅速获得近 3000 星，今日新增 68 星，登上 TypeScript 趋势榜。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要为代理界面添加动态边框或加载动画等视觉元素。
React 前端开发者：寻找现成的高质量 UI 组件以提升应用交互体验。
UI/UX 设计师：通过演示站点获取灵感，探索液态效果和光束动画的应用。

en.tag: High-crafted React UI libraries for AI agents
en.what: Libraries.dev is a collection of polished React UI components crafted for AI agents, including animated border beams, liquid morph effects, and dotted thought-orb loaders. Each component comes with its own demo site for easy preview.
en.content: The repo uses npm workspaces, containing multiple independent npm packages (e.g., border-beam, liquid-gooey, thinking-orbs), each with its own README and license. It also includes demo sites (beam, gooey, orbs) and an umbrella site libraries.dev.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and React, managed via npm workspaces, deployed using GitHub Actions and Cloudflare Pages, with hot-reload development support.
en.hot: Amid growing demand for AI agent UI components, this project quickly gained nearly 3000 stars with high-quality design and ease of use, adding 68 stars today and trending in TypeScript.
uses: AI agent developers: need to add dynamic borders or loading animations to agent interfaces.
React frontend developers: looking for ready-made high-quality UI components to enhance interaction.
UI/UX designers: get inspiration from demo sites for liquid effects and beam animations.

zh.tag: 在 Claude Code 中调用 Codex 进行代码审查与任务委派
zh.what: 这是一个 Claude Code 插件，让用户可以在 Claude Code 工作流中直接使用 OpenAI 的 Codex 进行代码审查或委派任务。它提供了多个斜杠命令，如 /codex:review 和 /codex:adversarial-review，以及后台任务管理功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含插件代码、文档和演示视频。主要提供斜杠命令和子代理，用于代码审查、任务委派、会话交接和后台任务管理。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript 开发，需要 Node.js 18.18+，依赖 Claude Code 插件系统和 OpenAI Codex CLI。
zh.hot: 该插件将两大 AI 编程工具（Claude Code 和 Codex）集成，方便用户在现有工作流中利用 Codex 的能力。Star 数已达 3.2 万，今日新增 52，位列 JavaScript 日榜第 7。
uses: Claude Code 用户希望在不切换工具的情况下获得 Codex 的代码审查能力。
开发者需要将复杂任务委派给 Codex 在后台运行，同时继续在 Claude Code 中工作。
团队希望利用对抗性审查来挑战实现决策和设计权衡。

en.tag: Use Codex from Claude Code for code reviews and task delegation
en.what: This is a plugin for Claude Code that enables users to leverage OpenAI's Codex for code reviews or task delegation directly within their Claude Code workflow. It provides slash commands like /codex:review and /codex:adversarial-review, plus background job management.
en.content: The repository contains plugin code, documentation, and a demo video. It offers slash commands and subagents for code review, task delegation, session handoff, and background job management.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript, requires Node.js 18.18+, relies on Claude Code's plugin system and the OpenAI Codex CLI.
en.hot: This plugin integrates two major AI coding tools (Claude Code and Codex), making it easy for users to leverage Codex within their existing workflow. With 32.7k stars and 52 new today, it ranks #7 on the JavaScript daily trending list.
uses: Claude Code users who want Codex's code review capabilities without switching tools.
Developers who need to delegate complex tasks to Codex in the background while continuing work in Claude Code.
Teams looking to use adversarial reviews to challenge implementation decisions and design tradeoffs.

zh.tag: 为AI编码代理提供生产级工程技能的技能包
zh.what: 这个仓库提供了一套编码技能，将资深工程师的工作流程、质量门禁和最佳实践编码成AI代理可以遵循的规范。它通过斜杠命令和自动触发机制，覆盖从规格定义到部署的整个开发周期。
zh.content: 仓库包含24个技能，每个技能位于skills/目录下，并配有references/目录存放参考文档。提供8个斜杠命令（如/spec、/plan、/build）对应开发阶段，还支持通过skills CLI安装到70多种AI代理中。
zh.stack: 主要语言是JavaScript，依赖Vercel Labs的skills CLI进行安装和管理。技能本身是Markdown格式的指令集，可被Claude Code、Cursor、Codex等代理识别。
zh.hot: 该仓库在GitHub Trending上排名靠前，拥有近9万星标，因为AI编码代理的普及使得开发者急需标准化的工程实践来提升代码质量。它提供即插即用的技能，简化了代理的工作流程。
uses: AI代理用户：希望让Claude Code、Cursor等代理遵循资深工程师的最佳实践。
开发团队：需要统一编码规范和质量门禁，提升代码审查和测试效率。
