zh.what: 该仓库是 OpenAI 官方的 Codex 插件集合，包含多种插件示例，每个插件都有清单文件和可选配套组件。它提供了默认市场和 API 密钥用户的独立市场，方便用户发现和安装插件。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个插件目录，如 Figma、Notion、iOS/macOS 构建、Web 应用、Expo 等，每个插件包含清单文件及技能、MCP 配置等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，插件基于 Codex 平台，依赖 JSON 清单和 MCP 协议。
zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方仓库，吸引了大量开发者关注，今日新增 20 星，总星数超 5400，位列日榜第 15 名。
uses: 开发者想要扩展 Codex 功能，创建自定义插件。
团队需要集成 Figma、Notion 等工具到 AI 工作流。
学习官方插件结构和最佳实践。

en.tag: Official Codex plugin examples and marketplace
en.what: This repository is OpenAI's official collection of Codex plugin examples, each with a manifest and optional companion surfaces. It provides a default marketplace and a separate one for API key users, making it easy to discover and install plugins.
en.content: The repo contains plugin directories for Figma, Notion, iOS/macOS builds, web apps, Expo, etc., each with manifests and optional skills/MCP configs.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, plugins are built on the Codex platform, relying on JSON manifests and MCP protocol.
en.hot: As an official OpenAI repo, it attracts many developers, gaining 20 stars today and over 5400 total, ranking 15th on the daily trending list.
uses: Developers who want to extend Codex with custom plugins.
Teams needing to integrate tools like Figma and Notion into AI workflows.
Learners studying official plugin structure and best practices.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 写的本地优先罗技 Options+ 替代品
zh.what: OpenLogi 是一个开源的罗技外设配置工具，通过 HID++ 协议直接与设备通信，支持按键重映射、DPI 调节和 SmartShift 等功能。它无需罗技账号，不收集遥测数据，所有配置以本地 TOML 文件保存，强调隐私和本地优先。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个组件：OpenLogi GUI（GPUI 桌面应用，提供交互式鼠标图示、按键动作选择器、DPI 预设、SmartShift、RGB 键盘灯效、按应用配置文件等）、OpenLogi agent（后台服务，负责输入钩子和设备 I/O）以及相关的文档和配置示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，GUI 基于 GPUI（Zed 编辑器所用的框架），通过 HID++ 协议与罗技设备通信，支持 Logi Bolt、Unifying 接收器、蓝牙直连和 USB 连接。
zh.hot: 作为罗技官方 Options+ 的开源替代品，它解决了用户对官方软件臃肿、遥测和账号要求的痛点，在 Rust 社区和追求隐私的用户中迅速走红，GitHub 星标已超 8600，今日新增 115。
uses: 罗技外设用户：希望摆脱官方 Options+ 的臃肿和遥测，获得本地优先的配置体验
Rust 开发者：对 GPUI 桌面应用开发或 HID++ 协议实现感兴趣的开发者
隐私倡导者：拒绝账号绑定和数据收集，偏好开源软件的用户

en.tag: A native, local-first Logitech Options+ alternative in Rust
en.what: OpenLogi is an open-source Logitech peripheral configuration tool that communicates directly with devices via HID++, supporting button remapping, DPI adjustment, and SmartShift. It requires no Logitech account, collects no telemetry, and stores all configuration in local TOML files, emphasizing privacy and local-first principles.
en.content: The repository contains three components: OpenLogi GUI (a GPUI desktop app with interactive mouse diagram, per-button action picker, DPI presets, SmartShift, RGB keyboard lighting, per-application profiles), OpenLogi agent (background service owning input hook and device I/O), plus documentation and config examples.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, the GUI is built with GPUI (the framework used by Zed editor), communicates with Logitech devices via HID++ protocol, supporting Logi Bolt, Unifying receivers, Bluetooth-direct, and USB connections.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to Logitech's official Options+, it addresses user pain points with bloat, telemetry, and account requirements, quickly gaining popularity in the Rust community and among privacy-conscious users, with over 8.6k stars and 115 added today.
uses: Logitech peripheral users who want a local-first config experience without bloat and telemetry
Rust developers interested in GPUI desktop app development or HID++ protocol implementation
Privacy advocates who reject account requirements and data collection, preferring open-source software

zh.tag: 终端里的轻量 AI 编程代理
zh.what: Codex CLI 是 OpenAI 推出的本地运行编码代理，能在终端中直接执行代码任务。它支持与 ChatGPT 计划集成，也可通过 API 密钥使用，提供命令行交互体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 CLI 工具，提供安装脚本、二进制发布包及文档，支持 npm、Homebrew 等安装方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 OpenAI API 或 ChatGPT 认证，支持跨平台（macOS、Linux、Windows）。
zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方开源项目，今日新增 2729 星，总星数突破 11 万，登顶 GitHub 日榜，开发者期待在终端中直接使用 AI 编程。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中快速执行 AI 辅助编码任务，无需离开命令行环境。
使用 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 等计划的用户，可无缝集成现有订阅进行编程。
需要轻量级、可脚本化的代码生成与修改工具的技术团队。

en.tag: Lightweight AI coding agent that runs in your terminal
en.what: Codex CLI is a coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your computer. It executes coding tasks directly in the terminal, integrates with ChatGPT plans, and can also be used with an API key.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust-based CLI tool, installation scripts, binary release assets, and documentation, with support for npm and Homebrew installation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, it relies on OpenAI API or ChatGPT authentication, and supports cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows).
en.hot: As an official OpenAI open-source project, it gained 2,729 stars today, surpassing 110k total stars and topping the daily GitHub trending list. Developers are eager to use AI coding directly in the terminal.
uses: Developers who want to perform AI-assisted coding tasks quickly in the terminal without leaving the command line.
Users with ChatGPT Plus/Pro plans who can seamlessly integrate their existing subscription for coding.
Tech teams needing a lightweight, scriptable tool for code generation and modification.

zh.tag: 一站式下载器：课程、视频、音乐、书籍，无需命令行
zh.what: OmniGet 是一款免费开源的桌面应用，支持从 Udemy、Hotmart、YouTube 等 1800+ 网站下载课程、视频、音乐和电子书。内置播放器、PDF/EPUB 阅读器和音乐库，所有文件保存在本地，无需命令行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 后端、Svelte/Tauri 前端、桌面安装包及多语言 README。提供图形界面、快捷键下载、内置播放器等功能，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 Tauri 构建，使用 Svelte 作为前端框架，依赖 yt-dlp 进行下载。
zh.hot: 今日新增 102 星，总星数达 9480，在 GitHub Trending 日榜（Rust）排名第 10。其精准的 SEO 标签策略使其在多个下载器细分领域（如课程下载、YouTube 下载）中排名第一，吸引了大量用户。
uses: 在线学习者：需要下载 Udemy、Hotmart 等平台的付费课程以便离线观看。
内容创作者：希望保存 YouTube、TikTok 等平台的视频素材用于二次创作。
音乐与书籍爱好者：想要下载音乐和电子书并在应用内管理阅读。
技术小白：希望无需命令行即可轻松下载网络资源。

en.tag: All-in-one downloader for courses, videos, music & books — no terminal needed
en.what: OmniGet is a free, open-source desktop app that downloads courses, videos, music, and books from 1,800+ sites including Udemy, Hotmart, and YouTube. It features a built-in player, PDF/EPUB reader, and music library, keeping all files on your computer with no terminal required.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust backend, Svelte/Tauri frontend, desktop installers, and multilingual READMEs. It offers a GUI, hotkey downloads, built-in player, and supports Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.stack: Built with Rust and Tauri, using Svelte for the frontend, and powered by yt-dlp for downloads.
en.hot: Gained 102 stars today, reaching 9,480 total, ranking #10 on GitHub Trending (Rust) daily. Its strategic SEO tagging makes it #1 in niche downloader categories (e.g., course-downloader, youtube-downloader), driving significant attention.
uses: Online learners who need to download paid courses from Udemy, Hotmart, etc. for offline viewing.
Content creators who want to save videos from YouTube, TikTok, etc. for remixing or reference.
Music and book enthusiasts who wish to download media and manage them within the app.
Non-technical users who prefer a GUI over command-line tools for downloading online content.

zh.tag: 基于 GPUI 的 Rust 跨平台桌面 UI 组件库
zh.what: GPUI Kit 是一个用于构建高性能跨平台桌面应用的 Rust 框架，提供 60+ 生产级 UI 组件和完整的数据、布局、编辑能力。它基于 Zed 编辑器使用的 GPUI 构建，并支持 JavaScript 扩展。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个子 crate：gpui-base（无样式行为、状态和基础设施）、gpui-shell（JavaScript 扩展）、gpui-component（完整样式化 UI 系统）。主 crate 重新导出所有层，应用只需依赖 gpui-kit 即可。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 GPUI（Zed 编辑器使用的 GPU 加速 UI 框架），支持 macOS、Windows、Linux，集成 Tree-sitter、LSP 等。
zh.hot: 凭借 13.9K stars 和日增 179 登顶 Rust 日榜，因为它是首个将 GPUI 从 Zed 中解耦并打包成通用组件库的项目，填补了 Rust 桌面 UI 生态的空白。
uses: Rust 开发者希望用 Rust 构建跨平台桌面应用，并追求高性能和原生体验。
需要数据表格、虚拟列表、代码编辑器等复杂组件的桌面应用开发场景。
希望复用 Zed 编辑器 UI 能力但不想直接依赖 Zed 的团队。
对 GPUI 感兴趣，想学习其架构或基于 gpui-base 自定义 UI 系统的开发者。

en.tag: Rust desktop UI component library built on GPUI for cross-platform apps
en.what: GPUI Kit is a Rust framework for building high-performance cross-platform desktop apps, offering 60+ production-ready UI components and full data, layout, and editing capabilities. It is built on GPUI, the UI framework used by Zed editor, and supports JavaScript extensions.
en.content: The repo contains three sub-crates: gpui-base (unstyled behavior, state, and infrastructure), gpui-shell (JavaScript extensions), and gpui-component (complete styled UI system). The main crate re-exports all layers, so apps only need to depend on gpui-kit.
en.stack: Built on Rust and GPUI (GPU-accelerated UI framework used by Zed editor), supports macOS, Windows, Linux, integrates Tree-sitter, LSP, etc.
en.hot: With 13.9K stars and +179 today, it tops the Rust daily chart as the first project to decouple GPUI from Zed and package it as a general-purpose component library, filling a gap in the Rust desktop UI ecosystem.
uses: Rust developers who want to build cross-platform desktop apps with high performance and native feel.
Desktop app development requiring complex components like data tables, virtual lists, and code editors.
Teams that want to reuse Zed's UI capabilities without depending on Zed directly.
Developers interested in GPUI, learning its architecture, or building custom UI systems on gpui-base.

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的浏览器自动化 CLI
zh.what: agent-browser 是一个专为 AI 代理设计的浏览器自动化命令行工具，基于原生 Rust 实现，提供快速、可靠的浏览器操作能力。它通过命令行接口实现打开网页、点击、填写表单、截图等操作，并支持可访问性树快照和引用定位，适合 AI 代理进行网页交互。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心二进制、npm/Homebrew/Cargo 安装脚本、从源码构建的 Node.js 和 pnpm 配置，以及自动化安装 Chrome for Testing 的机制。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，通过 npm 包分发，支持从源码构建（需要 Node.js 24+、pnpm 11+），依赖 Chrome for Testing 作为浏览器引擎。
zh.hot: star 数高达 4.2 万，今日新增 62，位列 Rust 日榜第 5，因其为 AI 代理提供轻量级、快速的浏览器自动化方案，契合当前 AI 智能体开发热潮。
uses: AI 代理开发者，需要让代理执行网页操作如点击、填表、截图等。
自动化测试工程师，寻求快速、稳定的浏览器自动化 CLI 工具。
希望用命令行快速控制浏览器的开发者，无需编写复杂脚本。

en.tag: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
en.what: agent-browser is a browser automation CLI designed for AI agents, built with native Rust for speed and reliability. It provides command-line operations like opening pages, clicking, filling forms, and taking screenshots, with accessibility tree snapshots and ref-based targeting, making it suitable for AI agents to interact with web pages.
en.content: The repository includes a native Rust binary, installation scripts for npm/Homebrew/Cargo, Node.js and pnpm build configs for source builds, and mechanisms to automatically install Chrome for Testing.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, distributed via npm package, supports building from source (requires Node.js 24+, pnpm 11+), and relies on Chrome for Testing as the browser engine.
en.hot: With 42k stars and 62 new stars today, ranking #5 on Rust daily trending, it's popular for providing a lightweight, fast browser automation solution for AI agents, aligning with the current AI agent development boom.
uses: AI agent developers needing to perform web actions like clicking, filling forms, and taking screenshots.
Automation test engineers seeking a fast and reliable browser automation CLI.
Developers who want to control a browser quickly via command line without writing complex scripts.

zh.tag: 一站式管理多款 AI 编程助手配置的跨平台桌面工具
zh.what: AI Toolbox 是一个跨平台桌面应用，帮助开发者集中管理 OpenCode、Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编程助手的配置。它提供可视化界面，支持供应商、模型、Prompt、插件、MCP、Skills 等的统一管理，并内置本地代理网关、会话管理、数据备份等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码，基于 Tauri 构建，界面支持中英文，提供系统托盘快速切换、主题切换、自动更新等功能。项目文档包含截图，展示各模块的管理界面。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，基于 Tauri 框架开发，前端可能涉及 Web 技术（如 HTML/CSS/JS）。依赖包括系统托盘、文件同步（WSL/SSH）、WebDAV 等。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编程助手增多，配置管理成为痛点，该工具一站式解决多工具配置混乱问题。今日新增 18 星，总星数 1381，登上 Rust 日榜第 6，说明开发者对此类需求强烈。
uses: 使用多个 AI 编程助手（如 Claude Code、Codex）的开发者，希望统一管理配置和供应商。
需要跨设备同步配置（WSL/SSH）的开发者，简化环境迁移和同步流程。
对 MCP 服务器和 Skills 技能管理有需求的开发者，集中管理工具和扩展。

en.tag: Cross-platform desktop app to manage configs for multiple AI coding assistants
en.what: AI Toolbox is a cross-platform desktop app that helps developers centrally manage configurations for AI coding assistants like OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. It offers a visual interface for unified management of providers, models, prompts, plugins, MCP, Skills, and includes a local proxy gateway, session management, and data backup.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of a desktop app built with Tauri, featuring bilingual UI (Chinese/English), system tray quick switching, theme support, and auto-update. Docs include screenshots of each module.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built on Tauri framework, with frontend likely using web tech (HTML/CSS/JS). Dependencies include system tray, file sync (WSL/SSH), WebDAV, etc.
en.hot: As AI coding assistants multiply, config management becomes a pain point; this tool solves the chaos of multi-tool configs in one place. With +18 stars today (total 1,381) and #6 on Rust daily trending, it clearly addresses a strong developer need.
uses: Developers using multiple AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) who want unified config and provider management.
Developers needing cross-device config sync (WSL/SSH) to simplify environment migration and synchronization.
Developers who need centralized management of MCP servers and Skills for tools and extensions.

zh.tag: 统一指标、日志、追踪的云原生可观测性数据库
zh.what: GreptimeDB 是一个开源的云原生可观测性数据库，使用单一列式引擎统一处理指标、日志和追踪数据。它专为在对象存储上运行而设计，提供高吞吐、低成本的存储方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的数据库实现，包括查询引擎、存储引擎、分布式协调等，并提供 Docker 镜像、Helm 图表和客户端库。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Apache Arrow、DataFusion 和 object store 等生态，支持多种对象存储后端。
zh.hot: 随着可观测性数据量激增，开发者寻求统一且成本效益高的解决方案，GreptimeDB 凭借其创新架构和活跃社区迅速获得关注，star 数已超 6.6k。
uses: 适用于需要统一管理指标、日志和追踪的 DevOps 和 SRE 团队，降低基础设施成本。
适合在云环境中构建可观测性平台，利用对象存储实现弹性扩展和低延迟查询。
对 Rust 和数据库内核感兴趣的开发者可参与贡献，学习分布式系统设计。

en.tag: Unified cloud-native observability database for metrics, logs, and traces
en.what: GreptimeDB is an open-source cloud-native observability database that unifies metrics, logs, and traces in a single columnar engine. It is designed to run on object storage, offering high throughput and low-cost storage.
en.content: The repository contains the full database implementation, including query engine, storage engine, and distributed coordination, along with Docker images, Helm charts, and client libraries.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging Apache Arrow, DataFusion, and object store ecosystem, supporting various object storage backends.
en.hot: With the explosion of observability data, developers seek unified and cost-effective solutions, and GreptimeDB's innovative architecture and active community have driven its popularity, surpassing 6.6k stars.
uses: Ideal for DevOps and SRE teams needing to unify metrics, logs, and traces to reduce infrastructure costs.
Suitable for building observability platforms in the cloud, leveraging object storage for elastic scaling and low-latency queries.
Great for developers interested in Rust and database internals to contribute and learn distributed system design.

zh.tag: AI IDE 多账号管理与配额监控工具
zh.what: Cockpit Tools 是一款通用的 AI IDE 账号管理工具，支持 Antigravity、Codex、GitHub Copilot、Windsurf、Cursor 等主流 AI 编程工具的账号管理。它提供一键切换账号、多账号并行运行、配额监控和自动唤醒等功能，帮助用户高效利用不同账号的资源。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用源码，提供可视化仪表盘、各平台账号管理模块、配额监控界面、唤醒任务设置，以及多语言支持（18 种语言）。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，可能使用 Tauri 或类似框架构建跨平台桌面应用，支持 macOS、Windows、Linux。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编程工具的普及，用户常需管理多个账号以应对配额限制，该工具精准解决了这一痛点。17k+ 星标和今日新增 56 星表明其需求旺盛，在 Rust 趋势榜上位列第 8。
uses: 重度 AI 编程用户，需在多个 IDE 账号间切换以突破配额限制。
团队或开发者，需集中管理多个 AI 账号并监控使用情况。
自动化爱好者，希望利用唤醒任务在配额重置前自动激活模型。

en.tag: Universal AI IDE account manager with multi-account switching and quota monitoring
en.what: Cockpit Tools is a universal AI IDE account manager supporting Antigravity, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Cursor, and more. It offers one-click account switching, multi-account parallel running, quota monitoring, and wake-up automation to help users efficiently utilize resources across different accounts.
en.content: The repository contains the source code for a desktop application with a visual dashboard, account management modules for various platforms, quota monitoring UI, wake-up task settings, and support for 18 languages.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, likely using Tauri or a similar framework to build a cross-platform desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
en.hot: As AI coding tools proliferate, users often need to manage multiple accounts to cope with quota limits, and this tool precisely addresses that pain point. With 17k+ stars and 56 new stars today, it ranks #8 on the Rust trending list, indicating strong demand.
uses: Heavy AI coding users who need to switch between multiple IDE accounts to bypass quota limits.
Teams or developers who need to centrally manage multiple AI accounts and monitor usage.
Automation enthusiasts who want to use wake-up tasks to automatically activate models before quota resets.

zh.tag: Rust 编写的轻量 Bitwarden 服务器，自托管首选
zh.what: Vaultwarden 是 Bitwarden 服务器 API 的非官方替代实现，用 Rust 编写，兼容官方 Bitwarden 客户端。它专为自托管设计，资源占用远低于官方服务，适合不想运行重量级官方服务器的用户。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务器端代码，支持 Docker、Podman 等多种部署方式，提供 Docker Hub、ghcr.io 等镜像。项目包含 Web 界面、API 实现、数据库迁移等模块，并附带详细的部署文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Actix Web 框架、SQLx 数据库工具，支持 SQLite、MySQL、PostgreSQL 等数据库。前端部分使用 Web Vault（官方 Bitwarden 前端）的静态文件。
zh.hot: Vaultwarden 拥有 66.8k stars，持续活跃，今日新增 66 星，位列 Rust 日榜第 13。其轻量、易自托管的特点吸引了大量希望完全掌控密码数据的用户。
uses: 个人用户或小团队希望自托管密码管理器，避免依赖云端服务
企业或组织需要低成本、低资源占用的密码管理解决方案
开发者希望基于 Bitwarden 兼容 API 进行二次开发或集成

en.tag: Lightweight Bitwarden-compatible server in Rust, ideal for self-hosting
en.what: Vaultwarden is an unofficial alternative implementation of the Bitwarden server API, written in Rust and compatible with official Bitwarden clients. It is designed for self-hosting, with much lower resource usage than the official service, ideal for users who prefer a lightweight setup.
en.content: The repository contains the full server-side code, supporting deployment via Docker, Podman, and more, with images on Docker Hub and ghcr.io. It includes a web interface, API implementation, database migrations, and detailed deployment documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, using Actix Web framework and SQLx for database access, supporting SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL. The frontend uses static files from the official Bitwarden Web Vault.
en.hot: With 66.8k stars and steady growth (66 stars today, #13 on Rust daily trending), Vaultwarden's lightweight and self-hosting-friendly nature attracts users who want full control over their password data.
uses: Individuals or small teams who want to self-host a password manager and avoid cloud dependencies
Organizations needing a low-cost, low-resource password management solution
Developers looking to build on a Bitwarden-compatible API for customization or integration

zh.tag: 跨平台声明式 GUI 工具包，支持多语言原生 UI
zh.what: Slint 是一个开源声明式 GUI 工具包，用于构建嵌入式、桌面和移动平台的原生用户界面。开发者使用 .slint 标记语言编写 UI，并将其与 Rust、C++、JavaScript 或 Python 的业务逻辑连接。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Slint 的完整源代码、示例（嵌入式、桌面、移动）、文档、工具集成（如 Figma 插件）以及 Live Preview 编辑器插件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，支持多种后端（如 Qt、Winit），并提供 C++、JavaScript、Python 绑定。
zh.hot: Slint 以轻量级和跨平台著称，在嵌入式 GUI 领域备受关注，star 数已超 2.3 万，今日新增 7 星，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 10。
uses: 嵌入式系统开发者，需要低资源占用的原生 GUI
桌面应用开发者，希望用声明式语言快速构建跨平台 UI
需要与 Rust、C++、Python 或 JS 后端集成的团队
设计师与开发者协作，通过 Figma 插件无缝导入设计

en.tag: Cross-platform declarative GUI toolkit for native UIs in Rust, C++, JS, Python
en.what: Slint is an open-source declarative GUI toolkit for building native user interfaces for embedded systems, desktops, and mobile platforms. Write UI in .slint markup and connect it to business logic in Rust, C++, JavaScript, or Python.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, examples for embedded/desktop/mobile, documentation, tool integrations (e.g., Figma plugin), and Live Preview editor plugins.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, supports multiple backends (e.g., Qt, Winit), and offers bindings for C++, JavaScript, and Python.
en.hot: Slint is known for being lightweight and cross-platform, gaining traction in embedded GUI. With over 23k stars and 7 new today, it ranks #10 on the Rust trending list.
uses: Embedded developers needing low-resource native GUIs
Desktop app developers who want a declarative language for cross-platform UI
Teams integrating with Rust, C++, Python, or JS backends
Designers and developers collaborating via Figma plugin import

zh.tag: 跨平台 iOS 侧载工具，功能丰富，前身 PlumeImpactor
zh.what: Impactor 是一款开源的 iOS/iPadOS/tvOS 侧载应用，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。它允许用户使用 Apple ID 签名并安装应用到 iOS 9.0+ 设备，并支持 SideStore、LiveContainer 等。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Rust 源代码、演示截图、README 文档，以及用于构建和发布的配置。核心功能包括用户友好的 UI、签名和侧载、AppSync 支持、插件注入等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 usbmuxd（Linux）和 iTunes 驱动（Windows）与 Apple 设备通信。
zh.hot: 作为 PlumeImpactor 的继任者，它提供了跨平台支持和丰富的功能，在 Rust 社区中引起关注，今日新增 11 星，总星数达 3150。
uses: iOS 开发者和爱好者，需要侧载应用或测试自己的应用。
希望使用 SideStore 或 LiveContainer 的用户，需要可靠的安装工具。
高级用户，想要注入 tweak 或自定义签名选项。

en.tag: Cross-platform & feature-rich iOS sideloading app, formerly PlumeImpactor
en.what: Impactor is an open-source iOS/iPadOS/tvOS sideloading application supporting macOS, Linux, and Windows. It allows users to sign and install apps on iOS 9.0+ devices using their Apple ID, with support for SideStore and LiveContainer.
en.content: The repository contains full Rust source code, demo screenshots, README documentation, and build/release configurations. Key features include a user-friendly UI, signing and sideloading, AppSync support, and tweak injection.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, it relies on usbmuxd (Linux) and iTunes drivers (Windows) for Apple device communication.
en.hot: As the successor to PlumeImpactor, it offers cross-platform support and rich features, gaining attention in the Rust community with 11 new stars today and 3150 total.
uses: iOS developers and enthusiasts who need to sideload apps or test their own applications.
Users who want to install SideStore or LiveContainer and need a reliable installation tool.
Advanced users who want to inject tweaks or customize signing options.

zh.tag: 光速开发的多人在线游戏与实时应用后端数据库
zh.what: SpacetimeDB 是一个将数据库与服务器逻辑合二为一的实时平台，开发者直接用 Rust 或 C# 编写存储过程，由数据库自动执行并同步状态到客户端。它消除了传统后端架构中数据库与应用服务器之间的网络延迟，让多人游戏和实时应用开发变得极其简单高效。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 SpacetimeDB 核心引擎（Rust 实现）、模块 SDK（支持 Rust、C#/Unity、TypeScript）、CLI 工具、文档与示例，以及用于部署的 Docker 镜像和云服务配置。
zh.stack: 核心用 Rust 编写，模块支持 Rust、C#（.NET/Unity）和 TypeScript，依赖包括 Wasmtime（WebAssembly 运行时）、RocksDB 等存储引擎，并提供多种语言的客户端库。
zh.hot: 25k+ 星标说明它精准切中实时应用开发痛点——将数据库与服务器逻辑合并，大幅降低架构复杂度与延迟，尤其吸引游戏开发者与实时应用团队，日榜第 12 名仍保持热度。
uses: 多人游戏开发者：快速构建实时同步的游戏后端，无需自建服务器与网络层
实时协作应用团队：用于聊天、白板、直播互动等需要低延迟状态同步的场景
全栈开发者：用 Rust 或 C# 直接编写后端逻辑，简化部署与运维
对 WebAssembly 感兴趣的工程师：学习如何用 Wasm 扩展数据库能力

en.tag: A database for real-time apps and games at the speed of light
en.what: SpacetimeDB is a unified database and server platform that lets developers write stored procedures in Rust or C#, which the database executes automatically and syncs state to clients. It eliminates network latency between database and app server, making multiplayer and real-time development incredibly simple and fast.
en.content: The repo contains the core engine (Rust), module SDKs for Rust, C#/Unity, and TypeScript, CLI tools, docs and examples, plus Docker images and cloud deployment configs.
en.stack: Core is written in Rust; modules support Rust, C# (.NET/Unity), and TypeScript. Dependencies include Wasmtime for WebAssembly, RocksDB for storage, and client libraries for multiple languages.
en.hot: With 25k+ stars, it hits a real pain point—merging database and server logic to cut complexity and latency, especially appealing to game devs and real-time teams; still trending at #12 on the daily Rust list.
uses: Multiplayer game developers: quickly build real-time backends without managing servers or networking
Real-time collaboration teams: for chat, whiteboards, live interactions needing low-latency state sync
Full-stack developers: write backend logic directly in Rust or C#, simplifying deployment and ops
Engineers interested in WebAssembly: learn how to extend database capabilities with Wasm

zh.tag: 数据中心级分布式推理服务编排层
zh.what: Dynamo 是一个开源的数据中心级推理服务框架，作为推理引擎（如 SGLang、TensorRT-LLM、vLLM）之上的编排层，将它们整合为协调的多节点推理系统。它通过分离式服务、智能路由、多级 KV 缓存和自动扩展，最大化吞吐量并最小化延迟，适用于 LLM、推理、多模态和视频生成等负载。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心、Python 扩展、文档、示例、recipes 和容器镜像，并提供设计提案和社区贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 实现高性能，Python 提供可扩展性；依赖推理引擎如 SGLang、TensorRT-LLM 和 vLLM。
zh.hot: 本月新增 285 星，总星数 7813，登上 GitHub Trending（Rust）月榜第 20 名。作为 NVIDIA 支持的开源项目，它填补了推理引擎之上的编排层空白，吸引大量关注。
uses: AI 基础设施团队：构建大规模多节点推理服务，优化 GPU 利用率和成本。
模型部署工程师：需要为 LLM、多模态或视频生成模型设计高吞吐、低延迟的服务架构。
平台开发者：希望扩展或定制推理编排逻辑，利用 Rust 和 Python 的混合开发。
研究与实验：在数据中心规模下测试分离式推理、KV 缓存等先进技术。

en.tag: Datacenter-scale distributed inference serving orchestration layer
en.what: Dynamo is an open-source, datacenter-scale inference serving framework that acts as an orchestration layer above inference engines like SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and vLLM, turning them into a coordinated multi-node inference system. It uses disaggregated serving, intelligent routing, multi-tier KV caching, and automatic scaling to maximize throughput and minimize latency for LLM, reasoning, multimodal, and video generation workloads.
en.content: The repository includes a Rust core, Python extensions, documentation, examples, recipes, and container images, along with design proposals and community contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Built in Rust for performance and Python for extensibility; relies on inference engines like SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and vLLM.
en.hot: With 285 stars added this month and 7,813 total, it ranks #20 on GitHub Trending (Rust) monthly. As an NVIDIA-backed open-source project, it fills the orchestration gap above inference engines, drawing significant attention.
uses: AI infrastructure teams: building large-scale multi-node inference services to optimize GPU utilization and cost.
Model deployment engineers: designing high-throughput, low-latency serving architectures for LLMs, multimodal, or video generation models.
Platform developers: extending or customizing inference orchestration logic with Rust and Python.
Research and experimentation: testing advanced techniques like disaggregated serving and KV caching at datacenter scale.

zh.tag: 零信任零延迟的 AI 代理安全沙箱
zh.what: nono 是一个为 AI 代理提供安全、多路复用执行路径的沙箱工具，强调零信任、零设置和零延迟。它允许开发者以最小权限运行 Claude Code、Codex 等代理，无需守护进程、容器或虚拟机，并支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows (WSL2)。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心沙箱引擎、命令行工具、配置示例、文档站点，以及用于扩展的注册表（registry）和 GitHub Action（agent-sign）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖系统级安全机制（如 seccomp、landlock）实现沙箱隔离，支持跨平台。
zh.hot: 由 Sigstore 团队打造，解决了 AI 代理运行时的安全痛点，以零配置和零延迟的沙箱方案吸引开发者，当前在 GitHub 日榜（Rust）排名第 14，star 数接近 4000。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要安全隔离运行 Claude Code、Codex 等代理，防止越权访问系统资源。
DevOps 与安全团队：希望在不引入容器或虚拟机的情况下，为生产环境中的代理提供最小权限沙箱。
开源社区贡献者：可以 fork 配置、定制主题，并通过 nono registry 分享给团队或社区。

en.tag: Zero-trust, zero-latency secure sandbox for AI agents
en.what: nono is a sandbox tool that provides secure, multiplexed execution paths for AI agents, emphasizing zero trust, zero setup, and zero latency. It allows developers to run agents like Claude Code and Codex with least privilege, without daemons, containers, or VMs, supporting macOS, Linux, and Windows (WSL2).
en.content: The repository contains a Rust-based core sandbox engine, CLI tools, configuration examples, documentation site, and a registry for sharing configs, plus a GitHub Action (agent-sign).
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging OS-level security mechanisms like seccomp and landlock for sandboxing, with cross-platform support.
en.hot: Built by the Sigstore team, it addresses the security pain point of running AI agents with a zero-config, zero-latency sandbox, attracting developers; it ranks #14 on GitHub Trending (Rust) with nearly 4k stars.
uses: AI agent developers: need to run agents like Claude Code and Codex in a secure sandbox to prevent unauthorized access to system resources.
DevOps and security teams: want to provide least-privilege sandboxes for agents in production without introducing containers or VMs.
Open source contributors: can fork configs, customize themes, and share them via the nono registry with teams or the community.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 编写的极速 Python 代码检查与格式化工具
zh.what: Ruff 是一个用 Rust 编写的 Python 代码检查器（linter）和格式化器（formatter），旨在替代 Flake8、Black、isort 等多个工具。它比现有工具快 10 到 100 倍，并内置缓存、自动修复和超过 900 条规则。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档、基准测试和配置示例。核心是一个高性能的 CLI 工具，支持 pyproject.toml 配置，并提供编辑器集成（如 VS Code）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 PyPI 分发，支持 Python 3.14 及更早版本。
zh.hot: 凭借极致的性能（比现有工具快 10-100 倍）和一体化设计，Ruff 在开发者中广受欢迎，star 数接近 5 万，今日新增 20，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 15 名。
uses: Python 开发者：希望用单一工具替代多个 lint/format 工具，提升开发效率。
大型项目维护者：需要快速检查大量代码，且支持 monorepo 分层配置。
CI/CD 集成：在持续集成中快速运行 lint 和格式化检查，减少等待时间。

en.tag: An extremely fast Python linter and code formatter, written in Rust.
en.what: Ruff is a Python linter and formatter written in Rust, designed to replace tools like Flake8, Black, and isort. It is 10-100x faster than existing tools, with built-in caching, auto-fix, and over 900 rules.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation, benchmarks, and configuration examples. The core is a high-performance CLI tool with pyproject.toml support and editor integrations (e.g., VS Code).
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, distributed via PyPI, supporting Python 3.14 and earlier.
en.hot: With its extreme speed (10-100x faster than existing tools) and all-in-one design, Ruff has gained massive popularity, nearing 50k stars, with 20 new stars today, ranking #15 on the Rust trending list.
uses: Python developers: want to replace multiple lint/format tools with one, improving efficiency.
Large project maintainers: need fast checking of large codebases with monorepo-friendly config.
CI/CD integration: run lint and format checks quickly in pipelines to reduce wait time.

zh.tag: 隐私优先的跨平台文本扩展工具
zh.what: Espanso 是一款用 Rust 编写的跨平台文本扩展器，当用户输入特定关键词时，它会自动替换为预设的文本、图片、脚本等内容。它注重隐私，所有处理都在本地完成，不进行任何跟踪。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Espanso 的源代码、文档、示例配置和构建脚本。主要目录包括 src（Rust 源码）、docs（官方文档）、images（示例图片）等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖包括 wry（用于系统托盘）、notify（文件监控）等。支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。
zh.hot: Espanso 拥有 14k+ 星标，因其强大的功能和隐私保护特性受到用户青睐。它支持几乎所有程序，并提供丰富的扩展能力，如自定义脚本、表单和包管理器。
uses: 提高打字效率，快速插入常用短语或代码片段
创建系统级的自定义快捷键，执行脚本或命令
在支持文本输入的任何应用中实现个性化自动更正

en.tag: Privacy-first, cross-platform text expander written in Rust
en.what: Espanso is a cross-platform text expander written in Rust that detects when you type specific keywords and replaces them with something else, such as text, images, or scripts. It is privacy-first, with all processing done locally and no tracking.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, example configurations, and build scripts for Espanso. Key directories include src (Rust source), docs (official documentation), and images (example images).
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, with dependencies such as wry for system tray and notify for file watching. Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: Espanso has over 14k stars, popular for its powerful features and privacy protection. It works with almost any program and offers extensive extensibility, including custom scripts, forms, and a package manager.
uses: Boost typing efficiency by quickly inserting common phrases or code snippets
Create system-wide shortcuts to execute scripts or commands
Implement personalized autocorrect in any app that accepts text input

zh.tag: GitHub 官方 MCP 服务器，让 AI 直接操作仓库与工作流
zh.what: GitHub MCP Server 是 GitHub 官方的模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器，允许 AI 代理、助手和聊天机器人通过自然语言直接与 GitHub 平台交互。它支持读取仓库和代码文件、管理 issue 和 PR、分析代码以及自动化工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 MCP 服务器实现，提供远程托管版本和本地运行版本，并附带详细的文档、配置示例和策略治理指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，基于 MCP 协议，支持多种 MCP 宿主（如 VS Code、Claude Desktop、Cursor 等）。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub 官方项目，它迅速获得 3.2 万+ Star，本月新增 854，跻身 Go 趋势榜前十，反映了 AI 编程助手与 GitHub 深度集成的强烈需求。
uses: 开发者希望让 AI 助手直接管理仓库、issue 和 PR，提升日常开发效率。
团队利用 AI 自动化 CI/CD 流程，监控构建失败并分析代码质量。
AI 工具开发者需要将 GitHub 功能集成到自定义代理或聊天机器人中。

en.tag: GitHub's official MCP server connecting AI to repositories and workflows
en.what: The GitHub MCP Server is GitHub's official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables AI agents, assistants, and chatbots to interact directly with the GitHub platform through natural language. It supports reading repositories and code files, managing issues and PRs, analyzing code, and automating workflows.
en.content: The repository contains a Go implementation of the MCP server, offering both a remote hosted version and a local version, along with comprehensive documentation, configuration examples, and policy governance guides.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, built on the MCP protocol, and compatible with various MCP hosts such as VS Code, Claude Desktop, and Cursor.
en.hot: As an official GitHub project, it quickly amassed over 32k stars, with 854 new stars this month, ranking in the top 10 Go trending repos, reflecting the strong demand for deep AI coding assistant integration with GitHub.
uses: Developers who want AI assistants to directly manage repositories, issues, and PRs to boost daily productivity.
Teams leveraging AI to automate CI/CD pipelines, monitor build failures, and analyze code quality.
AI tool builders integrating GitHub capabilities into custom agents or chatbots.

zh.tag: 一键本地运行开源大模型的跨平台工具
zh.what: Ollama 是一个让用户轻松在本地运行和管理开源大模型的工具，支持 Kimi、GLM、DeepSeek、Qwen、Gemma 等众多模型。它提供命令行界面、REST API 和多种编程语言库，方便集成到现有应用或作为 AI 助手使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Ollama 的完整源代码，包括安装脚本、命令行工具、REST API 服务器、模型管理功能，以及 Python 和 JavaScript 客户端库的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，底层依赖 llama.cpp 等推理后端，支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 和 Docker。
zh.hot: Ollama 已获得 18 万星标，本月新增近 3000，因其让本地运行大模型变得极其简单，成为开发者和 AI 爱好者的首选工具。
uses: 开发者希望在本地快速测试或运行开源模型，无需复杂配置
需要将大模型集成到自己的应用或代理中的团队
关注隐私，希望数据不出本机的个人用户

en.tag: Run open-source LLMs locally with one command
en.what: Ollama is a tool that lets users easily run and manage open-source LLMs locally, supporting models like Kimi, GLM, DeepSeek, Qwen, Gemma, and more. It provides a CLI, REST API, and libraries for multiple languages, making it easy to integrate into existing apps or use as an AI assistant.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Ollama, including installation scripts, CLI tools, REST API server, model management features, and documentation/examples for Python and JavaScript client libraries.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging inference backends like llama.cpp, supporting macOS, Windows, Linux, and Docker.
en.hot: With 180k stars and nearly 3k added this month, Ollama is the go-to tool for developers and AI enthusiasts due to its simplicity in running LLMs locally.
uses: Developers who want to quickly test or run open-source models locally without complex setup
Teams needing to integrate LLMs into their applications or agents
Privacy-conscious users who prefer to keep data on their own machines

zh.tag: 订阅转 API 的一站式网关，支持拼车共享
zh.what: Sub2API 是一个开源 AI API 网关平台，用于将 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini、Grok 等订阅配额统一转换为 API 接口，支持拼车共享以分摊成本，并允许原生工具无缝使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 后端、Vue 3 前端、PostgreSQL 数据库、Redis 缓存，并提供 Docker 部署支持。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 Go 1.27、Vue 3.4+、PostgreSQL 15+、Redis 7+，支持 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: Star 数突破 4 万，今日新增 130，登上 GitHub 趋势榜（Go）第 7 名，因其解决了订阅共享和 API 接入的痛点，受到开发者追捧。
uses: 希望将 AI 订阅配额共享给团队或朋友，降低使用成本的个人或组织。
需要统一管理多个 AI 服务 API 的开发者，实现无缝集成到现有工具。
对 AI 网关技术感兴趣，希望学习或二次开发的学习者和开发者。

en.tag: One-stop gateway converting AI subscriptions to unified APIs, supporting carpool sharing
en.what: Sub2API is an open-source AI API gateway platform that converts subscription quotas from Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, etc., into unified APIs, supporting carpooling to share costs and enabling seamless use with native tools.
en.content: The repository contains a Go backend, Vue 3 frontend, PostgreSQL database, Redis cache, and Docker deployment support.
en.stack: Tech stack includes Go 1.27, Vue 3.4+, PostgreSQL 15+, Redis 7+, with Docker support.
en.hot: With over 40k stars and 130 new stars today, it ranks 7th on GitHub Trending (Go), gaining popularity for addressing subscription sharing and API integration pain points.
uses: Individuals or organizations wanting to share AI subscription quotas with teams or friends to reduce costs.
Developers needing unified management of multiple AI service APIs for seamless integration into existing tools.
Learners and developers interested in AI gateway technology for study or further development.

zh.tag: 基于 WireGuard 的安全组网与访问控制平台

zh.tag: 让 AI 编程代理用原始人语言省 65% token 的 Claude Code 技能

Enthusiasts interested in prompt engineering and how language style optimization compresses tokens

zh.tag: 云存储的 rsync：命令行同步与加密工具

System administrators automating server backups to object storage like S3 or B2.
