zh.tag: 为编码代理提供持久化、结构化记忆的分布式图式问题追踪器
zh.what: Beads 是一个命令行工具，为 AI 编码代理提供持久化、结构化的记忆。它用依赖感知的图结构取代杂乱的 markdown 计划，使代理能够处理长期任务而不丢失上下文。它支持多代理协作，通过 Dolt 实现分布式同步。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 工具（bd），提供初始化、任务创建/认领/关闭等命令，以及针对 Codex、Claude Code 等代理的集成设置脚本。文档涵盖快速入门、代理设置和 IDE 集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，依赖 Dolt（分布式 SQL 数据库）实现图存储和同步。提供 npm 和 PyPI 包，支持 MCP 集成。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编程代理的普及，开发者需要更可靠的记忆机制。Beads 以 2.69 万星标迅速走红，今日新增 43 星，登上 Go 语言日榜，解决了代理丢失上下文的痛点。
uses: 使用 Codex、Claude Code 等 AI 编程代理的开发者，希望提升代理在复杂项目中的任务执行能力。
需要多代理协作或跨机器同步任务状态的团队，利用分布式图追踪问题。
对 AI 代理工作流感兴趣的技术爱好者，想探索结构化记忆和依赖图管理。

en.tag: Distributed graph issue tracker giving coding agents persistent, structured memory
en.what: Beads is a CLI tool that provides persistent, structured memory for AI coding agents. It replaces messy markdown plans with a dependency-aware graph, enabling agents to handle long-horizon tasks without losing context. It supports multi-agent collaboration with distributed sync via Dolt.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based CLI tool (bd) with commands for init, task creation/claim/close, and setup scripts for agents like Codex and Claude Code. Docs cover quickstart, agent setup, and IDE integrations.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging Dolt (distributed SQL database) for graph storage and sync. Offers npm and PyPI packages, with MCP support.
en.hot: With the rise of AI coding agents, developers need more reliable memory mechanisms. Beads quickly gained 26.9k stars, adding 43 today, and hit the Go daily trending list by solving the pain point of agents losing context.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents like Codex and Claude Code who want to improve agent performance on complex tasks.
Teams needing multi-agent collaboration or cross-machine task sync, using distributed graph issue tracking.
Tech enthusiasts interested in AI agent workflows, exploring structured memory and dependency graph management.

zh.tag: 多协议代理服务管理面板，支持 Xray 全系协议
zh.what: 3X-UI 是一个开源的 Xray-core 服务器管理面板，提供简洁的多语言 Web 界面，用于部署、配置和监控多种代理和 VPN 协议。它是 X-UI 项目的增强分支，支持更广泛的协议和更稳定的性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Web 面板源码，支持多协议入站（VLESS、VMess、Trojan 等），提供流量统计、客户端管理、订阅链接等功能，并附带多语言文档和安装脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，基于 Xray-core，前端可能使用 Vue 或类似框架，依赖 SQLite 等数据库存储配置。
zh.hot: 拥有 45.9k 星标，因其功能全面、支持协议众多且持续更新而广受欢迎，是自建代理服务的热门选择。
uses: 适合个人或小团队在 VPS 上快速搭建和管理多协议代理服务，尤其需要图形化界面和流量统计的用户。
适用于需要同时支持多种协议（如 VLESS、Trojan、WireGuard）并提供客户端订阅链接的场景。
适合希望基于 Xray 进行二次开发或学习代理面板实现的技术爱好者。

en.tag: Multi-protocol proxy management panel for Xray-core with rich features
en.what: 3X-UI is an open-source web control panel for managing Xray-core servers, offering a clean multi-language interface for deploying, configuring, and monitoring various proxy and VPN protocols. It is an enhanced fork of X-UI with broader protocol support and improved stability.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the web panel, supporting multi-protocol inbounds (VLESS, VMess, Trojan, etc.), with traffic statistics, client management, subscription links, and multi-language documentation and installation scripts.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, built on Xray-core, with a frontend likely using Vue or similar framework, and using SQLite or similar database for configuration storage.
en.hot: With 45.9k stars, it is popular for its comprehensive features, extensive protocol support, and active maintenance, making it a go-to choice for self-hosted proxy services.
uses: Ideal for individuals or small teams to quickly deploy and manage multi-protocol proxy services on a VPS, especially those needing a GUI and traffic statistics.
Suitable for scenarios requiring simultaneous support for multiple protocols (e.g., VLESS, Trojan, WireGuard) and providing client subscription links.
Great for tech enthusiasts who want to extend Xray-based development or learn how proxy panels are implemented.

zh.tag: 终极摄像头流媒体应用，支持数十种格式与协议
zh.what: go2rtc 是一个零依赖的摄像头流媒体应用，支持数十种格式与协议，提供极低延迟的流媒体传输。它可以将来自不同来源的视频流进行转码、混合，并输出到各种平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心二进制、Docker 镜像、Home Assistant 插件，以及用于 Web 界面的静态文件。支持多种输入输出协议，内置 FFmpeg 转码，并提供 JavaScript API 用于集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 Pion WebRTC 库，可选集成 FFmpeg 进行转码。支持跨平台（Windows、macOS、Linux、FreeBSD）。
zh.hot: 作为摄像头流媒体工具，它解决了智能家居和监控场景中的兼容性问题，拥有 14k+ 星标，今日新增 17，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: 智能家居用户，用于将摄像头流接入 Home Assistant 等平台
开发者，需要集成多协议视频流到自己的应用中
监控系统部署者，需要低延迟、多格式的流媒体服务

en.tag: Ultimate camera streaming app supporting dozens of formats and protocols
en.what: go2rtc is a zero-dependency camera streaming application supporting dozens of formats and protocols with minimal latency. It can transcode, mix, and output streams from various sources to multiple platforms.
en.content: The repository contains a Go binary, Docker images, Home Assistant add-on, and static files for a web UI. It supports various input/output protocols, built-in FFmpeg transcoding, and a JavaScript API for integration.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging the Pion WebRTC library, with optional FFmpeg integration for transcoding. Cross-platform support for Windows, macOS, Linux, and FreeBSD.
en.hot: As a camera streaming tool, it solves compatibility issues in smart home and surveillance scenarios, with 14k+ stars and 17 new stars today, maintaining developer interest.
uses: Smart home users integrating camera streams into platforms like Home Assistant
Developers needing to integrate multi-protocol video streams into their applications
Surveillance system deployers requiring low-latency, multi-format streaming services

zh.tag: Go 编写的插件化 DNS 服务器，灵活可扩展
zh.what: CoreDNS 是一个用 Go 编写的 DNS 服务器/转发器，通过插件链实现各种 DNS 功能。它支持多种协议（UDP/TCP、DoT、DoH、DoH3、DoQ、gRPC），并能从文件、etcd、Kubernetes 等后端加载数据。作为 CNCF 毕业项目，它广泛用于 Kubernetes 集群的服务发现。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CoreDNS 的完整源码、插件实现（如 cache、kubernetes、forward 等）、构建配置和文档。插件机制允许用户通过配置文件组合功能，并支持编写自定义插件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖多个 Go 库，如 grpc、quic-go 等。支持通过 Docker 部署，并提供 Prometheus 指标接口。
zh.hot: 尽管今日新增 star 不多（3 个），但总星数达 14293，说明其长期稳定的受欢迎程度。作为 Kubernetes 默认 DNS 组件，它持续获得关注。
uses: Kubernetes 集群管理员：作为集群 DNS 服务，实现服务发现和负载均衡。
开发运维人员：需要灵活、可编程的 DNS 服务器，用于内部网络或边缘场景。
云原生开发者：希望扩展 DNS 功能，编写自定义插件以满足特定需求。

en.tag: A flexible, extensible DNS server written in Go, chaining plugins
en.what: CoreDNS is a DNS server/forwarder written in Go that chains plugins to perform DNS functions. It supports multiple protocols (UDP/TCP, DoT, DoH, DoH3, DoQ, gRPC) and can serve data from files, etcd, Kubernetes, and more. As a CNCF graduated project, it's widely used for service discovery in Kubernetes clusters.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of CoreDNS, plugin implementations (e.g., cache, kubernetes, forward), build configurations, and documentation. The plugin mechanism allows users to combine features via config files and supports writing custom plugins.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on libraries like grpc and quic-go. Supports Docker deployment and exposes Prometheus metrics.
en.hot: Despite modest daily star gain (3), its total 14293 stars reflect long-term popularity. As the default DNS component in Kubernetes, it consistently attracts attention.
uses: Kubernetes cluster admins: use as cluster DNS for service discovery and load balancing.
DevOps engineers: need a flexible, programmable DNS server for internal or edge networks.
Cloud-native developers: extend DNS functionality by writing custom plugins for specific needs.

zh.tag: 开源 AI 网关，一个 SDK 接入 100+ 模型
zh.what: AxonHub 是一个开源的 AI 网关，允许开发者使用任意 SDK 调用 100 多种大语言模型，无需修改代码。它内置了故障转移、负载均衡、成本控制和端到端追踪功能，旨在简化 AI 应用的开发和部署。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心网关服务、Docker 部署配置、多语言 README（中英日）以及赞助商信息。项目结构清晰，提供测试和 lint 工作流，确保代码质量。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，支持 Docker 部署，并集成 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。依赖常见 AI 模型 API，提供统一接口。
zh.hot: 5k+ stars 说明开发者对统一 AI 接入层需求强烈。它解决了多模型切换和故障转移的痛点，且零代码改动，在 Go 社区日榜位列第 18 名。
uses: 后端开发者：需要快速集成多个 LLM 提供商，避免供应商锁定。
平台团队：希望统一管理 API 密钥、成本与流量，实现高可用。
AI 应用创业者：想用最少代码构建多模型 AI 产品，快速迭代。

en.tag: Open-source AI gateway: one SDK, 100+ LLMs, failover & tracing
en.what: AxonHub is an open-source AI gateway that lets developers call 100+ LLMs with any SDK without code changes. It includes built-in failover, load balancing, cost control, and end-to-end tracing to streamline AI app development and deployment.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based core gateway service, Docker deployment configs, multilingual READMEs (EN/ZH/JA), and sponsor info. It has clear structure with CI workflows for testing and linting.
en.stack: Built primarily in Go, with Docker support and GitHub Actions for CI. It integrates with various LLM APIs behind a unified interface.
en.hot: 5k+ stars show strong demand for a unified AI access layer. It solves multi-model switching and failover pain points with zero code changes, ranking #18 on Go daily trending.
uses: Backend developers: quickly integrate multiple LLM providers and avoid vendor lock-in.
Platform teams: centrally manage API keys, costs, and traffic for high availability.
AI startup founders: build multi-model AI products with minimal code and fast iteration.

zh.tag: Kubernetes 原生 AI 代理框架
zh.what: kagent 是一个 Kubernetes 原生框架，用于构建、部署和管理 AI 代理。它利用 Kubernetes 作为编排平台，简化了代理的创建和运维。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心框架代码、示例代理、UI 演示（GIF）以及文档目录，提供快速入门和安装指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes API，支持 OpenSSF 最佳实践，提供 Codespaces 开发环境。
zh.hot: 结合 Kubernetes 与 AI 代理是热门趋势，该项目提供原生集成方案，虽今日新增星数不多，但已积累 3657 星，受到开发者关注。
uses: 适合希望在 Kubernetes 上部署和管理 AI 代理的云原生开发者
适用于需要将代理与现有 Kubernetes 工作流集成的团队
适合对代理框架感兴趣并希望快速上手的开发者

en.tag: Kubernetes-native framework for building AI agents
en.what: kagent is a Kubernetes-native framework for building, deploying, and managing AI agents. It leverages Kubernetes as the orchestration platform to simplify agent creation and operations.
en.content: The repository contains core framework code, example agents, UI demo (GIF), and documentation sections with quickstart and installation guides.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relies on Kubernetes APIs, follows OpenSSF best practices, and offers Codespaces development environment.
en.hot: Combining Kubernetes with AI agents is a hot trend, and this project offers a native integration. Despite modest daily stars, it has accumulated 3657 stars, gaining developer attention.
uses: For cloud-native developers who want to deploy and manage AI agents on Kubernetes
For teams needing to integrate agents with existing Kubernetes workflows
For developers interested in agent frameworks and wanting a quick start

zh.tag: 自托管聚合仪表盘，把订阅源集中一处
zh.what: Glance 是一个轻量级、高度可定制的自托管仪表盘，用于集中展示 RSS、Reddit、Hacker News、天气、YouTube 等订阅源。它通过美观简洁的界面，让用户在一个页面中快速浏览所有信息流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心服务、YAML 配置文件示例、文档（配置、主题、预配置页面）、社区组件目录以及 Docker 部署支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖少量 JavaScript（原生），生成单一可执行文件（<20MB），支持多平台和 Docker 容器。
zh.hot: 凭借极低的资源占用、丰富的组件生态和高度可定制性，Glance 在自托管社区广受欢迎，目前已收获 36,682 颗星，今日新增 22 颗。
uses: 自托管爱好者：搭建个人信息中心，整合 RSS、新闻、天气等订阅源。
开发者和技术爱好者：监控 GitHub、Hacker News、Reddit 等技术社区动态。
追求效率的用户：通过自定义布局和主题，打造专属的极简仪表盘。

en.tag: Self-hosted dashboard aggregating all your feeds in one place
en.what: Glance is a lightweight, highly customizable self-hosted dashboard that aggregates feeds like RSS, Reddit, Hacker News, weather, YouTube, and more. It presents all your information streams in a beautiful, streamlined interface for quick browsing.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based core service, YAML configuration examples, documentation (configuration, themes, preconfigured pages), community widgets directory, and Docker deployment support.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, with minimal vanilla JavaScript, producing a single binary under 20MB for multiple OS/architectures, and a small Docker container.
en.hot: With its low resource usage, extensive widget ecosystem, and high customizability, Glance has gained popularity in the self-hosting community, amassing 36,682 stars with 22 added today.
uses: Self-hosting enthusiasts: build a personal dashboard to aggregate RSS, news, weather, and more.
Developers and tech enthusiasts: monitor GitHub, Hacker News, Reddit, and other tech communities.
Productivity-focused users: create a minimal, personalized dashboard with custom layouts and themes.

zh.tag: 基于 HTTP 的快速 TCP/UDP 隧道工具
zh.what: Chisel 是一个用 Go 编写的快速 TCP/UDP 隧道工具，通过 HTTP 传输，并使用 SSH 加密。它主要用于穿透防火墙，也可为网络提供安全端点。
zh.content: 仓库包含 chisel 的完整源代码，包括客户端和服务器端，可编译为单个可执行文件。还包含文档、测试和基准测试。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 crypto/ssh 实现 SSH 加密，使用 jpillora/backoff 实现指数退避重连。
zh.hot: Chisel 因其简单易用和强大的穿透能力而广受欢迎，在 GitHub 上拥有超过 16k 星标，并持续出现在趋势榜中。
uses: 需要穿透防火墙访问内网服务的开发者和运维人员。
希望快速建立安全隧道以进行远程调试或访问受限网络。
用于反向代理或 SOCKS5 代理场景，实现灵活的网络访问。

en.tag: Fast TCP/UDP tunnel over HTTP, secured via SSH
en.what: Chisel is a fast TCP/UDP tunnel tool written in Go, transported over HTTP and secured via SSH. It is mainly useful for passing through firewalls, and can also provide a secure endpoint into your network.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code for chisel, including both client and server, which compiles into a single executable. It also includes documentation, tests, and benchmarks.
en.stack: Developed in Go, using crypto/ssh for SSH encryption and jpillora/backoff for exponential backoff reconnection.
en.hot: Chisel is popular for its ease of use and powerful tunneling capabilities, with over 16k stars on GitHub and consistent presence on trending lists.
uses: Developers and operators who need to access internal services through firewalls.
Those who want to quickly establish secure tunnels for remote debugging or accessing restricted networks.
For reverse proxy or SOCKS5 proxy scenarios to enable flexible network access.

zh.tag: 自托管多云盘与文件分享系统
zh.what: Cloudreve 是一个自托管的文件管理和分享系统，支持将文件存储到本地或多种云存储服务。它提供 WebDAV、在线预览、离线下载等功能，适合个人或团队搭建私有云盘。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务，提供完整的 Web 界面和 API，支持多用户、多存储策略、分享链接、在线编辑等功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，前端基于 Vue.js（分离仓库），支持 SQLite/MySQL 等数据库，可部署于 Docker 或裸机。
zh.hot: 拥有 28.6k star，因其功能全面且易于自部署，满足用户对数据隐私和云盘定制的需求，长期活跃于 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: 个人用户搭建私有云盘，替代公有云服务，保护数据隐私。
团队或企业用于内部文件共享与协作，支持多用户和权限管理。
开发者学习 Go 语言和 Web 应用开发，参考其架构和功能实现。

en.tag: Self-hosted multi-cloud file management and sharing platform
en.what: Cloudreve is a self-hosted file management and sharing system that supports storing files locally or on multiple cloud storage providers. It offers WebDAV, online preview, offline download, and more, suitable for individuals or teams to build private cloud drives.
en.content: The repository contains a Go backend service with a complete web UI and API, supporting multi-user, multiple storage policies, share links, online editing, and more.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, frontend based on Vue.js (separate repo), supports SQLite/MySQL databases, deployable via Docker or bare metal.
en.hot: With 28.6k stars, it's popular for its comprehensive features and easy self-deployment, addressing users' needs for data privacy and cloud drive customization, consistently trending on GitHub.
uses: Individuals building private cloud drives to replace public cloud services and protect data privacy.
Teams or enterprises for internal file sharing and collaboration, with multi-user and permission management.
Developers learning Go and web app development, referencing its architecture and feature implementations.

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 的 JSON 解析与序列化库
zh.what: 这是一个为现代 C++ 设计的 JSON 库，提供直观的 API，支持 JSON 的解析、序列化以及与 STL 容器的无缝集成。它旨在让 C++ 开发者能够像使用 Python 或 JavaScript 一样轻松地处理 JSON 数据。
zh.content: 仓库包含单一头文件 json.hpp，以及完整的文档、测试套件和示例代码。支持多种平台和编译器，并提供了在线演示和详细的 API 参考。
zh.stack: 纯 C++11 及以上实现，无外部依赖，使用 CMake 构建，支持跨平台（Windows、Linux、macOS）。
zh.hot: 因其易用性和高性能而广受欢迎，拥有超过 5 万 star，是 C++ 社区最常用的 JSON 库之一。今日新增 16 星，持续活跃。
uses: C++ 开发者需要在项目中快速集成 JSON 解析和生成功能
需要跨平台且无依赖的 JSON 库的嵌入式或桌面应用开发
希望简化 JSON 数据处理流程的软件工程师

en.tag: JSON parser and serializer for modern C++
en.what: A JSON library for modern C++ that provides an intuitive API for parsing, serializing, and integrating with STL containers. It aims to make JSON handling in C++ as easy as in Python or JavaScript.
en.content: The repository contains a single header file json.hpp, along with comprehensive documentation, test suites, and examples. It supports multiple platforms and compilers, offering an online demo and detailed API reference.
en.stack: Implemented in pure C++11 or later with no external dependencies, built with CMake, and cross-platform (Windows, Linux, macOS).
en.hot: Popular for its ease of use and high performance, with over 50k stars, it is one of the most used JSON libraries in the C++ community. Gaining 16 stars today, it remains actively maintained.
uses: C++ developers needing to quickly integrate JSON parsing and generation in their projects
Embedded or desktop app development requiring a cross-platform, dependency-free JSON library
Software engineers looking to simplify JSON data handling in their code

zh.tag: 跨平台桌面同步客户端，连接 Nextcloud 服务器与本地文件
zh.what: Nextcloud Desktop Client 是一个用于将 Nextcloud 服务器上的文件与本地计算机同步的桌面应用，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。它提供文件同步、共享和访问功能，确保用户随时随地都能获取最新文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面客户端的完整源代码，包括主对话框、同步引擎、文件活动界面等，以及文档、构建脚本和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 框架（Qt6 或 Qt5），依赖 OpenSSL、QtKeychain、SQLite，支持 CMake 构建，并可选使用 KDE Craft 进行打包。
zh.hot: 尽管今日新增 star 不多，但作为 Nextcloud 官方客户端，长期稳定在 C++ 趋势榜前列，社区活跃，持续维护。
uses: 个人用户：在本地电脑上同步和管理 Nextcloud 云盘文件，实现离线访问和自动备份。
团队协作：团队成员共享文件夹，实时同步更新，确保协作效率。
开发者：参与开源贡献，学习 Qt/C++ 桌面应用开发，或定制企业级同步方案。

en.tag: Cross-platform desktop sync client connecting Nextcloud server to local files
en.what: Nextcloud Desktop Client is a desktop application that synchronizes files from a Nextcloud server to your local computer, available for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides file sync, sharing, and access, ensuring users have the latest files wherever they are.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the desktop client, including the main dialog, sync engine, file activity UI, plus documentation, build scripts, and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily built with C++ and Qt framework (Qt6 or Qt5), depending on OpenSSL, QtKeychain, SQLite, built with CMake, and optionally packaged with KDE Craft.
en.hot: Despite modest daily star gains, as the official Nextcloud client, it consistently ranks high in C++ trending, with an active community and ongoing maintenance.
uses: Individual users: sync and manage Nextcloud cloud files on local computers for offline access and automatic backup.
Team collaboration: share folders among team members with real-time sync to enhance productivity.
Developers: contribute to open source, learn Qt/C++ desktop development, or customize enterprise sync solutions.

zh.tag: 内存高效的跨平台序列化库，免解析直接读取
zh.what: FlatBuffers 是一个专为极致内存效率设计的跨平台序列化库。它允许直接访问序列化数据而无需先进行解析或解包，同时保持出色的向前/向后兼容性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 flatc 编译器（用于从 schema 生成各语言代码）、多种语言的运行时库、示例代码（如 monster.fbs）以及完整的文档。
zh.stack: 核心使用 C++ 编写，支持通过 CMake 构建，并提供了 C、C++、C#、Dart 等多种语言的代码生成和运行时库。
zh.hot: 尽管今日新增星标为 0，但累计 26k+ 星标表明其长期稳定的高关注度，作为 Google 出品的成熟序列化方案，在性能敏感场景中广受欢迎。
uses: 游戏开发中需要快速加载大量资源或网络同步数据的场景
移动应用或嵌入式系统内存受限，需高效数据存储与传输
需要跨语言、跨平台且保持前后兼容的数据交换格式

en.tag: Memory-efficient cross-platform serialization library with direct buffer access
en.what: FlatBuffers is a cross-platform serialization library architected for maximum memory efficiency. It allows direct access to serialized data without parsing/unpacking first, while maintaining great forwards/backwards compatibility.
en.content: The repository includes the flatc compiler for generating language-specific code from schemas, runtime libraries for multiple languages, sample code (e.g., monster.fbs), and comprehensive documentation.
en.stack: Core written in C++, built with CMake, with code generation and runtime libraries for C, C++, C#, Dart, and more.
en.hot: Despite 0 stars today, the cumulative 26k+ stars reflect its long-standing popularity as a mature Google serialization solution, widely adopted in performance-critical scenarios.
uses: Game development requiring fast loading of large assets or network sync data
Mobile or embedded systems with limited memory needing efficient data storage and transmission
Cross-language, cross-platform data interchange with forward/backward compatibility

zh.tag: 隐私优先的 Chromium 浏览器，无广告无噪音
zh.what: Helium 是一款基于 Chromium 的网页浏览器，强调隐私保护和无偏见广告拦截。它去除了 Google 相关服务，提供简洁、快速的上网体验，目前处于测试阶段。
zh.content: 仓库包含浏览器核心代码、补丁集（来自 ungoogled-chromium 等）以及品牌资源。平台打包和工具链分别存放在独立的仓库中。
zh.stack: 基于 Chromium 和 ungoogled-chromium，使用 C++ 开发，集成 uBlock Origin 的修改版用于广告拦截。
zh.hot: 隐私浏览器需求旺盛，Helium 以无偏见广告拦截和简洁设计吸引用户，star 数已超 2 万，今日新增 111，登上 C++ 趋势榜。
uses: 注重隐私、希望摆脱 Google 追踪的普通用户
开发者可参与贡献，基于 Chromium 的浏览器定制开发
寻求无广告干扰、简洁快速浏览体验的用户

en.tag: Privacy-first Chromium browser with unbiased ad-blocking, no bloat
en.what: Helium is a Chromium-based web browser focused on privacy and unbiased ad-blocking. It removes Google services, offering a clean, fast browsing experience, currently in beta.
en.content: The repo contains the browser core, patchset (from ungoogled-chromium etc.), and branding assets. Platform packaging and tooling are in separate repos.
en.stack: Built on Chromium and ungoogled-chromium, developed in C++, integrates a modified uBlock Origin for ad-blocking.
en.hot: High demand for privacy browsers, Helium attracts users with unbiased ad-blocking and clean design, stars exceed 20k with 111 added today, trending in C++.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want to avoid Google tracking
Developers interested in contributing to Chromium-based browser customization
Users seeking an ad-free, clean, and fast browsing experience

zh.tag: 跨平台开源多轨音频编辑器与录音软件
zh.what: Audacity 是一款易用的多轨音频编辑器和录音软件，支持 Windows、macOS、GNU/Linux 等系统。它提供录音、编辑、混音、效果处理等功能，适合播客、音乐制作和音频修复等场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Audacity 的完整源代码，包括核心编辑器、音频引擎、效果插件、UI 资源等。当前正在开发 Audacity 4，采用全新 UI 并进行大规模重构，同时保留 3.x 分支供维护。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 wxWidgets（UI）、PortAudio（音频 I/O）等库。构建系统支持 CMake，并提供针对不同平台的构建脚本。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源音频工具，Audacity 长期拥有稳定用户群。近期因 Audacity 4 的 UI 重构和功能更新引发关注，今日新增 272 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第二。
uses: 播客制作者：录制和编辑多轨音频，添加效果和导出播客节目。
音乐爱好者：进行简单的录音、剪辑和混音，或修复老旧录音。
教育场景：用于音频教学、学生录音作业或声音实验。
音频修复：去除噪音、剪辑对话或恢复历史录音。

en.tag: Cross-platform open-source multi-track audio editor and recorder
en.what: Audacity is an easy-to-use, multi-track audio editor and recorder for Windows, macOS, GNU/Linux and other operating systems. It provides recording, editing, mixing, and effects processing, suitable for podcasting, music production, and audio restoration.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Audacity, including the core editor, audio engine, effects plugins, and UI resources. It is currently undergoing major structural change for Audacity 4, with a brand-new UI and refactorings, while maintaining the 3.x branch.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relying on wxWidgets for UI, PortAudio for audio I/O, and other libraries. The build system uses CMake, with platform-specific build scripts.
en.hot: As a long-standing open-source audio tool, Audacity has a stable user base. Recent attention is driven by the UI overhaul and updates for Audacity 4, gaining 272 stars today and ranking #2 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Podcasters: record and edit multi-track audio, add effects, and export episodes.
Music enthusiasts: perform simple recording, editing, and mixing, or restore old recordings.
Educational settings: use for audio teaching, student recording assignments, or sound experiments.
Audio restoration: remove noise, edit dialogue, or recover historical recordings.

zh.tag: 为 Wayland 打造的一体化可定制桌面外壳
zh.what: Noctalia 是一个原生的 Wayland 桌面外壳，旨在提供精致且可配置的 Linux 桌面体验，无需拼凑独立的栏、启动器、通知守护进程等组件。它直接构建在 Wayland 和 OpenGL ES 之上，不依赖 Qt 或 GTK，将 UI、渲染、配置和 IPC 模型整合为一个统一的 shell。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面外壳实现，涵盖多显示器栏、坞站、启动器、控制中心、通知、壁纸、锁屏、会话操作、剪贴板历史、OSD、托盘集成和桌面小部件。项目还提供文档、Discord 社区链接和 ethos 页面，以阐述其设计理念。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，直接基于 Wayland 协议和 OpenGL ES 进行渲染，不依赖 Qt 或 GTK。项目采用统一的配置和 IPC 模型，确保各组件协同工作。
zh.hot: Noctalia 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得 10,270 颗星，今日新增 65 颗，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 7。它解决了 Wayland 桌面碎片化问题，提供一体化解决方案，吸引了追求简洁与一致性的 Linux 用户。
uses: 追求精致、统一视觉风格的 Linux 桌面用户，希望摆脱多个独立工具的维护负担。
喜欢深度定制桌面环境的开发者，可通过脚本小部件和统一配置实现个性化。
Wayland 用户希望在不依赖 Qt/GTK 的情况下获得高性能、原生体验的桌面外壳。

en.tag: A sleek, customizable desktop shell crafted for Wayland.
en.what: Noctalia is a native Wayland desktop shell for users who want a polished, configurable Linux desktop without assembling separate bar, launcher, notification daemon, and other components. It is built directly on Wayland and OpenGL ES with no Qt or GTK dependency, providing a cohesive shell layer for common desktop surfaces and services.
en.content: The repository contains a full desktop shell implementation, including multi-monitor bars, dock, launcher, control center, notifications, wallpaper, lock screen, session actions, clipboard history, OSDs, tray integration, and desktop widgets. It also includes documentation, Discord community links, and an ethos page explaining the project's philosophy.
en.stack: Written in C++, built directly on Wayland and OpenGL ES with no Qt or GTK dependency. The project uses a unified configuration and IPC model to ensure all components work together cohesively.
en.hot: Noctalia has gained 10,270 stars with 65 new stars today, ranking #7 on the C++ trending list. It addresses the fragmentation of Wayland desktops by offering an integrated solution, appealing to Linux users seeking simplicity and consistency.
uses: Linux desktop users who want a polished, consistent visual style without juggling multiple independent tools.
Developers who enjoy deep customization, using script-backed widgets and unified configuration for personalization.
Wayland users seeking a high-performance, native desktop shell without Qt/GTK dependencies.

zh.tag: 轻量级进程内向量数据库，极速相似搜索
zh.what: Zvec 是一个开源的、嵌入式的向量数据库，专为低延迟和高性能设计，可直接集成到应用中。它已在阿里巴巴集团内部经过实战检验，提供生产级的相似性搜索能力，且部署简单。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 引擎、Python 和 Node.js 客户端库、文档、基准测试以及示例。最新版本引入了 zvec-grep 命令行工具和 ReMe 集成，支持 DiskANN 和索引优化。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 实现，提供 Python（3.10~3.14）和 npm 包，支持 Linux/macOS（含 ARM64），采用 io_uring 异步 I/O，集成 HNSW 和 IVF 索引算法。
zh.hot: 凭借阿里背书和极简部署，在 GitHub 上获得 15.7k 星，今日新增 97 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 10。其轻量级进程内设计契合 AI 代理和本地搜索需求。
uses: 开发者需要在应用中嵌入向量数据库，实现低延迟相似搜索，如推荐系统或语义缓存。
AI 代理开发者利用 zvec 作为记忆存储后端，支持 HNSW 近似最近邻搜索。
本地优先工具链用户通过 zvec-grep 统一关键词与向量搜索，提升工作区检索效率。
对性能敏感的场景，如大规模向量检索，需要生产级且易部署的解决方案。

en.tag: Lightweight in-process vector DB for lightning-fast similarity search
en.what: Zvec is an open-source, in-process vector database designed for low-latency, high-performance similarity search. It can be embedded directly into applications, and has been battle-tested within Alibaba Group for production-grade use.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ engine, Python and Node.js client libraries, documentation, benchmarks, and examples. The latest release adds zvec-grep CLI tool and ReMe integration, with DiskANN support and index optimizations.
en.stack: Primarily implemented in C++, with Python (3.10~3.14) and npm packages, supporting Linux/macOS (incl. ARM64), using io_uring async I/O, integrating HNSW and IVF index algorithms.
en.hot: With Alibaba's backing and minimal setup, it has gained 15.7k stars on GitHub, +97 today, ranking #10 on the C++ trending list. Its lightweight in-process design suits AI agents and local search needs.
uses: Developers needing an embedded vector DB for low-latency similarity search in apps like recommendation or semantic cache.
AI agent developers using zvec as a memory backend with HNSW ANN search.
Local-first toolchain users leveraging zvec-grep to unify keyword and vector search for workspace retrieval.
Performance-sensitive scenarios requiring production-grade, easy-to-deploy vector search.

zh.tag: 通用游戏与视频后期处理注入器
zh.what: ReShade 是一个通用的后期处理注入器，适用于游戏和视频软件。它提供自动化方式访问帧颜色和深度信息，并使用自定义着色语言 ReShade FX 编写环境光遮蔽、景深、色彩校正等效果，且这些效果在几乎所有应用中都能生效。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ReShade 的完整源代码，包括核心运行时、效果编译器、钩子管理、输入处理、GUI 覆盖层等，以及一个独立的 ReShade FX 着色器编译器，可集成到其他项目中。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Visual Studio 2017+ 和 Python（用于 glad 依赖）。使用了 MinHook 库进行 API 钩子，并包含自定义的着色器语言解析器和预处理器。
zh.hot: ReShade 是游戏和视频后期处理领域最流行的工具之一，拥有大量用户和社区支持。尽管今日新增 star 不多，但长期积累的 5439 个 star 反映了其稳定受欢迎程度，且持续更新维护。
uses: 游戏玩家和视频创作者：为游戏或视频添加视觉效果，提升画面质量。
游戏开发者和图形程序员：学习或集成 ReShade FX 着色器编译器到自己的项目中。
Mod 制作者和爱好者：通过编写自定义着色器或插件扩展功能。

en.tag: Generic post-processing injector for games and video software
en.what: ReShade is a generic post-processing injector for games and video software. It provides automated access to frame color and depth information, and uses a custom shader language called ReShade FX to write effects like ambient occlusion, depth of field, color correction, and more, which work everywhere.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of ReShade, including the core runtime, effect compiler, hook management, input handling, GUI overlay, and a standalone ReShade FX shader compiler that can be integrated into other projects.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++, requires Visual Studio 2017+ and Python (for the glad dependency). Uses the MinHook library for API hooking, and includes custom shader language parser and preprocessor.
en.hot: ReShade is one of the most popular post-processing tools for games and video, with a large user base and community support. Although today's star increase is modest, the long-term accumulation of 5439 stars reflects its steady popularity and ongoing maintenance.
uses: Gamers and video creators: add visual effects to games or videos to enhance image quality.
Game developers and graphics programmers: learn or integrate the ReShade FX shader compiler into their own projects.
Mod makers and enthusiasts: extend functionality by writing custom shaders or add-ons.

zh.tag: 单GPU极致推理引擎，专为RTX 5090优化
zh.what: NInfer 是一个从零编写的 C++/CUDA 推理引擎，专门针对单个 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 上的特定 Qwen 检查点进行极致性能优化。它支持文本、图像和视频提示，通过本地 CLI 或兼容 OpenAI/Anthropic 的 HTTP API 提供服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++/CUDA 源码、CMake 构建配置、示例应用（如 ninfer-serve）以及预转换的模型工件（.ninfer 文件），这些工件嵌入了分词器、聊天模板和媒体前端资源。
zh.stack: 技术栈包括 C++20、CUDA（sm_120a 架构）、CMake、Ninja、FFmpeg 和 libcurl。依赖 CUDA Toolkit 13.1+，并要求 RTX 5090 硬件。
zh.hot: 今日新增 45 星，总星数 1431，登上 C++ 日榜第 10。其极致单 GPU 性能定位和针对最新硬件的专业化设计吸引了开发者关注。
uses: 在 RTX 5090 上运行 Qwen 模型，追求极致推理速度的 AI 开发者和研究者
需要本地部署多模态（文本/图像/视频）推理服务，且兼容 OpenAI/Anthropic API 的工程师
对 CUDA 优化和推理引擎实现感兴趣的底层系统开发者

en.tag: Max single-GPU inference engine, specialized for RTX 5090
en.what: NInfer is a from-scratch C++/CUDA inference engine optimized for maximum performance on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 with explicitly registered Qwen checkpoints. It handles text, image, and video prompts via a local CLI or OpenAI-/Anthropic-compatible HTTP APIs.
en.content: The repository contains full C++/CUDA source code, CMake build configuration, example applications like ninfer-serve, and pre-converted model artifacts (.ninfer files) that embed tokenizer, chat template, and media frontend resources.
en.stack: Tech stack includes C++20, CUDA (sm_120a), CMake, Ninja, FFmpeg, and libcurl. Requires CUDA Toolkit 13.1+ and RTX 5090 hardware.
en.hot: Gained 45 stars today, total 1431, ranking #10 on C++ daily trending. Its extreme single-GPU performance focus and specialized design for latest hardware attract developers.
uses: AI developers and researchers running Qwen models on RTX 5090 seeking extreme inference speed
Engineers needing local multimodal (text/image/video) inference with OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs
Low-level system developers interested in CUDA optimization and inference engine implementation

zh.tag: 在 Windows/Linux 上增强 AirPods 桌面体验的工具
zh.what: AirPodsDesktop 是一个开源程序，旨在为 Windows 和 Linux 用户提供 AirPods 的桌面体验增强功能。它能够显示电池信息、自动检测佩戴状态、支持低音频延迟模式，并带有美观的动画效果。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建说明、多语言 README（英文、简体中文、繁体中文）以及预览 GIF。项目采用 Qt 框架构建，并集成了多个第三方库。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 5.15.2 开发，依赖 spdlog、cpr、nlohmann/json 等库，支持 Windows 和 Linux 平台。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 40 星，总星数达 3262，位列 GitHub C++ 趋势榜第 11 名。它填补了 AirPods 在非苹果设备上缺乏官方工具的空缺，吸引大量用户关注。
uses: AirPods 用户希望在 Windows 或 Linux 电脑上查看电量等状态信息
开发者想学习如何用 Qt 构建跨平台桌面应用并集成蓝牙功能
对 AirPods 功能扩展感兴趣，希望参与开源贡献的用户

en.tag: Enhance AirPods desktop experience on Windows and Linux
en.what: AirPodsDesktop is an open-source program that enhances the desktop experience of AirPods on Windows and Linux. It shows battery info, auto-detects ear wearing, supports low audio latency mode, and features beautiful animations.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, build instructions, multilingual READMEs (English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese), and a preview GIF. The project is built with Qt and integrates several third-party libraries.
en.stack: Developed in C++ with Qt 5.15.2, relying on libraries like spdlog, cpr, nlohmann/json, and supporting Windows and Linux.
en.hot: With 40 stars added today and a total of 3262, it ranks #11 on GitHub Trending for C++. It fills the gap of no official AirPods tools on non-Apple devices, attracting many users.
uses: AirPods users who want to see battery status on Windows or Linux PCs
Developers interested in building cross-platform desktop apps with Qt and integrating Bluetooth features
Users curious about extending AirPods functionality and contributing to open source

zh.tag: RE引擎游戏通用模组框架与VR支持工具
zh.what: REFramework 是一个针对卡普空 RE 引擎游戏的模组加载器、脚本平台和模组工具，支持 VR。它允许玩家在游戏中加载 Lua 脚本、插件和内置模组，并提供了大量游戏修复和增强功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 DLL 文件、Lua 脚本 API、插件系统、VR 支持、多种内置模组（如自由视角、FOV 调整等）以及开发者工具（如对象浏览器）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 DirectX 11/12，支持 SteamVR/OpenXR，并集成 Lua 脚本引擎。
zh.hot: 作为 RE 引擎游戏模组的核心工具，它持续吸引大量玩家和模组作者，今日新增 16 星，总星数达 5408，在 C++ 趋势榜上排名第 17。
uses: 模组作者：利用 Lua API 和插件系统为 RE 引擎游戏创建自定义模组和脚本。
VR 玩家：在支持的 RE 游戏中启用 VR 模式，获得沉浸式体验。
游戏玩家：使用内置修复和增强功能改善游戏体验，如解锁帧率或修复崩溃。

en.tag: Universal mod framework, scripting platform, and VR support for RE Engine games
en.what: REFramework is a mod loader, scripting platform, and modding tool for Capcom's RE Engine games, with VR support. It enables loading Lua scripts, plugins, and built-in mods, plus many fixes and enhancements.
en.content: The repository contains core DLLs, Lua scripting API, plugin system, VR support, various built-in mods (free camera, FOV slider, etc.), and developer tools like object explorer.
en.stack: Primarily C++, relies on DirectX 11/12, supports SteamVR/OpenXR, and integrates a Lua scripting engine.
en.hot: As a central tool for RE Engine modding, it consistently attracts players and modders, gaining 16 stars today to reach 5408 total, ranking #17 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Modders: Create custom mods and scripts for RE Engine games using the Lua API and plugin system.
VR enthusiasts: Enable VR mode in supported RE games for an immersive experience.
Gamers: Use built-in fixes and enhancements to improve gameplay, such as unlocking frame rate or fixing crashes.

zh.tag: 明日方舟全自动日常助手，一键长草
zh.what: MAA 是一款基于图像识别的《明日方舟》游戏辅助工具，能自动完成游戏内的日常任务，如刷图、基建换班、公招等。它通过模拟操作和图像识别，让玩家实现“一键长草”，省时省力。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、文档（支持多语言）、以及用于构建和发布的配置。主要模块涵盖战斗、基建、公招、肉鸽等自动化功能，并提供多种编程语言的接口。
zh.stack: 基于 C++20 开发，使用图像识别技术，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 平台。项目还集成了多种语言的接口，如 C、Python、Java、Rust 和 Golang。
zh.hot: 作为热门游戏《明日方舟》的辅助工具，MAA 凭借其高度自动化和活跃的社区更新，在 GitHub 上获得了 2.3 万星标，本月新增 762 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 21 名。
uses: 《明日方舟》玩家：希望自动完成日常任务，节省时间，实现一键长草。
游戏自动化爱好者：对图像识别和模拟操作技术感兴趣，可学习其实现。
开发者：需要集成游戏辅助功能，可通过提供的多种语言接口进行二次开发。

en.tag: One-click Arknights daily task assistant, auto-grind all clients
en.what: MAA is an image-recognition-based assistant for Arknights that automates daily tasks like auto-battles, base management, and recruitment. It simulates user operations to enable one-click idle farming, saving time and effort.
en.content: The repo contains full C++ source code, multi-language docs, and build/release configs. Main modules cover battle, base, recruitment, and roguelike automation, with APIs in multiple languages.
en.stack: Built with C++20, leveraging image recognition, and supporting Windows, Linux, and macOS. It also provides APIs for C, Python, Java, Rust, and Golang.
en.hot: As a popular Arknights assistant, MAA's high automation and active community updates have earned 22,988 stars, with 762 added this month, ranking #21 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Arknights players who want to automate daily tasks and save time with one-click farming.
Game automation enthusiasts interested in image recognition and simulated input techniques.
Developers seeking to integrate game assist features via provided multi-language APIs.

zh.tag: 用 Web 技术构建跨平台桌面应用的开源框架
zh.what: Electron 是一个开源框架，允许开发者使用 JavaScript、HTML 和 CSS 构建跨平台桌面应用。它基于 Node.js 和 Chromium，被 Visual Studio Code 等众多知名应用采用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Electron 的完整源代码、文档、示例以及构建和测试脚本。它提供了预编译的二进制文件，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 平台。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 JavaScript，依赖 Chromium 和 Node.js。通过 npm 安装，支持多种平台架构。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 12 万颗星，是 GitHub 上最受欢迎的桌面应用框架之一。今日新增 8 颗星，持续保持高热度。
uses: 开发者：希望用 Web 技术快速构建跨平台桌面应用的开发者
团队：需要为 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 提供一致体验的产品团队
学习者：想学习桌面应用开发或了解 Chromium 和 Node.js 集成的学习者

en.tag: Open-source framework for building cross-platform desktop apps with web tech
en.what: Electron is an open-source framework that lets developers build cross-platform desktop apps using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. It is based on Node.js and Chromium and is used by many well-known apps like Visual Studio Code.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, examples, and build/test scripts for Electron. It provides prebuilt binaries for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ and JavaScript, relying on Chromium and Node.js. Installed via npm, supporting multiple platforms and architectures.
en.hot: With over 120k stars, it's one of the most popular desktop app frameworks on GitHub. Gained 8 stars today, maintaining high popularity.
uses: Developers: those who want to quickly build cross-platform desktop apps using web technologies
Teams: product teams needing consistent experience across Windows, macOS, and Linux
Learners: those interested in desktop app development or the integration of Chromium and Node.js

zh.tag: 跨平台实时物理渲染引擎，主打移动端高效
zh.what: Filament 是 Google 开源的实时物理渲染引擎，支持 Android、iOS、Linux、macOS、Windows 和 WebGL2。它专为 Android 设计，追求极致的小体积和高效率，同时保持高质量的渲染效果。
zh.content: 仓库包含引擎核心库、材质编译器（matc）、glTF 2.0 加载器（gltfio）等工具，并提供 Maven 依赖和预编译发布包，方便集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，提供 Java/Kotlin（Android）、Swift/Objective-C（iOS）等语言绑定，依赖 OpenGL ES、Vulkan 等图形 API。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方维护的渲染引擎，Filament 在移动端性能和体积上表现优异，持续获得开发者关注，当前 2 万+ star 印证其稳定热度。
uses: 移动端 3D 应用开发者，需要高性能且轻量的渲染引擎
游戏或可视化项目团队，希望跨平台复用渲染代码
对物理渲染（PBR）技术感兴趣的图形学学习者

en.tag: Cross-platform real-time PBR engine, optimized for mobile
en.what: Filament is Google's open-source real-time physically based rendering engine supporting Android, iOS, Linux, macOS, Windows, and WebGL2. It is designed to be as small and efficient as possible on Android while delivering high-quality rendering.
en.content: The repository includes the core engine library, material compiler (matc), glTF 2.0 loader (gltfio), and other tools, with Maven dependencies and prebuilt releases for easy integration.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with Java/Kotlin (Android) and Swift/Objective-C (iOS) bindings, leveraging graphics APIs like OpenGL ES and Vulkan.
en.hot: As an official Google rendering engine, Filament excels in mobile performance and size, consistently gaining developer attention, with 20k+ stars reflecting its sustained popularity.
uses: Mobile 3D app developers needing a high-performance, lightweight rendering engine
Game or visualization teams wanting to reuse rendering code across platforms
Graphics learners interested in physically based rendering (PBR) techniques

zh.tag: 时间序列可视化工具，快速强大且直观
zh.what: PlotJuggler 是一款用于可视化时间序列数据的工具，支持拖拽操作、文件加载和实时数据流。它能够处理数千条时间序列和数百万个数据点，并提供数据变换功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 PlotJuggler 的源代码、文档、构建配置（支持 Windows/Ubuntu/macOS/ROS2）以及示例数据。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 开发，使用 Qt 和 OpenGL 进行界面与渲染，支持多种数据源插件（CSV, ULog, ROS, MQTT 等）。
zh.hot: 尽管 star 数增长平缓，但作为 ROS 生态中常用的可视化工具，持续获得开发者关注，尤其在机器人领域。
uses: 机器人开发者：用于分析 ROS bag 或实时 topic 数据，调试传感器和状态估计。
数据分析师：快速探索 CSV 或日志文件中的时间序列，进行滤波和变换。
嵌入式系统工程师：通过 MQTT 或 WebSocket 实时监控设备数据。

en.tag: Fast, powerful, intuitive time series visualization tool
en.what: PlotJuggler is a tool for visualizing time series data, featuring drag-and-drop UI, file loading, and live streaming. It can handle thousands of time series and millions of data points, with data transformation capabilities.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, build configurations (Windows/Ubuntu/macOS/ROS2), and example data for PlotJuggler.
en.stack: Developed in C++, using Qt and OpenGL for UI and rendering, with plugins for various data sources (CSV, ULog, ROS, MQTT, etc.).
en.hot: Despite modest star growth, it remains popular among ROS developers as a go-to visualization tool, especially in robotics.
uses: Robotics developers: analyze ROS bags or live topics to debug sensors and state estimation.
Data analysts: quickly explore time series in CSV or log files, applying filters and transformations.
Embedded engineers: monitor device data in real-time via MQTT or WebSocket.

zh.tag: 华为昇腾上的 vLLM 硬件插件，让推理引擎跑在 NPU 上
zh.what: 这是一个社区维护的硬件插件，使 vLLM 推理引擎能够利用华为昇腾（Ascend）NPU 进行加速。它通过适配层将 vLLM 的接口映射到昇腾的 CANN 运行时，让用户可以在昇腾硬件上无缝运行大模型推理服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含插件源码、文档、支持矩阵、示例脚本以及发布版本（如 v0.26.0rc1、v0.23.0）。目录结构包括 docs、vllm_ascend 核心模块，以及用于构建和测试的配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Python，依赖 vLLM 框架、华为 CANN 工具链以及 PyTorch。通过 CMake 构建，并集成 CI 测试。
zh.hot: 随着昇腾 NPU 在国产 AI 生态中普及，开发者需要将主流推理框架 vLLM 迁移到昇腾，该插件填补了这一空白。尽管今日新增 0 星，但累计 2760 星表明其持续受到关注，并登上 C++ 日榜第 17 名。
uses: 在华为昇腾 910B/310P 等 NPU 上部署 vLLM 推理服务的开发者
需要将现有 vLLM 应用无缝迁移到国产算力平台的企业或研究机构
关注国产 AI 硬件生态、希望参与社区贡献的工程师或研究者

en.tag: Community hardware plugin to run vLLM inference on Huawei Ascend NPUs
en.what: This is a community-maintained hardware plugin that enables vLLM inference engine to leverage Huawei Ascend NPUs. It provides an adaptation layer mapping vLLM interfaces to Ascend's CANN runtime, allowing seamless LLM inference on Ascend hardware.
en.content: The repository contains plugin source code, documentation, support matrix, example scripts, and release artifacts (e.g., v0.26.0rc1, v0.23.0). It includes docs, the vllm_ascend core module, and build/test configurations.
en.stack: Primarily C++ and Python, depending on vLLM, Huawei CANN toolkit, and PyTorch. Built with CMake and integrated with CI tests.
en.hot: As Ascend NPUs gain traction in China's AI ecosystem, developers need to run vLLM on them, and this plugin fills that gap. Despite 0 stars today, its 2760 total stars and #17 on C++ daily trending show sustained interest.
uses: Developers deploying vLLM inference on Huawei Ascend NPUs like 910B/310P
Enterprises or research groups migrating existing vLLM workloads to domestic AI accelerators
Engineers or researchers interested in China's AI hardware ecosystem and contributing to the community

zh.tag: 开源 OCR 引擎，支持 100+ 语言识别
zh.what: Tesseract 是一个开源的 OCR（光学字符识别）引擎，提供 libtesseract 库和命令行工具 tesseract。它支持超过 100 种语言的文本识别，并输出多种格式如纯文本、PDF 和 hOCR。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OCR 引擎的源代码、文档、测试和构建配置，以及用于训练和评估的脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Leptonica 图像处理库，支持 LSTM 神经网络引擎。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的开源 OCR 引擎，拥有 76k+ stars，长期活跃，是 OCR 领域的标准工具。
uses: 开发者集成 OCR 功能到应用中，如文档扫描和图像文字提取。
研究人员用于训练自定义 OCR 模型或评估 OCR 性能。
需要批量处理文档或图像中文字识别的自动化流程。

en.tag: Open-source OCR engine supporting 100+ languages
en.what: Tesseract is an open-source OCR engine that provides libtesseract library and a command-line tool. It recognizes text in over 100 languages and outputs various formats like plain text, PDF, and hOCR.
en.content: The repository contains source code, documentation, tests, build configurations, and scripts for training and evaluation.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on Leptonica for image processing, and supports LSTM neural network engine.
en.hot: As the most popular open-source OCR engine with 76k+ stars, it remains highly active and is the de facto standard for OCR.
uses: Developers integrating OCR into apps for document scanning and text extraction from images.
Researchers training custom OCR models or evaluating OCR performance.
Automation workflows requiring batch text recognition from documents or images.

zh.tag: 3D打印切片与G代码生成工具
zh.what: PrusaSlicer 是一款将 3D 模型转换为 3D 打印指令（G-code）的软件，支持 FDM 和 mSLA 打印机。它由 Prusa Research 开发，兼容多种品牌打印机，并提供丰富的打印参数设置和模型编辑功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建文档（doc/Build.md）、资源文件（如图标）以及贡献指南。主要功能包括精确的打印参数设置、模型编辑（如涂色、切割、排列）、多项目多平台支持、多材料打印、3D 预览和命令行接口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，基于 Slic3r 构建，依赖常见的图形和几何库。支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台，Linux 通过 Flathub 分发。
zh.hot: 作为 3D 打印领域的知名开源切片软件，PrusaSlicer 持续获得关注，今日新增 13 颗星，总星数达 9296，位列 C++ 趋势榜第三。其强大的功能和活跃的社区是热度来源。
uses: 3D 打印爱好者：使用 PrusaSlicer 将模型切片并生成打印指令，支持多种打印机。
专业用户：需要精细控制打印参数和进行多材料打印的工程师或设计师。
自动化工作流：通过命令行接口在无 GUI 环境下集成切片功能。

en.tag: 3D printing slicer and G-code generator
en.what: PrusaSlicer is a software that converts 3D models into 3D printing instructions (G-code), supporting FDM and mSLA printers. Developed by Prusa Research, it is compatible with a wide range of printer brands and offers extensive printing parameter settings and model editing features.
en.content: The repository contains the complete C++ source code, build documentation (doc/Build.md), resource files (e.g., icons), and contribution guidelines. Key features include precise printing parameter settings, model editing (painting, cutting, arranging), multi-project and multi-bed support, multi-material printing, 3D preview, and a command-line interface.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, built on Slic3r, and relies on common graphics and geometry libraries. Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux; Linux is distributed via Flathub.
en.hot: As a well-known open-source slicer in 3D printing, PrusaSlicer continues to gain attention, adding 13 stars today, reaching 9296 total, ranking third on the C++ trending list. Its powerful features and active community drive its popularity.
uses: 3D printing enthusiasts: use PrusaSlicer to slice models and generate print instructions for various printers.
Professional users: engineers or designers needing precise control over print parameters and multi-material printing.
Automation workflows: integrate slicing via command-line interface in headless environments.

zh.tag: Windows 桌面网速与硬件监控悬浮窗
zh.what: TrafficMonitor 是一款 Windows 平台的小巧悬浮窗软件，实时显示网速、CPU 和内存利用率，支持嵌入任务栏、更换皮肤及历史流量统计。它提供标准版和 Lite 版，Lite 版无需管理员权限，适合日常使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、预编译的 Release 版本（含标准版和 Lite 版）、详细的 README 文档、Wiki 使用说明、截图以及插件系统，支持通过 GitHub Actions 自动构建。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 Microsoft Visual C++ 运行库，支持 Windows 平台，通过 GitHub Actions 进行 CI/CD 构建。
zh.hot: 拥有 46k+ star，长期受 Windows 用户欢迎，因其轻量实用且持续更新，今日新增 19 星，位列 C++ 日榜第 20 名。
uses: Windows 用户实时监控网速、CPU 和内存占用，无需打开任务管理器
需要嵌入任务栏显示系统状态，保持桌面整洁的用户
喜欢自定义桌面皮肤，追求个性化监控界面的用户
开发者和技术爱好者学习 C++ 桌面应用开发与系统监控实现

en.tag: Desktop widget for network speed, CPU & memory monitoring on Windows
en.what: TrafficMonitor is a lightweight desktop widget for Windows that displays real-time network speed, CPU and memory usage. It supports taskbar embedding, custom skins, and historical traffic statistics. Available in Standard and Lite editions, the Lite version requires no admin privileges for everyday use.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, precompiled releases (Standard and Lite), detailed README and Wiki documentation, screenshots, and a plugin system, with automated builds via GitHub Actions.
en.stack: Developed primarily in C++, depends on Microsoft Visual C++ runtime, targets Windows, and uses GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
en.hot: With over 46k stars, it remains popular among Windows users for its lightweight utility and active maintenance, gaining 19 stars today and ranking #20 on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Windows users who want real-time network speed, CPU, and memory monitoring without opening Task Manager
Users who prefer a taskbar-embedded status display to keep the desktop clean
Enthusiasts who enjoy customizing desktop skins for a personalized monitoring interface
Developers and tech enthusiasts learning C++ desktop app development and system monitoring

zh.tag: 开源参数化3D建模软件，跨平台CAD替代品
zh.what: FreeCAD是一款免费开源的参数化3D建模软件，主要用于设计各种尺寸的真实物体。它允许用户通过修改模型历史中的参数来轻松调整设计，并支持从2D草图创建3D模型，以及从3D模型生成高质量的工程图纸。
zh.content: 仓库包含FreeCAD的完整源代码，包括核心模块（如Gui、Mod）和构建配置。还提供安装说明、编译指南、问题报告指南，以及指向文档、论坛和博客的链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用C++，依赖OpenCASCADE几何内核、Coin3D场景图库、Python API和Qt图形界面。支持Windows、macOS和Linux跨平台。
zh.hot: FreeCAD作为开源CAD领域的标杆，持续获得关注。当前GitHub星标超过33k，今日新增31星，位列C++趋势榜第21名，体现了其在开源社区中的稳定热度。
uses: 产品设计师和机械工程师：用于参数化建模和设计验证，可替代商业CAD软件。
建筑师和建筑爱好者：适用于建筑信息建模（BIM）和建筑结构设计。
学生和教育工作者：作为学习3D建模和CAD原理的免费教学工具。
爱好者和创客：用于3D打印模型设计和个人项目制作。

en.tag: Open-source parametric 3D modeler, cross-platform CAD alternative
en.what: FreeCAD is a free and open-source parametric 3D modeler primarily designed to create real-life objects of any size. It allows users to easily modify designs by adjusting parameters in the model history, and supports creating 3D from 2D sketches and extracting design details for production-ready drawings.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of FreeCAD, including core modules (e.g., Gui, Mod) and build configurations. It also provides installation instructions, compilation guide, issue reporting guidelines, and links to documentation, forum, and blog.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relying on OpenCASCADE geometry kernel, Coin3D scene graph, Python API, and Qt GUI. Cross-platform on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: As a benchmark in open-source CAD, FreeCAD consistently gains attention. With over 33k stars and 31 new stars today, ranking #21 on the C++ trending list, it shows steady popularity in the open-source community.
uses: Product designers and mechanical engineers: for parametric modeling and design validation, as an alternative to commercial CAD software.
Architects and building enthusiasts: suitable for building information modeling (BIM) and architectural structure design.
Students and educators: as a free teaching tool for learning 3D modeling and CAD principles.
Hobbyists and makers: for 3D printing model design and personal project creation.

zh.tag: AI 代理技能，一键生成可验证的交互式系统架构图
zh.what: Archify 是一个 AI 代理技能，可将代码库或系统描述转化为精美的交互式系统地图。它支持五种图表类型、四种预设、明暗主题和内置品牌标识，并能生成自包含的 HTML 文件，方便演示和分享。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、文档、示例和生成器代码，支持通过 npx 命令安装到 Raven、Cursor、Claude Code 等代理。提供项目页面、场景指南和画廊，展示不同用例。
zh.stack: 主要基于 HTML，使用 TypeScript 生成确定性校验的 JSON IR，并输出 HTML、PNG、SVG、WebM 等格式。依赖 npx 进行安装，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 18k+ 星标和日增千星的势头，Archify 满足了开发者对可视化架构文档的迫切需求，尤其在 AI 辅助开发场景下，能快速生成可验证的图表，提升代码审查和沟通效率。
uses: 开发者希望在代码审查前快速生成架构对比图，确保变更可验证。
技术写作者或架构师需要为系统设计生成交互式演示文档，便于向团队或客户展示。
AI 代理用户希望将代码库映射为可视化图表，以便更直观地理解系统结构和数据流。

en.tag: Agent skill that turns codebases into beautiful, verifiable interactive architecture diagrams
en.what: Archify is an agent skill that transforms a codebase or system description into a polished, interactive system map. It supports five diagram types, four presets, dark/light themes, and built-in brand marks, producing self-contained HTML files for easy presentation and sharing.
en.content: The repository contains skill definitions, documentation, examples, and generator code, installable via npx into agents like Raven, Cursor, and Claude Code. It includes a project page, scenario guide, and gallery showcasing various use cases.
en.stack: Primarily HTML-based, using TypeScript to generate deterministically checked JSON IR, outputting HTML, PNG, SVG, WebM, and more. Installed via npx, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 18k+ stars and a daily gain of 1k, Archify addresses the urgent need for visual architecture documentation, especially in AI-assisted development, enabling quick generation of verifiable diagrams that boost code review and communication efficiency.
uses: Developers who want to quickly generate architecture comparison diagrams before code review to ensure changes are verifiable.
Technical writers or architects needing interactive presentation documents for system designs to share with teams or clients.
AI agent users who want to map codebases into visual diagrams for better understanding of system structure and data flow.

zh.tag: 一键开启沉浸式多智能体课堂
zh.what: OpenMAIC 是一个开源的多智能体交互式课堂平台，让用户通过点击即可获得沉浸式的多智能体学习体验。它模拟真实课堂环境，由多个 AI 智能体扮演不同角色（如教师、学生），进行互动教学。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端界面（Next.js/React）、后端逻辑（LangGraph 编排）、智能体配置、部署模板（Vercel）、文档和社区资源。支持 OpenClaw 集成和 Lemonade 本地 AI。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Next.js 16、React 19、LangGraph 1.1 构建，支持多种 LLM 提供商（如 OpenAI、Anthropic）的 API 密钥配置。
zh.hot: 凭借创新的多智能体教学理念和极简的一键部署体验，在 GitHub 上迅速走红，24 小时内新增 907 星，总星数突破 2.2 万，位列 Trending 日榜第 5。
uses: 教育工作者：快速搭建 AI 驱动的互动课堂，探索新型教学模式。
AI 开发者：研究多智能体协作与交互，参考其架构和实现。
学习者：通过沉浸式多智能体对话，获得个性化学习体验。
开源爱好者：部署和定制自己的智能体课堂，参与社区贡献。

en.tag: One-click immersive multi-agent learning classroom
en.what: OpenMAIC is an open-source multi-agent interactive classroom platform that provides an immersive learning experience with one click. It simulates a real classroom where multiple AI agents play different roles (e.g., teacher, students) to conduct interactive teaching.
en.content: The repo includes frontend UI (Next.js/React), backend logic (LangGraph orchestration), agent configurations, deployment templates (Vercel), documentation, and community resources. Supports OpenClaw integration and Lemonade local AI.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, using Next.js 16, React 19, LangGraph 1.1, and supports multiple LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) via API keys.
en.hot: Its innovative multi-agent teaching concept and one-click deployment experience have made it viral on GitHub, gaining 907 stars in 24 hours, surpassing 22k total stars, and ranking #5 on the daily trending list.
uses: Educators: Quickly set up AI-driven interactive classrooms to explore new teaching models.
AI developers: Study multi-agent collaboration and interaction, referencing its architecture and implementation.
Learners: Gain personalized learning experiences through immersive multi-agent dialogues.
Open-source enthusiasts: Deploy and customize their own agent classroom, contributing to the community.

zh.tag: 开源终端编码代理，兼容任意 LLM 后端
zh.what: OpenClaude 是一个开源的编码代理 CLI，支持云端和本地模型提供商。它允许用户通过统一的终端工作流使用 OpenAI 兼容 API、Gemini、GitHub Models、Codex OAuth、Ollama 等，同时保留提示、工具、代理、MCP、斜杠命令和流式输出等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 CLI 工具、文档、设置指南、VS Code 扩展支持以及社区资源。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 构建，依赖 Node.js 环境，支持多种 LLM 提供商 API。
zh.hot: 凭借 31k+ stars 和日增 80 的势头，OpenClaude 凭借其‘随处运行、使用任何东西’的灵活性和对多种模型后端的支持，迅速成为开发者首选。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中统一管理多种 LLM 提供商，无需切换工具。
团队需要将编码代理集成到 CI/CD 或自动化工作流中。
喜欢使用 Ollama 等本地模型进行离线开发的用户。

en.tag: Open-source terminal coding agent for any LLM backend
en.what: OpenClaude is an open-source coding-agent CLI for cloud and local model providers. It lets you use OpenAI-compatible APIs, Gemini, GitHub Models, Codex OAuth, Codex, Ollama, Atomic Chat, and other supported backends while keeping one terminal-first workflow: prompts, tools, agents, MCP, slash commands, and streaming output.
en.content: The repository includes the full CLI tool, documentation, setup guides, VS Code extension support, and community resources.
en.stack: Built primarily with TypeScript, requires Node.js, and integrates with multiple LLM provider APIs.
en.hot: With 31k+ stars and 80 daily additions, OpenClaude's flexibility to run anywhere and use any model backend has made it a top choice for developers.
uses: Developers who want to manage multiple LLM providers from one terminal without switching tools.
Teams looking to integrate a coding agent into CI/CD or automated workflows.
Users who prefer local models like Ollama for offline development.

zh.tag: Google 时序预测基础模型，支持多变量与协变量
zh.what: TimesFM 是 Google Research 开发的预训练时序基础模型，用于时间序列预测。它采用 decoder-only 架构，在大量时序数据上预训练，能够进行零样本预测。最新 3.0 版本支持原生多变量预测和协变量，并在多个基准上排名第一。
zh.content: 仓库包含模型源码、预训练权重（Hugging Face）、示例和文档。代码结构分版本管理，最新 3.0 在根目录，旧版本归档在 v1 子目录。
zh.stack: 基于 PyTorch 实现，依赖 Hugging Face Transformers 等。提供 pip 包安装，支持 Python。
zh.hot: 近期发布 3.0 版本，带来多变量预测和协变量支持，在三大基准上排名第一，引发社区关注。今日新增 1618 star，总星标超 3 万。
uses: 时间序列预测研究者：用于零样本预测和模型对比实验
数据科学家：快速进行多变量预测，无需大量训练数据
企业应用开发者：集成到 BigQuery ML 或 Vertex AI 进行规模化预测

en.tag: Google's pretrained time-series foundation model for forecasting, with multivariate & covariate support
en.what: TimesFM is a pretrained time-series foundation model by Google Research for time-series forecasting. It uses a decoder-only architecture pretrained on diverse time-series data, enabling zero-shot forecasting. The latest 3.0 version natively supports multivariate forecasting and covariates, ranking #1 on multiple benchmarks.
en.content: The repo contains model source code, pretrained weights (on Hugging Face), examples, and docs. Code is organized by version; latest 3.0 is at root, older versions archived under v1.
en.stack: Implemented in PyTorch, leveraging Hugging Face Transformers. Installable via pip, Python-based.
en.hot: The recent 3.0 release with native multivariate forecasting and covariates, achieving #1 on three major benchmarks, has sparked interest. Gained 1,618 stars today, total over 30k.
uses: Time-series researchers: for zero-shot forecasting and model benchmarking
Data scientists: for quick multivariate forecasting without extensive training data
Enterprise developers: integrating with BigQuery ML or Vertex AI for scalable forecasting

zh.tag: 2小时从零训练64M超小语言模型，全流程开源教程
zh.what: MiniMind 是一个从零开始训练超小语言模型（64M参数）的开源项目，仅需3块钱成本和2小时即可在单张消费级GPU上完成训练。项目覆盖从数据清洗、预训练到SFT、RLHF、Agentic RL等完整链路，并扩展了视觉、多模态等变体。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的训练代码、模型结构定义、数据预处理脚本、训练教程和多个模型变体（如MiniMind-V、MiniMind-O）。所有核心算法均用PyTorch原生实现，不依赖高层封装库。
zh.stack: 基于Python和PyTorch，从零实现Transformer、MoE、LoRA、DPO、PPO等算法，不依赖transformers/trl等库。
zh.hot: 以极低成本（3元/2小时）训练LLM的颠覆性理念，加上全流程开源和教程性质，吸引了大量希望深入理解LLM的开发者。56k星标和日增近500星，说明其精准切中了个人开发者复现大模型的需求。
uses: LLM初学者：通过从零实现和训练，深入理解大模型内部机制，而非仅使用现成库。
个人开发者/研究者：在消费级GPU上快速实验预训练、微调、RLHF等全流程。
教育场景：作为高校或培训机构的AI课程实战项目，低成本复现前沿技术。
对模型压缩和高效训练感兴趣者：探索64M小模型的性能边界和扩展方向。

en.tag: Train a 64M LLM from scratch in 2h with full pipeline, open-source tutorial
en.what: MiniMind is an open-source project to train a tiny 64M-parameter LLM from scratch, costing only $0.4 and 2 hours on a single consumer GPU. It covers the full pipeline from data cleaning, pretraining to SFT, RLHF, Agentic RL, and extends to vision and multimodal variants.
en.content: The repo contains full training code, model architecture definitions, data preprocessing scripts, tutorials, and several model variants (e.g., MiniMind-V, MiniMind-O). All core algorithms are implemented natively in PyTorch without high-level wrappers.
en.stack: Built with Python and PyTorch, implementing Transformer, MoE, LoRA, DPO, PPO from scratch, without relying on libraries like transformers/trl.
en.hot: The disruptive idea of training an LLM for just $0.4 and 2 hours, combined with full open-source pipeline and tutorial nature, attracts developers eager to understand LLMs deeply. With 56k stars and ~500 daily additions, it hits the need for personal reproduction of LLMs.
uses: LLM beginners: gain deep understanding of LLM internals by implementing and training from scratch, not just using off-the-shelf libraries.
Individual developers/researchers: quickly experiment with pretraining, fine-tuning, RLHF on consumer GPUs.
Educational settings: as a hands-on project for AI courses, reproducing cutting-edge techniques at low cost.
Those interested in model compression and efficient training: explore the performance limits of 64M small models.

zh.tag: 无需 Tailscale 账号的端到端加密 netcat
zh.what: Tailcat 是 Tailscale 开源组件的重混，用于在 Tailscale 数据平面上实现类似 netcat 的功能，但不需要 Tailscale 控制平面。它提供点对点的 WireGuard 加密隧道，并通过 DERP 进行 NAT 穿透和后备中继。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 库（可导入为 github.com/tailscale/tailcat）和 CLI 工具（cmd/tailcat），以及一个实验性的浏览器 WebAssembly 演示。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 编写，使用 Tailscale 的 magicsock 数据平面和 WireGuard 加密，依赖 DERP 服务器进行中继。
zh.hot: 本周新增 3762 星，总星数达 6233，因其无需账号即可实现安全传输的创新理念而备受关注。
uses: 需要快速在两台机器间传输文件或文本，但不想配置复杂 VPN 或 SSH 隧道的开发者。
希望在不修改系统路由表或 DNS 的情况下，获得端到端加密连接的安全研究人员。
对 Tailscale 内部数据平面机制感兴趣，想学习或扩展其开源组件的 Go 开发者。

en.tag: A netcat-like tool with end-to-end encryption, no Tailscale account needed
en.what: Tailcat is a remix of Tailscale open source pieces to act like netcat, but over Tailscale's data plane without Tailscale's control plane. It provides point-to-point WireGuard-encrypted tunnels with DERP for NAT traversal and relay.
en.content: The repo contains a Go library (importable as github.com/tailscale/tailcat) and a CLI tool (cmd/tailcat), plus an experimental in-browser WebAssembly demo.
en.stack: Written in Go, leveraging Tailscale's magicsock data plane and WireGuard encryption, with DERP servers for relay.
en.hot: Gained 3762 stars this week, reaching 6233 total, due to its innovative concept of secure transfer without an account.
uses: Developers needing quick file or text transfer between two machines without complex VPN or SSH tunnel setup.
Security researchers wanting end-to-end encrypted connections without altering system routing tables or DNS.
Go developers interested in Tailscale's internal data plane mechanisms, for learning or extending open source components.

zh.tag: 把任意 AI 代理变成科学家的技能库，覆盖生物、化学、医学等 163 个技能
zh.what: 这是一个开源的科学 Agent 技能库，提供 163 个即用型技能和 100+ 科学数据库，覆盖生物学、化学、医学和药物发现。它兼容 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等主流 AI 代理，并遵循开放的 Agent Skills 标准，让任何 AI 代理都能执行科学任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、测试用例、文档和示例，以及一个可选的本地 AI 协同科学家工具 K-Dense BYOK。技能以标准格式组织，便于集成和扩展。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 Agent Skills 标准，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 3.47 万星标和 17.5 万科学家用户，它填补了 AI 代理在科学领域应用的空白，成为最受欢迎的科学技能库。
uses: 科研人员：快速让 AI 代理执行文献分析、实验设计等任务。
开发者：为 AI 代理集成科学技能，构建垂直领域应用。
教育者：在教学中使用 AI 辅助科学探索，提升学生参与度。

en.tag: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist with 163 validated skills and 100+ scientific databases.
en.what: An open-source library of scientific Agent Skills, offering 163 ready-to-use skills and 100+ scientific databases across biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. It works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and other AI agents, following the open Agent Skills standard, enabling any agent to perform scientific tasks.
en.content: The repo contains skill definitions, tests, documentation, examples, and an optional local AI co-scientist tool K-Dense BYOK. Skills are organized in a standard format for easy integration and extension.
en.stack: Primarily Python-based, relying on the Agent Skills standard, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 34.7k stars and 175k+ scientist users, it fills a gap in AI agent applications for science, becoming the most popular scientific skills library.
uses: Researchers: quickly enable AI agents to perform literature analysis, experiment design, etc.
Developers: integrate scientific skills into AI agents to build domain-specific applications.
Educators: use AI-assisted scientific exploration in teaching to boost student engagement.

zh.tag: 在 Mac 上虚拟运行 iPhone 的命令行工具
zh.what: vphone-cli 利用 Apple 的 Virtualization.framework 和 PCC 研究虚拟机基础设施，在 macOS 上启动虚拟 iPhone。它自动化了从下载固件、修补引导链到 DFU 恢复和首次启动的完整流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含命令行工具 vphone-cli、用于管理虚拟机的子命令（vm、fw、restore、cfw 等），以及构建脚本和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Swift 编写，依赖 Python、aria2、wget、openssl、libusb 等工具，通过 Homebrew 安装。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub Trending 周榜排名第 8，本周新增近 2000 star，总 star 过万，因其能在 Mac 上虚拟运行 iPhone 的突破性能力而备受关注。
uses: iOS 开发者和安全研究人员，希望在 Mac 上快速启动虚拟 iPhone 进行测试。
对 iOS 内部机制感兴趣的技术爱好者，想探索 PCC 研究虚拟机基础设施。
需要多设备测试环境的人员，可通过克隆快速创建多个虚拟 iPhone。

en.tag: CLI tool to boot a virtual iPhone on Apple Silicon Macs
en.what: vphone-cli leverages Apple's Virtualization.framework and PCC research VM infrastructure to boot a virtual iPhone on macOS. It automates the entire pipeline from firmware download, boot chain patching, DFU restore, to first boot.
en.content: The repository includes the vphone-cli command-line tool, subcommands for VM management (vm, fw, restore, cfw, etc.), build scripts, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Swift, with dependencies on Python, aria2, wget, openssl, libusb, etc., installed via Homebrew.
en.hot: Ranked #8 on GitHub Trending this week with ~2000 new stars, surpassing 10k total, it gains attention for its groundbreaking ability to run a virtual iPhone on a Mac.
uses: iOS developers and security researchers who want to spin up virtual iPhones on a Mac for testing.
Tech enthusiasts interested in iOS internals, exploring PCC research VM infrastructure.
Those needing multiple test devices, can quickly clone virtual iPhones for parallel testing.

zh.tag: 中国专利智能助手：挖掘专利点、编写交底书、通俗解读
zh.what: 这是一个面向中国专利的 Agent 技能，帮助研发人员从项目材料中挖掘可申请的专利点，编写发明、实用新型、外观设计的交底书，并支持多轮迭代修改。它还能将公开专利解读成通俗笔记和知识图谱，沉淀为个人专利知识库，并辅助审查答复和政策嗅探。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义（SKILL.md）、安装说明（INSTALL.md）、设计文档、示例输出（如交底书、Mermaid 图、线稿图）以及相关代码。核心功能模块包括专利点挖掘、交底书生成与迭代、专利通俗解读（输出到 Obsidian）、审查答复辅助等。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.9+，使用 Playwright 与 CNIPA（中国国家知识产权局）交互，遵循 AgentSkills 标准，集成 Obsidian CLI 和 Bases 生态，支持 Mermaid 图表生成。
zh.hot: 5.6k stars 且日增 62，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 13，因为精准解决了研发人员写专利交底书的痛点，将专利解读与知识库结合，实用性强且演示效果直观。
uses: 研发工程师：从项目代码和方案中快速挖掘专利点，生成规范交底书
专利代理人/IPR：辅助审查答复、多轮修订交底书，并跟踪政策动向
技术管理者：将公开专利解读为通俗笔记，构建团队私有专利知识库
创新爱好者：学习专利撰写技巧，理解复杂专利的技术细节

en.tag: China patent skill: mine patent points, draft disclosures, plain-language analysis
en.what: This is an Agent skill for Chinese patents, helping R&D personnel mine patentable points from project materials, draft invention, utility model, and design patent disclosures, with multi-round iteration support. It also interprets public patents into plain-language notes and knowledge graphs, building a personal patent knowledge base, and assists with office action responses and policy tracking.
en.content: The repo includes skill definition (SKILL.md), installation guide (INSTALL.md), design docs, sample outputs (disclosures, Mermaid diagrams, line drawings), and code. Core modules cover patent point mining, disclosure generation and iteration, plain-language interpretation (into Obsidian), and office action assistance.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.9+, uses Playwright for CNIPA interaction, follows AgentSkills standard, integrates Obsidian CLI and Bases ecosystem, and supports Mermaid diagram generation.
en.hot: With 5.6k stars and +62 today, ranking #13 on GitHub Trending daily, it addresses the pain point of drafting patent disclosures for engineers, combining interpretation with knowledge base, highly practical with clear demos.
uses: R&D engineers: quickly mine patent points from code and designs, generate standard disclosures
Patent attorneys/IPR: assist with office actions, multi-round revisions, and policy tracking
Tech managers: interpret public patents into plain notes, build team patent knowledge base
Innovation enthusiasts: learn patent drafting skills and understand complex patent details

zh.tag: 开源 SEO 分析平台，支持 AI Agent 与 MCP 工具链集成
zh.what: OpenSEO 是 Semrush 和 Ahrefs 的开源替代品，提供关键词研究、排名追踪、竞品洞察、外链审计与站点诊断等核心 SEO 工作流。它采用按量付费模式，用户只需接入自己的 DataForSEO API 密钥即可使用，无需订阅。同时，它内置 MCP 服务器和可复用的 Agent Skills，让 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等 AI 代理直接调用 SEO 数据完成自动化任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的前后端应用代码与现代化 UI，支持 Docker 和 Cloudflare 自托管，内置 MCP 服务器以及预设的 Agent Skills（如 keyword-research、competitor-analysis、link-prospecting）。文档涵盖 API 密钥配置、Google Search Console 接入、SEO 成本参考及本地开发指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，前端采用现代 UI 框架，后端依赖 DataForSEO API 获取 SEO 数据，并通过 MCP 协议与外部 AI Agent 通信；支持 Docker 容器化部署与 Cloudflare 边缘托管。
zh.hot: 在 SEO 工具普遍昂贵且功能臃肿的背景下，它以开源、按量付费、可自托管的定位迅速获得关注；4,405 Stars 中本月新增 2,187 颗，登上 GitHub TypeScript 月榜第 17 名，其对 MCP 与 AI Agent 的原生集成进一步放大了开发者与增长团队的兴趣。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 无需订阅高价 SaaS，用自有 API 密钥低成本完成 SEO 监控与关键词研究。
AI 工程师 / Agent 开发者 —— 通过 MCP 将实时 SEO 数据接入 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等智能体，实现自动化内容策略。
增长与营销团队 —— 利用预设 Agent Skills 快速完成竞品分析、外链挖掘和排名追踪。
隐私敏感企业 —— 支持 Docker/Cloudflare 自托管，完全掌控数据与成本。

en.tag: Open-source SEO suite with AI agent & MCP integration for self-hosting
en.what: OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, offering keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlink audits, and site audits. It uses a pay-as-you-go model with your own DataForSEO API key instead of expensive subscriptions. It also exposes an MCP server and reusable Agent Skills so AI agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw can interact directly with SEO data.
en.content: The repository contains a full-stack application with a modern UI, supporting Docker and Cloudflare self-hosting, along with a built-in MCP server and pre-built Agent Skills (e.g., keyword-research, competitor-analysis, link-prospecting). Documentation covers API key setup, Google Search Console integration, SEO cost references, and local development guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, it features a modern frontend UI, relies on the DataForSEO API for search data, and communicates with external AI agents via the MCP protocol. It supports Docker containerization and Cloudflare edge hosting.
en.hot: It gained rapid traction as a free, pay-as-you-go, self-hostable alternative to expensive and bloated SEO suites; with 4,405 stars and 2,187 added this month alone—ranking 17th on GitHub's monthly TypeScript trending list—its native MCP and AI Agent support has further driven interest from developers and growth teams.
uses: Indie developers and small teams —— Avoid expensive subscriptions by using your own API key for low-cost SEO monitoring and keyword research.
AI engineers and agent builders —— Feed real-time SEO data into Claude Code, OpenClaw, or other agents via MCP for automated content strategy.
Growth and marketing teams —— Use pre-built Agent Skills to quickly run competitor analysis, link prospecting, and rank tracking.
Privacy-conscious organizations —— Self-host via Docker or Cloudflare to maintain full control over data and costs.

zh.tag: 浏览器里的实时全球态势感知模拟器

en.tag: A real-time global situational awareness simulator in your browser
en.what: A spy-satellite simulator in your browser with real data. It visualizes live aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic, and public cameras on a photorealistic 3D globe, with hands-free voice control.

Tech enthusiasts who want to experience real-time global dynamics (flights, ships, satellites, etc.).
Educational settings for demonstrating real-time data sources and 3D visualization techniques.

zh.tag: MCP 服务器精选清单，覆盖官方与社区实现
zh.what: 这是一个精选的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器列表，旨在帮助开发者发现和选择适合的 MCP 服务器来扩展 AI 模型的能力。它涵盖了文件访问、数据库连接、API 集成等多种用途的服务器，并提供了分类和标记以便快速筛选。

en.tag: Curated list of MCP servers, official & community implementations

zh.tag: 全自动去除语言模型审查的优化工具
zh.what: Heretic 是一个无需昂贵后训练即可移除 Transformer 语言模型审查（安全对齐）的工具。它结合方向消融（abliteration）与基于 TPE 的参数优化器，自动寻找高质量消融参数，同时最小化拒绝次数和与原始模型的 KL 散度，从而保留模型智能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 实现、命令行界面、自动优化流程、支持多种模型架构（稠密、MoE、混合如 Qwen3.5），并提供示例配置和基准测试结果。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch、Transformers、Optuna（TPE 优化器）等，实现方向消融和参数优化。
zh.hot: 2.87 万星标，日增 150，登上日榜第 6。它让非专家也能一键去除模型审查，且效果媲美人工调优，引发广泛关注。
uses: AI 研究人员和开发者，希望快速去除模型审查而不损失性能。
对模型安全对齐机制感兴趣，想探索方向消融技术的实践者。
需要定制模型行为、去除内容限制的普通用户，无需深入理解内部原理。

en.tag: Fully automatic censorship removal for language models via TPE-based optimization
en.what: Heretic is a tool that removes censorship (safety alignment) from transformer-based language models without expensive post-training. It combines directional ablation (abliteration) with a TPE-based parameter optimizer to automatically find high-quality parameters that minimize refusals and KL divergence from the original model, preserving intelligence.
en.content: The repository contains a full Python implementation, CLI, automatic optimization pipeline, support for dense, MoE, and hybrid models (e.g., Qwen3.5), along with example configs and benchmark results.
en.stack: Built with Python, leveraging PyTorch, Transformers, and Optuna for TPE-based optimization, implementing directional ablation.
en.hot: With 28.7k stars and +150 daily, ranking #6 on the daily trend, it enables non-experts to decensor models with one command, rivaling manual abliteration, sparking wide interest.
uses: AI researchers and developers seeking to remove model censorship quickly without performance loss.
Practitioners interested in safety alignment mechanisms and directional ablation techniques.
General users who need to customize model behavior or remove content restrictions without deep technical knowledge.

zh.tag: 命令行下载 App Store 的 ipa 包工具
zh.what: ipatool 是一个命令行工具，允许用户从 App Store 搜索 iOS、iPadOS、tvOS 和 visionOS 应用，并下载其 ipa 文件。它支持认证、搜索、购买和列出已购应用等操作。

zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 App Store 的 API，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，可通过 Homebrew 安装。
zh.hot: 该工具为开发者和安全研究人员提供了便捷的 ipa 下载方式，在 GitHub 上获得 1 万+ star，今日新增 58 个，登上日榜第 8 名。

安全研究人员分析应用包内容
需要备份或归档 App Store 应用的用户

en.tag: CLI tool to search and download ipa packages from App Store
en.what: ipatool is a command-line tool that allows users to search for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS apps on the App Store and download their ipa files. It supports authentication, searching, purchasing, and listing purchased apps.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of a Go-based CLI tool with subcommands like auth, search, purchase, and list-purchases, supporting text and JSON output formats, along with a demo GIF and detailed documentation.

zh.tag: 让 AI 编程助手直接操控 Chrome 的 MCP 服务器
zh.what: chrome-devtools-mcp 是一个模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器，允许 AI 编程助手（如 Claude、Cursor、Copilot）实时控制并检查 Chrome 浏览器。它提供性能洞察、高级调试和可靠自动化能力，并附带 CLI 供非 MCP 场景使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MCP 服务器实现、CLI 工具、文档（工具参考、故障排除、设计原则等）以及贡献指南。核心功能包括性能追踪、网络请求分析、截图和 console 消息检查。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 puppeteer 实现浏览器自动化，依赖 Chrome DevTools 前端进行性能追踪，并集成 Google CrUX API 获取真实用户体验数据。
zh.hot: 凭借 5 万+ star 成为 AI 代理工具链的明星项目，本周新增 738 star 登上 TypeScript 周榜。它让 AI 编程助手获得浏览器级调试能力，极大提升自动化与排错效率。
uses: AI 编程助手（如 Claude、Cursor）需要自动化浏览器操作或调试前端代码的开发者
需要分析网页性能、网络请求和 console 错误的 QA 或性能工程师

对 Chrome DevTools 自动化感兴趣，想扩展其能力的开发者

en.tag: MCP server that lets coding agents control and inspect Chrome
en.what: chrome-devtools-mcp is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets coding agents (like Claude, Cursor, Copilot) control and inspect a live Chrome browser. It provides performance insights, advanced debugging, and reliable automation, with a CLI for non-MCP use.
en.content: The repo contains the MCP server implementation, a CLI, docs (tool reference, troubleshooting, design principles), and contributing guidelines. Key features include performance tracing, network analysis, screenshots, and console message inspection.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses puppeteer for browser automation, leverages Chrome DevTools frontend for performance tracing, and integrates Google CrUX API for real-user experience data.
en.hot: With 50k+ stars, it's a star in the AI agent toolchain, gaining 738 stars this week and ranking #18 on TypeScript weekly. It gives coding agents browser-level debugging, boosting automation and troubleshooting efficiency.

QA or performance engineers needing to analyze page performance, network requests, and console errors
MCP users who want to integrate browser control into custom AI workflows
Developers interested in extending Chrome DevTools automation capabilities

zh.tag: 截图秒变前端代码的AI工具

en.tag: Turn screenshots into clean frontend code with AI
en.what: This is a tool that uses AI to convert screenshots, mockups, Figma designs, and even screen recordings into clean, functional frontend code (e.g., HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue). Users upload an image or recording and get a working prototype or code implementation.

Product managers or designers validate UI concepts without manually writing code
Educational settings for teaching frontend development by visually demonstrating code generation

zh.tag: 一条命令微调大模型，无需SSH和复杂配置
zh.what: Soup 是一个命令行工具，旨在简化大语言模型的微调和后训练流程。用户只需编写一个 YAML 配置文件，然后执行一条命令即可完成训练，无需管理 SSH 或处理复杂的配置。它支持在普通笔记本电脑 GPU（如 4GB 显存）上训练 8B 参数的模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包（soup-cli），提供命令行接口、配置解析、训练引擎（基于分层流式训练）以及文档和示例。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10-3.12，使用 PyTorch 等深度学习框架，支持多种模型架构，通过 pip 安装。
zh.hot: 以 4198 星且单日新增 326 星登上趋势榜，因其大幅降低了 LLM 微调的门槛，让普通开发者也能在消费级硬件上训练大模型。
uses: 希望在自己的笔记本上微调大模型的研究者和开发者
需要快速迭代模型原型、不想折腾基础设施的 AI 工程师
教学场景中用于演示 LLM 微调流程的教师和学生

en.tag: Fine-tune LLMs with one command, no SSH or config hell
en.what: Soup is a command-line tool that simplifies fine-tuning and post-training of large language models. Users write a single YAML config and run one command to train, without SSH or complex configuration. It supports training 8B models on a 4GB laptop GPU.
en.content: The repo contains the Python package (soup-cli) with CLI, config parsing, training engine (layer streaming), plus docs and examples.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.10-3.12, uses PyTorch and other deep learning frameworks, supports various model architectures, installed via pip.
en.hot: With 4,198 stars and +326 today, it trends by dramatically lowering the barrier to LLM fine-tuning, enabling developers to train on consumer hardware.
uses: Researchers and developers who want to fine-tune LLMs on their laptops
AI engineers who need rapid prototyping without infrastructure hassle
Educators and students demonstrating LLM fine-tuning workflows

zh.tag: 为 LLM 打造的开源网络爬虫与抓取工具
zh.what: Crawl4AI 是一个开源网络爬虫和抓取工具，专为大型语言模型设计。它能将网页转换为干净、结构化的 Markdown 格式，方便用于 RAG、AI 代理和数据管道。该工具强调速度、可控性和易用性，并拥有超过 50k 星标的社区支持。

zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 Playwright 进行浏览器自动化，支持 Docker 部署，并集成 GPU 加速。
zh.hot: 随着 LLM 应用对高质量数据的需求激增，Crawl4AI 提供了专门为 LLM 优化的爬虫解决方案，star 数已超 8 万，今日新增 221，跻身 GitHub 趋势榜第 6。

数据工程师：构建数据管道，从网站提取结构化内容用于分析和训练。
研究人员：快速收集和整理网页信息，用于学术研究或市场调研。

en.tag: Open-source LLM-friendly web crawler & scraper for clean Markdown
en.what: Crawl4AI is an open-source web crawler and scraper designed specifically for large language models. It converts web pages into clean, structured Markdown, making it easy to use for RAG, AI agents, and data pipelines. It emphasizes speed, controllability, and ease of use, backed by a community of over 50k stars.
en.content: The repository includes a Python library, Docker API server, Playwright integration, memory-adaptive dispatcher, GPU support, and extensive documentation and examples. The latest v0.9.2 fixes memory leaks and Docker authentication issues.
en.stack: Primarily Python, leveraging Playwright for browser automation, Docker for deployment, and optional GPU acceleration.
en.hot: With the surge in demand for high-quality data for LLM applications, Crawl4AI offers a crawler solution specifically optimized for LLMs, amassing over 80k stars and 221 new stars today, ranking #6 on GitHub Trending.
uses: AI developers: crawl web pages and convert to clean Markdown for RAG systems or AI agents.
Data engineers: build data pipelines to extract structured content from websites for analysis and training.
Researchers: quickly collect and organize web information for academic research or market analysis.

Tutorial makers: turn raw screen recordings into finished tutorials with subtitles and color grading.
Developers: automate video pipelines with coding agents, customizing ffmpeg chains and animations.
