zh.what: Pixelle-Video 是一个 AI 全自动短视频生成引擎，用户只需输入一个主题，它就能自动完成文案撰写、配图/视频生成、语音合成、背景音乐添加和视频合成。它旨在让视频创作零门槛，无需剪辑经验。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 代码库、Web UI 界面、模块化视频生成流程（文案生成→配图规划→逐帧处理→视频合成），以及多种集成模块如数字人口播、图生视频、动作迁移等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖多种 AI 模型和服务，包括 LLM（GPT、通义千问、DeepSeek、Ollama）、TTS（Edge-TTS、Index-TTS）、图像/视频生成（WAN 2.1、Seedream、Seedance、Kling 等），以及 ComfyUI/RunningHub 工作流。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上获得 27,733 颗星，本周新增 370 颗，位列 Python 周榜第 15 名。其火爆源于将复杂的视频制作流程简化为一句主题输入，极大降低了创作门槛，吸引了大量内容创作者和 AI 爱好者。
uses: 内容创作者：快速生成短视频素材，提高内容产出效率。
营销人员：自动化制作产品宣传或广告视频，节省时间和成本。
教育工作者：将文本教程转化为视频讲解，增强学习体验。
AI 爱好者：探索和定制 AI 视频生成流程，集成不同模型。

en.tag: Fully automated AI short video engine from a single topic
en.what: Pixelle-Video is a fully automated AI short video engine. Users only need to input a topic, and it automatically handles scriptwriting, image/video generation, voiceover synthesis, background music, and video composition. It aims to make video creation accessible to everyone with zero editing experience.
en.content: The repository contains a complete Python codebase, a Web UI, a modular video generation pipeline (script → image planning → frame processing → video composition), and various integration modules such as digital human talking head, image-to-video, and motion transfer.
en.stack: Built primarily with Python, it integrates various AI models and services: LLMs (GPT, Qwen, DeepSeek, Ollama), TTS (Edge-TTS, Index-TTS), image/video generation (WAN 2.1, Seedream, Seedance, Kling), and ComfyUI/RunningHub workflows.
en.hot: With 27,733 stars (370 added this week) and ranking #15 on the Python weekly trending list, its popularity stems from simplifying complex video production into a single topic input, dramatically lowering the barrier for creators and attracting many content creators and AI enthusiasts.
uses: Content creators: Quickly generate short video material to boost content production efficiency.
Marketers: Automate product promos or ad videos, saving time and cost.
Educators: Convert text tutorials into video explanations to enhance learning.
AI enthusiasts: Explore and customize AI video pipelines, integrating various models.

zh.tag: 双足机器人强化学习训练环境，sim2real 全流程
zh.what: 这是为 Microduck 双足机器人设计的强化学习训练环境，基于 MuJoCo Warp 和 PPO 算法，在仿真中训练行走、跌倒恢复等技能，并导出 ONNX 部署到真实机器人。仓库封装了完整的 sim2real 流程，包括执行器物理、域随机化和奖励设计经验。
zh.content: 包含训练脚本、任务注册表（如行走、跌倒恢复等）、ONNX 导出工具、策略发布脚本，以及 Hugging Face Jobs 远程训练支持。还有 AGENTS.md 记录经验总结。
zh.stack: Python，依赖 MuJoCo Warp（需要 CUDA GPU）、PPO、uv 包管理，支持 ONNX 导出。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1247 stars（总数 1770），因为展示了真实机器人上成功的 sim2real 强化学习，且代码完整可复现，吸引机器人爱好者和 RL 研究者。
uses: 机器人研究者：学习双足机器人的 sim2real 强化学习流程和奖励设计。
RL 工程师：在 MuJoCo Warp 上训练策略，并部署到真实硬件。
Microduck 用户：直接训练和发布自定义行走策略。

en.tag: RL training environments for Microduck bipedal robot, full sim2real recipe
en.what: RL training environments for Microduck, an 800g bipedal robot, built on MuJoCo Warp with PPO. Policies are trained at 50Hz, exported to ONNX, and deployed on the real robot. The repo encodes the full sim2real recipe: actuator physics, domain randomization, backlash simulation, and reward-design lessons.
en.content: Contains training scripts, task registry (walking, fall recovery, etc.), ONNX export and publishing tools, and Hugging Face Jobs support for remote training. Includes AGENTS.md with distilled playbook.
en.stack: Python, built on MuJoCo Warp (requires CUDA GPU), PPO, uv package manager, ONNX export.
en.hot: Gained 1247 stars this week (total 1770) due to its successful sim2real RL on a real robot, with complete reproducible code, attracting robotics enthusiasts and RL researchers.
uses: Robotics researchers: study sim2real RL pipeline and reward design for bipedal robots.
RL engineers: train policies on MuJoCo Warp and deploy to real hardware.
Microduck users: train and publish custom walking policies directly.

zh.tag: 邮箱与用户名OSINT双合一扫描套件
zh.what: 这是一个OSINT（开源情报）工具，只需一个邮箱或用户名即可进行深度数据提取。它分析465+个活跃扫描向量（175+邮箱/290+用户名），用于安全研究、调查和数字足迹分析。

zh.stack: 主要使用Python编写，依赖requests等库进行网络请求，支持跨平台运行。
zh.hot: 本周新增1322星，总星数4639，登上GitHub周榜Python第12名。其强大的OSINT功能和易用性吸引了安全研究者和调查人员。
uses: 安全研究人员用于漏洞评估和渗透测试中的信息收集。
调查记者或执法机构用于数字足迹分析和案件调查。
个人用户用于检查自己的在线隐私暴露情况。

en.tag: 2-in-1 Email & Username OSINT suite for deep data extraction
en.what: This is an OSINT (Open Source Intelligence) tool that performs deep data extraction from just a single email or username. It analyzes 465+ actively maintained scan vectors (175+ email / 290+ username) for security research, investigations, and digital footprinting.
en.content: The repository contains a Python-based CLI tool offering email and username scanning capabilities, supporting multiple platforms (Termux, Windows, Linux), with Discord community link and sponsor banners.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python, using libraries like requests for network calls, with cross-platform support.
en.hot: Gained 1,322 stars this week, reaching 4,639 total, ranking #12 on GitHub Trending Python weekly. Its powerful OSINT capabilities and ease of use attract security researchers and investigators.

Investigative journalists or law enforcement for digital footprint analysis and case investigations.
Individuals to check their own online privacy exposure.

zh.tag: AI 代理驱动的跨平台热点搜索与摘要工具
zh.what: 这是一个 AI 代理技能，能够并行搜索 Reddit、X、YouTube、HN、Polymarket 等多个平台，根据用户互动（如点赞、投票、真实资金）对结果进行评分，并由 AI 代理裁判综合生成一份简洁的摘要。它旨在提供基于真实人群关注度的搜索，而非传统编辑选择的结果。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能规范（SKILL.md）、安装脚本、多语言 README 以及媒体资源。支持通过 Claude Code 插件市场或 npx 命令安装到多种 AI 代理宿主（如 Codex、Cursor 等）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖各平台 API 和浏览器会话，支持用户自带密钥。零配置即可使用 Reddit、HN 等，通过设置向导可解锁更多平台。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1215 星，总星数达 6.1 万，并曾登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。其独特价值在于打破了各大平台的数据孤岛，提供跨平台的真实热度聚合，满足了用户对深度、实时信息的需求。
uses: 适合需要快速了解某个人物、事件或话题在多个社交平台真实热度的市场研究人员、记者或投资者。
适用于 AI 代理开发者，希望为自己的代理添加跨平台搜索与摘要能力，作为技能模块集成。
适合日常用户，用于在开会前或决策前快速获取关于某人或某话题的全面、基于真实互动数据的简报。

en.tag: AI agent-led search engine across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and web
en.what: This is an AI agent skill that searches across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web in parallel, scores results by real user engagement (upvotes, likes, real money), and synthesizes a concise brief via an AI judge. It offers a people-powered alternative to editor-curated search results.
en.content: The repo includes the skill spec (SKILL.md), installation scripts, multilingual READMEs, and media assets. It can be installed via Claude Code plugin marketplace or npx command across 50+ agent hosts.
en.stack: Primarily Python-based, leveraging platform APIs and browser sessions with bring-your-own-keys support. Zero-config for Reddit, HN, etc., with a setup wizard to unlock more platforms.
en.hot: Gained 1,215 stars this week, totaling 61k, and hit #1 on GitHub Trending daily. Its unique value lies in bridging walled gardens to aggregate real engagement across platforms, meeting the demand for deep, real-time insights.
uses: For market researchers, journalists, or investors needing a quick pulse on a person or topic across social platforms with real engagement metrics.
For AI agent developers looking to integrate cross-platform search and summarization as a reusable skill.
For everyday users wanting a comprehensive, engagement-based brief before meetings or decisions, without manual browsing.

zh.tag: 聚合34家免费LLM提供商的统一API网关
zh.what: FreeLLMAPI 是一个开源项目，将数十家免费 LLM 提供商的免费额度聚合到一个 OpenAI 兼容的 /v1 端点后面。它提供智能路由、自动故障转移和加密密钥管理，让开发者无需管理多个 API 密钥即可访问大量免费模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 TypeScript 编写的 API 网关，支持 Docker 自托管、桌面应用（macOS/Windows）和 Android 应用。它提供了一个仪表板，用于监控每月 token 预算，并包含一个自动更新的模型目录。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，支持 Docker 部署，并提供桌面和移动端应用。依赖 OpenAI 兼容 API 标准，集成多个 LLM 提供商。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得近 2 万星标，日增 174 星。它解决了开发者对免费 LLM 资源分散、难以管理的痛点，提供了一站式解决方案。
uses: 个人开发者：快速集成多个免费 LLM，无需单独注册和付费。
原型开发：在项目初期使用免费模型验证想法，降低开发成本。
学习与研究：探索不同 LLM 的能力，进行对比实验。
自动化工具：为聊天机器人、内容生成等应用提供统一 API 接口。

en.tag: Unified API gateway aggregating 34 free LLM providers
en.what: FreeLLMAPI is an open-source project that aggregates free tiers from dozens of LLM providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint. It offers smart routing, automatic failover, and encrypted key management, allowing developers to access a vast array of free models without managing multiple API keys.
en.content: The repository contains a TypeScript-based API gateway with Docker self-hosting, desktop apps for macOS/Windows, and an Android app. It includes a dashboard for monitoring monthly token budgets and an auto-updating model catalog.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Docker deployment and desktop/mobile apps. Relies on OpenAI-compatible API standards and integrates multiple LLM providers.
en.hot: The project has gained nearly 20k stars with 174 new stars today, addressing the pain point of scattered free LLM resources by offering a one-stop solution.
uses: Individual developers: Quickly integrate multiple free LLMs without separate registrations and payments.
Prototyping: Validate ideas with free models in early stages, reducing development costs.
Learning and research: Explore capabilities of different LLMs and run comparative experiments.
Automation tools: Provide a unified API for chatbots, content generation, and more.

zh.tag: 自托管 WhatsApp API 网关，开源免费，可插拔架构
zh.what: OpenWA 是一个免费、开源的 WhatsApp API 网关，让开发者完全掌控消息基础设施，避免供应商锁定和隐藏费用。它支持多会话并发、提供完整仪表盘，并可通过配置切换数据库、存储和缓存后端。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心网关服务、基于 React 的仪表盘、官方插件（如 Chatwoot、Typebot）以及社区适配器。提供 Docker 原生部署和 n8n 集成节点。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 和 NestJS 构建，支持 Node.js 22 LTS，使用 SQLite/PostgreSQL 作为数据库，可选 Redis 缓存，支持 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 本周新增 499 星，总星数达 1.38 万，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 7。其开源免费、可插拔架构和完整仪表盘吸引了大量开发者，尤其适合需要自托管 WhatsApp 集成的场景。
uses: 开发者希望自建 WhatsApp 机器人或集成到业务系统，避免依赖商业 API 服务。
团队需要多会话管理、细粒度权限控制（如操作员/查看者令牌）的 WhatsApp 网关。
自动化工作流爱好者可结合 n8n 或 Chatwoot 等工具，实现客服或营销自动化。

en.tag: Self-hosted WhatsApp API gateway, open-source, pluggable architecture
en.what: OpenWA is a free, open-source WhatsApp API gateway that gives developers full control over their messaging infrastructure without vendor lock-in or hidden costs. It supports concurrent multi-session, provides a full dashboard, and allows swapping database, storage, and cache backends via configuration.
en.content: The repository includes the core gateway service, a React-based dashboard, official plugins (e.g., Chatwoot, Typebot), and community adapters. It offers Docker-native deployment and n8n integration nodes.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and NestJS, requires Node.js 22 LTS, supports SQLite/PostgreSQL for database, optional Redis cache, and Docker deployment.
en.hot: With 499 stars added this week and 13.8k total, it ranks #7 on the TypeScript weekly trending. Its open-source, pluggable architecture and full dashboard attract developers seeking self-hosted WhatsApp integration.
uses: Developers who want to build WhatsApp bots or integrate into business systems without relying on commercial API services.
Teams needing a WhatsApp gateway with multi-session management and granular access control (e.g., operator/viewer tokens).
Automation enthusiasts can combine with n8n or Chatwoot for customer support or marketing automation.

zh.tag: 自动构建个人知识库的跨平台桌面应用
zh.what: LLM Wiki 是一款跨平台桌面应用，能自动将你的文档转化为组织良好、相互关联的知识库。它摒弃了传统 RAG 每次从头检索的方式，而是让 LLM 增量构建并维护一个持久化的 wiki。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码，支持多格式文档解析、多模态图像提取、知识图谱、社区检测、深度研究等功能，并提供详细的 README 和中文等多语言文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，前端为桌面应用框架，后端包含 Rust 聊天代理，支持 LanceDB 向量搜索、MinerU PDF 处理，以及多种 LLM 模型配置。
zh.hot: 凭借自动构建知识库的独特理念和丰富的功能，在 GitHub 上获得 17k+ 星标，本周新增 453 星，登上 TypeScript 周榜第 15 名，受到知识管理爱好者和 AI 用户的广泛关注。
uses: 适合需要将大量文档转化为结构化知识库的研究人员、学生和知识工作者
适用于希望利用 AI 自动整理笔记、文献和网页剪辑的个人知识管理场景
对探索知识图谱、社区检测和深度研究功能感兴趣的技术爱好者和开发者

en.tag: Cross-platform desktop app that auto-builds a personal knowledge base
en.what: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop app that automatically turns your documents into an organized, interlinked knowledge base. Instead of traditional RAG, it uses LLM to incrementally build and maintain a persistent wiki from your sources.
en.content: The repository contains the full desktop app source code, featuring multi-format document parsing, multimodal image extraction, knowledge graph, community detection, deep research, and detailed README with multi-language support.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with a desktop app frontend and a Rust backend chat agent. Supports LanceDB vector search, MinerU PDF processing, and flexible LLM model configuration.
en.hot: With its unique concept of auto-building knowledge bases and rich features, it has gained 17k+ stars, adding 453 this week, ranking #15 on the TypeScript weekly trending list, attracting attention from knowledge management enthusiasts and AI users.
uses: Ideal for researchers, students, and knowledge workers who need to turn large document collections into structured knowledge bases
Perfect for personal knowledge management scenarios where AI automatically organizes notes, literature, and web clippings
Great for tech enthusiasts and developers interested in knowledge graphs, community detection, and deep research features

zh.tag: 用稳定命名本地URL替代端口号，面向开发者和AI代理
zh.what: Portless 是一个开发工具，让你用像 https://myapp.localhost 这样的稳定命名 URL 替代 localhost:3000 之类的端口号。它自动管理 HTTPS、端口分配和代理，简化本地开发体验，尤其适合人类和 AI 代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个命令行工具，通过全局或项目依赖安装。它生成本地 CA、绑定 443 端口并启动代理，自动将命名 URL 路由到分配的端口，支持多种框架和配置选项。
zh.stack: 主要用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 Node.js 生态，通过 npm 分发。涉及 HTTPS/HTTP2、代理、进程管理等技术。
zh.hot: 今日新增 450 星，总星数 12052，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜。它解决了开发中端口记忆和冲突的痛点，并迎合了 AI 代理对稳定 URL 的需求。
uses: 本地开发人员：告别端口号，使用易记的命名 URL 访问多个项目。
AI 代理开发者：为代理提供稳定的本地端点，便于自动化测试和交互。
团队协作：统一开发环境，减少端口冲突和配置问题。

en.tag: Replace port numbers with stable named local URLs for dev and agents
en.what: Portless is a dev tool that replaces port numbers with stable named URLs like https://myapp.localhost. It automatically handles HTTPS, port assignment, and proxying, simplifying local development for both humans and AI agents.
en.content: The repo contains a CLI tool installable globally or as a project dependency. It generates a local CA, binds port 443, and starts a proxy that routes named URLs to assigned ports, with support for many frameworks and configuration options.
en.stack: Written in TypeScript, distributed via npm, leveraging Node.js ecosystem. Involves HTTPS/HTTP2, proxying, and process management.
en.hot: Gained 450 stars today, total 12052, trending on GitHub. It solves the pain of remembering and conflicting ports, and caters to AI agents needing stable URLs.
uses: Local developers: replace port numbers with memorable named URLs for multiple projects.
AI agent developers: provide stable local endpoints for agents to automate testing and interaction.
Team collaboration: unify dev environment, reduce port conflicts and configuration issues.

zh.tag: Cursor 官方插件规范与精选插件集

插件开发者：参考规范与示例创建自己的 Cursor 插件

en.tag: Official Cursor plugin spec and curated plugins

Plugin developers: reference the spec and examples to create your own plugins
Teams: leverage Team Kit, Orchestrate, etc. to streamline CI/CD and parallel task handling

zh.tag: 一套核心，多端适配的 AI 编码代理工作流编排引擎
zh.what: AI-DLC Workflows 将 AI 编码代理转化为可验证、自纠错的工程工作流。它基于 AI-DLC 方法论，提供 14 个代理角色（11 个领域专家、2 个审查代理、1 个自适应工作流编排器）和 33 阶段流程，每个关卡需人工批准。

zh.hot: AWS 官方出品，将 AI 代理从单点工具升级为可治理的完整开发生命周期，契合企业级 AI 工程化需求。4.3k stars 且持续增长，登上 TypeScript 趋势榜。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程助手的开发者，希望获得结构化、可审查的开发流程

zh.tag: 让 AI 写作更像人：检测并改写 AI 腔的智能体技能
zh.what: 这是一个可移植的 AI 代理技能，用于审计和重写内容，去除常见的 AI 写作模式（如“Certainly!”、空洞的修饰语等）。它支持重写、检测和原地编辑三种模式，并可选语音风格（casual/professional 等），兼容 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex 等主流代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个可安装的 skill 定义（SKILL.md）、检测引擎（JavaScript 实现）、演示 GIF 和文档。核心是一个规则驱动的检测器，可标记 13 类 AI 写作模式，并执行多轮重写以彻底清除残留。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，采用规则/模式匹配而非机器学习，轻量且可嵌入任何 agentskills.io 兼容的代理。无外部依赖，MIT 许可。
zh.hot: 3,598 星且单日新增 133，登上 JavaScript 趋势榜第 8。AI 生成内容泛滥，开发者急需让输出“去 AI 味”的工具，而它恰好以 agent skill 形式即插即用。
uses: 内容创作者：用 Claude Code 等代理批量改写文章，去除 AI 腔，提升可读性。
开发者：在 CI 或本地用 Detect 模式审计 AI 生成的文档/提交信息，避免机械感。
团队：统一内容风格，通过 voice profile 定制专业、轻松或温暖等语气。
AI 代理开发者：集成此 skill 到自定义代理，增强文本后处理能力。

en.tag: Audit & rewrite AI-sounding text into natural prose, as a portable agent skill
en.what: A portable skill for AI agents that audits and rewrites content to remove common AI writing patterns ('AI-isms'). It offers three modes—rewrite, detect, and edit-in-place—plus optional voice profiles, and works with agents like Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Codex.
en.content: The repo contains a portable skill definition (SKILL.md), a JavaScript-based detection engine, a demo GIF, and docs. The core is a rule-driven detector that flags 13 categories of AI patterns and performs multi-pass rewriting to catch leftovers.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, using rule/pattern matching rather than ML, so it's lightweight and embeddable in any agentskills.io-compatible agent. No external dependencies, MIT licensed.
en.hot: With 3,598 stars and +133 today, it hit #8 on the JavaScript trending list. As AI-generated content floods the web, developers crave tools to make output sound human, and this skill plugs directly into their favorite agents.
uses: Content creators: use with Claude Code to rewrite articles in bulk, removing AI-isms for better readability.
Developers: run Detect mode in CI or locally to audit AI-generated docs/commit messages for robotic tone.
Teams: standardize content tone via voice profiles (casual, professional, warm, etc.).
Agent builders: integrate this skill into custom agents to enhance text post-processing.

zh.tag: 开源 API 客户端，本地优先的 Postman 替代品
zh.what: Bruno 是一款开源的 API 测试与探索 IDE，旨在颠覆 Postman 等传统工具。它采用纯文本标记语言 Bru 保存请求，集合直接存储在本地文件夹中，支持 Git 协作，且完全离线，注重数据隐私。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码（基于 Electron）、CLI 工具、Docker 支持，以及多语言文档和丰富的示例集合。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，基于 Electron 构建桌面应用，采用 Bru 标记语言，支持 Git 版本控制集成。
zh.hot: 凭借 46.7k 星标，Bruno 因本地优先、离线使用和 Git 协作等特性，成为 Postman 的轻量级替代品，受到开发者青睐。
uses: API 开发者：需要快速测试和调试 REST、GraphQL 等接口，但不想依赖云端同步。
注重隐私的团队：希望 API 集合数据完全保留在本地，避免上传到第三方服务器。
开源爱好者：偏好使用开源工具，并希望通过 Git 进行版本管理和团队协作。

en.tag: Open-source API client, offline-first alternative to Postman/Insomnia
en.what: Bruno is an open-source IDE for exploring and testing APIs, aiming to revolutionize the status quo of Postman and similar tools. It stores collections in local folders using a plain-text markup language called Bru, supports Git collaboration, and is fully offline-first, prioritizing data privacy.
en.content: The repository contains the full desktop app source (Electron-based), CLI tool, Docker support, and multi-language docs with rich examples.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, built with Electron for the desktop app, uses the Bru markup language, and integrates with Git for version control.
en.hot: With 46.7k stars, Bruno gains popularity as a lightweight Postman alternative due to its offline-first approach, local storage, and Git collaboration features.
uses: API developers who need quick testing and debugging of REST/GraphQL endpoints without cloud sync.
Privacy-conscious teams that want API collections to stay entirely on local devices.
Open-source enthusiasts who prefer tools with Git-based version control and collaboration.

zh.tag: 轻量灵活的 HTML5 图表库，用 canvas 绘制
zh.what: Chart.js 是一个基于 HTML5 canvas 的 JavaScript 图表库，让设计师和开发者能轻松创建响应式、可交互的图表。它支持多种常见图表类型，如折线图、柱状图、饼图等，并提供了丰富的配置选项和扩展机制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源码、文档、示例和测试。核心是 src 目录下的模块化代码，支持通过 npm 或 CDN 引入，并提供丰富的配置选项和插件系统。
zh.stack: 纯 JavaScript 实现，无外部依赖，基于 canvas 绘制。支持模块化打包（如 webpack、rollup），并兼容主流浏览器。
zh.hot: 作为老牌图表库，Chart.js 以简单易用和灵活性著称，star 数高达 67k+。尽管本周新增不多，但长期稳定，社区活跃，是许多项目的首选图表方案。
uses: 前端开发者快速为 Web 应用添加交互式图表，无需复杂配置
数据可视化项目需要轻量级、响应式图表且不引入重型框架
设计师或产品经理制作原型时，用 Chart.js 快速展示数据
教学和演示场景，用于讲解数据可视化基础

en.tag: Simple yet flexible HTML5 charting library using canvas
en.what: Chart.js is a JavaScript charting library based on HTML5 canvas, enabling designers and developers to easily create responsive, interactive charts. It supports various chart types like line, bar, pie, etc., with extensive configuration and extension capabilities.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, documentation, samples, and tests. The core is modular code in the src directory, installable via npm or CDN, with rich configuration options and a plugin system.
en.stack: Pure JavaScript implementation with no external dependencies, drawing on canvas. Supports modular bundling (e.g., webpack, rollup) and is compatible with major browsers.
en.hot: As a veteran charting library, Chart.js is known for simplicity and flexibility, with 67k+ stars. Although weekly additions are modest, it remains stable with an active community, making it a top choice for many projects.
uses: Frontend developers adding interactive charts to web apps quickly without complex setup
Data visualization projects needing lightweight, responsive charts without heavy frameworks
Designers or product managers prototyping with quick data displays
Educational contexts for teaching data visualization fundamentals

zh.tag: 把任意网站变成 CLI，让 AI 代理操作你的登录浏览器
zh.what: OpenCLI 能将任意网站、浏览器会话、Electron 应用和本地工具转换为确定性的命令行接口，供人类和 AI 代理使用。它还支持通过浏览器原语让 AI 代理在已登录的 Chrome 中执行导航、填表、点击和提取等操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 CLI 工具、内置适配器（如 Bilibili、知乎、小红书、Reddit、HackerNews、Twitter/X 等）、浏览器桥接扩展、桌面应用（OpenCLIApp）以及用于编写新适配器的技能（opencli-adapter-author）。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js（≥20.18.1）开发，通过 npm 分发；依赖 Chrome/Chromium 浏览器扩展和本地守护进程，并支持与 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 代理集成。
zh.hot: 本周新增 314 颗星，总星数达 2.9 万，登上 JavaScript 周榜第 16 名。它解决了 AI 代理无法操作登录态网站的痛点，提供统一的 CLI 接口，受到开发者和自动化爱好者的追捧。
uses: 开发者希望将常用网站（如 Bilibili、知乎）的操作脚本化，通过命令行快速获取数据或执行任务。
AI 代理（如 Claude Code、Cursor）用户需要让代理操作已登录的浏览器，完成表单填写、数据提取等自动化流程。
喜欢折腾的极客想为 Electron 应用（如 Cursor、ChatGPT）或本地工具（如 gh、docker）创建自定义 CLI 适配器。

en.tag: Turn any website into a CLI and let AI agents use your logged-in browser
en.what: OpenCLI converts any website, browser session, Electron app, or local tool into a deterministic CLI for humans and AI agents. It also enables AI agents to navigate, fill forms, click, and extract from any page via your logged-in browser.
en.content: The repo includes the core CLI tool, built-in adapters (e.g., Bilibili, Zhihu, Xiaohongshu, Reddit, HackerNews, Twitter/X), a browser bridge extension, a desktop app (OpenCLIApp), and skills like opencli-adapter-author for writing new adapters.
en.stack: Built on Node.js (>=20.18.1), distributed via npm; relies on a Chrome/Chromium browser extension and a local daemon, and integrates with AI agents like Claude Code and Cursor.
en.hot: Gained 314 stars this week, reaching 29k total and ranking #16 on the JavaScript weekly trending. It solves the pain point of AI agents not being able to use logged-in websites, offering a unified CLI interface, which appeals to developers and automation enthusiasts.
uses: Developers who want to script interactions with popular sites (e.g., Bilibili, Zhihu) via command line for quick data retrieval or task execution.
AI agent users (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) who need agents to operate a logged-in browser for form filling, data extraction, and other automation.
Power users who want to create custom CLI adapters for Electron apps (e.g., Cursor, ChatGPT) or local tools (e.g., gh, docker).

zh.tag: 轻量开源交互地图库，移动端友好
zh.what: Leaflet 是一个领先的开源 JavaScript 库，用于构建强大的交互式地图。它体积小（gzip 后约 40KB JS），但提供了开发者所需的大部分地图功能，并注重简洁性、性能和易用性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Leaflet 的源代码、文档、示例和构建工具。主要目录有 src（源代码）、dist（构建产物）、docs（文档）和 examples（示例）。
zh.stack: 纯 JavaScript 编写，无外部依赖，支持现代浏览器特性，同时兼容旧浏览器。可通过插件扩展，拥有大量第三方插件。
zh.hot: 尽管本周新增星数不多（47），但总星数高达 45.5k，长期稳居 JavaScript 热门榜。其稳定性、易用性和在乌克兰战争中的用途（如记录战争罪行）也提升了关注度。
uses: Web 开发者：快速在网页中嵌入交互式地图，无需复杂配置。
移动端开发者：利用其移动友好特性，构建响应式地图应用。
数据可视化：结合插件展示地理数据，如疫情地图、战争罪行记录。

en.tag: Lightweight open-source interactive map library, mobile-friendly
en.what: Leaflet is a leading open-source JavaScript library for building powerful interactive maps. It is lightweight (about 40KB gzipped JS) yet provides most mapping features developers need, designed with simplicity, performance, and usability in mind.
en.content: The repository contains Leaflet's source code, documentation, examples, and build tools. Main directories include src (source), dist (built files), docs (documentation), and examples.
en.stack: Written in pure JavaScript with no external dependencies, leveraging modern browser features while supporting older ones. Extensible via a huge number of plugins.
en.hot: Despite modest weekly stars (47), it has a huge total of 45.5k stars, consistently ranking in JavaScript trending. Its stability, ease of use, and use in Ukraine war documentation have also raised attention.
uses: Web developers: quickly embed interactive maps in web pages without complex setup.
Mobile developers: leverage its mobile-friendly features to build responsive map apps.
Data visualization: combine with plugins to display geographic data, such as pandemic maps or war crime documentation.

zh.tag: 免费无广告追剧资源精选指南，每日自动检测有效性
zh.what: 这是一个收集免费无广告追剧资源的指南，涵盖在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox/影视仓接口、IPTV直播源等。项目人工精选资源，并通过自动化脚本每天检测资源可用性，确保链接有效。完全开源，社区共同维护。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个资源列表（resources/resources.json），收录了114个资源，以及用于检测可用性和验证数据的GitHub Actions工作流。README提供分类导航和提交指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用JavaScript（用于自动化脚本），依赖GitHub Actions进行定时检测，数据以JSON格式存储。
zh.hot: 今日新增920星，总星数7531，登上JavaScript日榜第6。因其精准满足用户对免费无广告追剧资源的需求，且每日自动检测保证质量，社区活跃。
uses: 追剧爱好者：寻找免费无广告的在线影视资源，省去搜索烦恼。
影视开发者：获取TVBox/影视仓接口配置，快速搭建自己的影视应用。
IPTV用户：获取直播源，在电视或手机上观看直播频道。
资源贡献者：提交新资源，参与社区维护，共同完善指南。

en.tag: Curated free & ad-free drama resources, auto-checked daily
en.what: This is a guide collecting free and ad-free drama-watching resources, covering online video, apps, cloud search, magnet/BT, subtitles, TVBox interfaces, IPTV streams, etc. Resources are manually curated and automatically checked daily for availability. Fully open source, maintained by the community.
en.content: The repo contains a resource list (resources/resources.json) with 114 entries, plus GitHub Actions workflows for availability checks and data validation. The README provides categorized navigation and submission guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript for automation scripts, relies on GitHub Actions for scheduled checks, data stored in JSON format.
en.hot: Gained 920 stars today, total 7531, ranked #6 on JavaScript daily trending. It precisely meets the demand for free ad-free drama resources, with daily auto-checks ensuring quality, fostering an active community.
uses: Drama enthusiasts: find free ad-free online video resources, saving search time.
Developers: obtain TVBox/影视仓 API configs to quickly build their own video apps.
IPTV users: get live stream sources to watch channels on TV or mobile.
Contributors: submit new resources, join community maintenance, and improve the guide.

zh.tag: 超高效消息流平台，Rust 实现，主打极速与持久化
zh.what: Apache Iggy 是一个用 Rust 编写的持久化消息流平台，旨在提供极致的性能和效率。它支持流、主题、分区和消费者组，可实现高吞吐、低延迟的消息传递，并具备数据持久化能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心服务器、命令行客户端（iggy-cli）、多种语言的 SDK（Rust、JavaScript、Python、Java、.NET），以及示例和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，基于 Tokio 异步运行时，支持 TCP 和 QUIC 传输协议，并利用 Sled 或内存存储作为持久化后端。
zh.hot: 本周新增 194 星，总星数达 4792，位列 GitHub Trending Rust 周榜第一。其“激光速度”的定位和 Apache 背书吸引了大量关注，且多语言 SDK 降低了使用门槛。
uses: 需要高吞吐、低延迟消息传递的实时数据管道和事件驱动架构。
作为微服务间通信的可靠消息中间件，替代 Kafka 或 RabbitMQ 的轻量级选择。
对数据持久化和流处理有严格要求的物联网、金融或游戏后端场景。

en.tag: Hyper-efficient persistent message streaming platform in Rust, laser-fast
en.what: Apache Iggy is a persistent message streaming platform written in Rust, designed for extreme performance and efficiency. It supports streams, topics, partitions, and consumer groups, enabling high-throughput, low-latency messaging with data persistence.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust core server, a CLI client (iggy-cli), SDKs for multiple languages (Rust, JavaScript, Python, Java, .NET), plus examples and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built on the Tokio async runtime, supports TCP and QUIC transport protocols, and uses Sled or in-memory storage for persistence.
en.hot: Gained 194 stars this week, reaching 4,792 total, ranking #1 on GitHub Trending Rust weekly. Its 'laser speed' positioning and Apache backing attract attention, and multi-language SDKs lower the adoption barrier.
uses: Real-time data pipelines and event-driven architectures requiring high throughput and low latency.
A lightweight alternative to Kafka or RabbitMQ for reliable messaging between microservices.
IoT, financial, or gaming backends with strict requirements for data persistence and stream processing.

zh.tag: 基于 aircrack-ng 的图形化 WiFi 安全审计工具
zh.what: Airgorah 是一款 WiFi 安全审计软件，能够捕获附近的 WiFi 流量、发现连接到接入点的客户端、执行去认证攻击、捕获握手包并破解接入点密码。它基于 aircrack-ng 工具套件，使用 Rust 编写，并提供 GTK4 图形界面。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心逻辑、GTK4 图形界面（crates/gui）、以及通过 polkit 提权的特权代理（airgorah-agent）。提供安装和使用文档（wiki），并附带应用图标和截图。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，图形部分基于 GTK4（gtk4-rs）。依赖 aircrack-ng 工具套件，需要支持监听模式和包注入的无线网卡。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1180 星，总星数达 3001，位列 GitHub Trending（Rust）周榜第二。其图形化界面降低了 WiFi 安全审计的门槛，且基于 Rust 性能与安全性俱佳，吸引了大量安全爱好者和研究者。
uses: 网络安全研究人员：用于测试自家 WiFi 网络的安全性，发现漏洞。
渗透测试人员：在授权测试中快速捕获握手包并破解密码。
Rust 开发者：学习如何使用 GTK4 构建跨平台 GUI 应用。
WiFi 爱好者：探索无线网络协议与安全机制。

en.tag: GUI WiFi security auditing tool based on aircrack-ng
en.what: Airgorah is a WiFi security auditing software that captures nearby WiFi traffic, discovers clients connected to access points, performs deauthentication attacks, captures handshakes, and cracks access point passwords. It is based on the aircrack-ng suite, written in Rust, and features a GTK4 GUI.
en.content: The repository contains Rust core logic, a GTK4 GUI (crates/gui), and a privileged agent (airgorah-agent) that elevates via polkit. It includes installation and usage documentation (wiki), along with app icons and screenshots.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with GUI based on GTK4 (gtk4-rs). It depends on the aircrack-ng suite and requires a wireless card supporting monitor mode and packet injection.
en.hot: Gained 1,180 stars this week, reaching 3,001 total, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending (Rust) weekly. Its GUI lowers the barrier to WiFi security auditing, and being Rust-based offers performance and safety, attracting security enthusiasts and researchers.
uses: Security researchers: to test the security of their own WiFi networks and discover vulnerabilities.
Penetration testers: to quickly capture handshakes and crack passwords during authorized tests.
Rust developers: to learn how to build cross-platform GUI apps with GTK4.
WiFi enthusiasts: to explore wireless protocols and security mechanisms.

zh.tag: 为无服务器计算打造的安全快速微型虚拟机
zh.what: Firecracker 是一种开源虚拟化技术，专为创建和管理安全、多租户的容器及函数服务而设计。它通过轻量级虚拟机（microVM）结合硬件虚拟化的安全隔离与容器的速度灵活性，为无服务器计算提供高效运行环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Firecracker 的虚拟化监视器（VMM）核心代码，基于 KVM 创建和运行 microVM，并附有构建、测试、运行及生产环境配置的文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 Linux KVM 虚拟化技术，支持在 Unix/Linux 系统上通过 Docker 构建。
zh.hot: Firecracker 由 AWS 开发并开源，支撑 AWS Lambda 和 Fargate 等核心服务，凭借极低开销和高安全性在无服务器领域广受关注，目前已有 36k+ stars。
uses: 无服务器平台开发者：需要安全、快速启动的微VM来运行函数或容器工作负载。
容器运行时集成：如 Kata Containers 等，利用 Firecracker 提供更强的隔离性。
云基础设施团队：构建多租户环境，降低资源开销并提高硬件利用率。

en.tag: Secure and fast microVMs for serverless computing
en.what: Firecracker is an open-source virtualization technology purpose-built for creating and managing secure, multi-tenant container and function-based services. It runs workloads in lightweight microVMs that combine hardware virtualization security with container speed and flexibility, enabling efficient serverless computing.
en.content: The repository contains the core VMM code of Firecracker, which uses KVM to create and run microVMs, along with documentation for building, testing, running, and production host setup.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Rust, relies on Linux KVM for virtualization, and can be built on Unix/Linux systems with Docker.
en.hot: Developed by AWS and open-sourced, Firecracker powers AWS Lambda and Fargate, gaining popularity for its minimal overhead and high security in serverless computing, with 36k+ stars.
uses: Serverless platform developers: need secure, fast-booting microVMs for function or container workloads.
Container runtime integrators: such as Kata Containers, leveraging Firecracker for stronger isolation.
Cloud infrastructure teams: building multi-tenant environments to reduce overhead and increase hardware utilization.

zh.tag: Rust 即时模式 GUI 库，跨 Web 与原生
zh.what: egui 是一个用 Rust 编写的即时模式 GUI 库，旨在成为最简单易用的 Rust GUI 解决方案。它支持 Web、原生桌面以及游戏引擎集成，让开发者能够快速构建交互界面。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库 egui、官方框架 eframe、示例代码、集成指南及文档。核心 API 提供布局、控件、绘图等功能，并支持主题切换。
zh.stack: 纯 Rust 实现，无 unsafe 代码；依赖少，可编译到 WebAssembly，支持与游戏引擎集成。
zh.hot: 本周新增 216 星，总星数达 30.4k，位居 Rust 周榜第七。其易用性和跨平台能力吸引了大量 Rust 开发者。
uses: Rust 开发者希望快速构建桌面或 Web 应用界面
游戏引擎开发者需要内置调试工具或编辑器 UI
需要轻量级 GUI 且避免复杂框架的嵌入式或工具开发

en.tag: Easy-to-use immediate mode GUI library in Rust for web and native
en.what: egui is an immediate mode GUI library written in Rust, aiming to be the easiest-to-use GUI library for Rust. It runs on web, natively, and inside game engines, enabling rapid development of interactive interfaces.
en.content: The repository contains the core egui library, the official eframe framework, examples, integration guides, and documentation. The core API offers layout, widgets, painting, and theme switching.
en.stack: Pure Rust, no unsafe code; minimal dependencies, compiles to WebAssembly, and integrates with game engines.

en.what: fff is a Rust-based file search toolkit designed for AI agents and humans, offering fast and accurate file search. It supports path and content search, frequency-ranked file access, a background watcher, and a lightweight in-memory content index, outperforming CLIs like ripgrep and fzf in long-running processes.
en.content: The repo includes a Rust core library, an MCP server, a Neovim plugin, a CLI tool, and bindings for multiple languages (Python, NodeJS, Bun).
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with bindings for C, Python, NodeJS, Bun, and support for the MCP protocol.
en.hot: With the surge in AI agents needing efficient file search, fff gained popularity for its speed and accuracy, adding 204 stars this week and surpassing 10k total stars.
uses: AI agent developers: provide fast file search to agents, reducing grep roundtrips and saving context.
Neovim users: use as a plugin for improved file finding.
Developers needing high-performance file search: integrate fff library in Rust, Python, NodeJS projects.

zh.tag: 为 git 等命令提供语法高亮的分页器
zh.what: delta 是一个命令行工具，作为 git、diff、grep 等命令的分页器，提供语法高亮和增强的差异显示。它支持词级差异高亮、并排视图、行号等功能，让代码审查更直观。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档、安装脚本和配置文件。核心是一个可执行文件 delta，通过配置集成到 git 中。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖 bat 的语法高亮主题，利用 Levenshtein 编辑推断算法实现词级差异。
zh.hot: 拥有 3.2 万 star，因其显著提升 git 输出可读性而广受欢迎，是开发者日常工具链的必备品。
uses: 开发者日常使用 git 命令行时，希望获得更清晰、高亮的 diff 输出。
需要高效审查大型代码变更，利用并排视图和导航键快速浏览。
喜欢自定义终端配色和样式，追求个性化开发环境的用户。

en.tag: A syntax-highlighting pager for git, diff, grep, and more
en.what: Delta is a command-line tool that acts as a pager for git, diff, grep, and other commands, providing syntax highlighting and enhanced diff display. It supports word-level diff highlighting, side-by-side view, line numbers, and more, making code review more intuitive.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation, installation scripts, and configuration files. The core is an executable named delta, integrated into git via configuration.
en.stack: Written in Rust, it uses bat's syntax highlighting themes and a Levenshtein edit inference algorithm for word-level diffs.
en.hot: With 31,977 stars, it's popular for dramatically improving git output readability, making it a must-have in developers' daily toolchains.
uses: Developers who use git CLI daily and want clearer, syntax-highlighted diff output.
Those reviewing large code changes efficiently with side-by-side view and navigation keys.
Users who enjoy customizing terminal colors and styles for a personalized dev environment.

zh.tag: 快速、节省磁盘空间的 Node.js 包管理器
zh.what: pnpm 是一个快速且节省磁盘空间的 Node.js 包管理器，通过内容寻址存储来链接文件，避免重复下载。它支持 monorepo，提供严格的依赖访问控制，并具有确定性的锁文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 pnpm 的完整源代码、文档、基准测试脚本，以及一个用 Rust 编写的实验性 CLI 移植版本（pacquet）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript/TypeScript 编写，并包含 Rust 组件（pacquet）。依赖 Node.js 生态，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS。
zh.hot: pnpm 因其卓越的性能和磁盘效率而广受欢迎，在 GitHub 上拥有 36,310 颗星，并持续获得关注。其 Rust 移植版本也吸引了开发者的兴趣。
uses: 适用于大型 monorepo 项目，可显著减少依赖安装时间和磁盘占用。
适合对包管理性能有严格要求的开发团队，尤其是 CI/CD 环境。
适合希望使用严格依赖隔离和确定性锁文件的 Node.js 开发者。

en.tag: Fast, disk space efficient package manager for Node.js
en.what: pnpm is a fast and disk space efficient package manager for Node.js. It links files from a single content-addressable storage to avoid duplication, supports monorepos, enforces strict dependency access, and provides deterministic lockfiles.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, benchmark scripts, and an experimental Rust port of the CLI called pacquet.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript/TypeScript with a Rust component (pacquet). Depends on Node.js ecosystem, supports Windows, Linux, and macOS.
en.hot: pnpm is popular for its superior performance and disk efficiency, with 36,310 stars on GitHub and ongoing attention. Its Rust port also attracts developers.
uses: Ideal for large monorepo projects, significantly reducing install time and disk usage.
Suitable for teams with strict performance requirements, especially in CI/CD environments.
Great for Node.js developers who want strict dependency isolation and deterministic lockfiles.

zh.tag: 用众包提示词增强人类的开源AI框架
zh.what: Fabric 是一个开源框架，旨在通过 AI 增强人类能力。它提供模块化系统，利用众包提示词解决特定问题，可在任何地方使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的命令行工具、提示词模式集合（patterns）、文档、示例和 REST API 服务器。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 AI 模型 API（如 OpenAI），支持命令行和 REST API 接口。
zh.hot: 拥有 43.7k 星标，今日新增 103，因其解决了 AI 集成问题，将提示词组织为可复用模式，受到开发者追捧。
uses: 开发者希望将 AI 提示词系统化并集成到工作流中
命令行爱好者寻求高效使用 AI 的模块化工具
团队需要共享和标准化 AI 提示词以提升协作效率

en.tag: Open-source framework for augmenting humans with crowdsourced AI prompts
en.what: Fabric is an open-source framework for augmenting humans using AI. It provides a modular system for solving specific problems using a crowdsourced set of AI prompts that can be used anywhere.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-based CLI, a collection of prompt patterns, documentation, examples, and a REST API server.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it relies on AI model APIs (e.g., OpenAI) and provides both CLI and REST API interfaces.
en.hot: With 43.7k stars and 103 added today, it's popular for solving AI integration by organizing prompts into reusable patterns, appealing to developers.
uses: Developers looking to systematize AI prompts and integrate them into workflows
CLI enthusiasts seeking modular tools for efficient AI usage
Teams needing to share and standardize AI prompts for better collaboration

zh.tag: 通用代理平台，支持多协议与多平台
zh.what: sing-box 是一个通用代理平台，提供高性能的网络代理功能，支持多种代理协议（如 Shadowsocks、VMess、Trojan 等）和平台（包括 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android 等）。它旨在为用户提供灵活、可配置的代理解决方案，适用于各种网络环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含 sing-box 的源代码、构建脚本、文档（位于 sing-box.sagernet.org）以及许可证信息。项目使用 Go 语言编写，提供命令行工具，可通过配置文件进行定制。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖多种网络库，支持多平台编译。
zh.hot: sing-box 因其强大的功能和灵活性在 GitHub 上获得 37k+ 星标，今日新增 30 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 19 名，持续受到网络代理用户的关注。
uses: 适合需要科学上网或绕过网络限制的个人用户，提供稳定高效的代理服务。
适用于开发者或系统管理员，用于搭建自定义代理服务器或集成到现有网络架构中。
适合对隐私和安全性有较高要求的用户，通过代理加密流量保护数据。

en.tag: Universal proxy platform supporting multiple protocols and platforms
en.what: sing-box is a universal proxy platform that provides high-performance network proxying capabilities, supporting multiple proxy protocols (such as Shadowsocks, VMess, Trojan, etc.) and platforms (including Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, etc.). It aims to offer flexible and configurable proxy solutions for various network environments.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, build scripts, documentation (hosted at sing-box.sagernet.org), and license information. The project is written in Go and provides a command-line tool that can be customized via configuration files.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging various networking libraries, and supports cross-platform compilation.
en.hot: sing-box has gained 37k+ stars on GitHub due to its powerful features and flexibility, with 30 new stars today, ranking 19th on the Go trending list, continuing to attract attention from proxy users.
uses: Ideal for individual users needing to bypass network restrictions or access blocked content, providing stable and efficient proxy services.
Suitable for developers or system administrators to set up custom proxy servers or integrate into existing network infrastructure.
Great for users with high privacy and security requirements, encrypting traffic to protect data.

zh.tag: 可编程的异构LLM推理路由层，构建混合模型系统
zh.what: vLLM Semantic Router 是一个可编程的路由层，用于在异构 LLM 基础设施上构建 Mixture-of-Models 系统。它评估请求信号、用户偏好和应用策略，为每个请求选择或组合合适的模型路径，从而在不硬编码路由逻辑的情况下优化质量、成本、延迟、隐私和安全性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 实现的路由器核心、安装脚本、文档站点（website/）、以及示例和配置。提供在线 Playground 和 Hugging Face 集成，支持 v0.3 Themis 等版本发布。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 vLLM 生态，可能集成 Hugging Face 模型和云/边缘计算资源。
zh.hot: 随着 LLM 应用多样化，对混合模型路由的需求增长，该仓库提供可编程路由方案，今日新增 28 星，登上 Go 趋势榜第 3 名。
uses: 需要优化 LLM 推理成本与延迟的工程团队，通过路由策略动态选择模型。
构建多模型系统（MoM）的开发者，希望根据请求内容智能组合模型输出。
关注数据隐私的企业，利用路由将敏感数据保留在本地或私有云。
研究人员探索信号驱动的路由算法，可基于此进行实验和扩展。

en.tag: Programmable routing layer for heterogeneous LLM inference to build Mixture-of-Models systems
en.what: vLLM Semantic Router is a programmable routing layer for building Mixture-of-Models systems across heterogeneous LLM infrastructure. It evaluates request signals, user preferences, and application policies to select or compose the right model path for each request, improving quality, cost, latency, privacy, and safety without hard-coding routing logic.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based router core, installation scripts, documentation site (website/), examples, and configurations. It offers an online Playground and Hugging Face integration, with releases like v0.3 Themis.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, leveraging the vLLM ecosystem, with potential integrations with Hugging Face models and cloud/edge compute resources.
en.hot: As LLM applications diversify, the need for Mixture-of-Models routing grows; this repo offers a programmable solution, gaining 28 stars today and ranking #3 on Go trending.
uses: Engineering teams optimizing LLM inference cost and latency by dynamically routing requests to appropriate models.
Developers building Mixture-of-Models systems who want to intelligently compose model outputs based on request content.
Enterprises concerned with data privacy, using routing to keep sensitive data within local or private cloud boundaries.
Researchers exploring signal-driven routing algorithms, can experiment and extend based on this project.

zh.tag: 拦截AI爬虫的HTTP请求守卫
zh.what: Anubis 是一个用 Go 编写的反向代理，通过工作量证明（Proof-of-Work）挑战来验证 HTTP 请求是否来自真实用户，从而阻止 AI 爬虫和恶意机器人访问网站。它能够识别并过滤掉那些不遵守 robots.txt 的 AI 抓取工具，保护网站内容不被未经授权的抓取。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的代理服务器核心代码、Web 界面（用于展示挑战页面）、Docker 部署配置、文档和示例配置。项目结构清晰，包含 cmd、internal、web 等目录，并提供预构建的 Docker 镜像。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖标准库和少量第三方库（如 chi 路由器）。支持 Docker 部署，并集成 Prometheus 监控指标。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 爬虫日益泛滥，网站管理员急需有效的防护工具。Anubis 以 2.2 万星标和每日新增 100+ 的速度迅速走红，成为 GitHub Go 趋势榜常客，反映了社区对反爬虫解决方案的强烈需求。
uses: 网站管理员：保护个人博客或小型网站免受 AI 爬虫抓取内容
开发者：集成到现有服务中，作为反向代理层过滤恶意机器人
运维团队：通过 Docker 快速部署，为多个站点提供统一防护

en.tag: HTTP request guardian that blocks AI crawlers
en.what: Anubis is a Go-based reverse proxy that uses Proof-of-Work challenges to verify if HTTP requests come from real users, thereby blocking AI crawlers and malicious bots. It identifies and filters out AI scraping tools that ignore robots.txt, protecting website content from unauthorized scraping.
en.content: The repository contains the Go proxy server core code, a web interface for displaying challenge pages, Docker deployment configs, documentation, and example configurations. The project has a clear structure with cmd, internal, web directories, and provides pre-built Docker images.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, using the standard library and a few third-party libraries (e.g., chi router). Supports Docker deployment and integrates Prometheus metrics.
en.hot: With the proliferation of AI crawlers, website administrators urgently need effective protection tools. Anubis has gained 22k stars and adds 100+ daily, becoming a regular on GitHub Go trending, reflecting the community's strong demand for anti-crawler solutions.
uses: Website admins: Protect personal blogs or small sites from AI crawlers scraping content
Developers: Integrate into existing services as a reverse proxy layer to filter malicious bots
Ops teams: Deploy quickly via Docker to provide unified protection for multiple sites

zh.tag: 自托管的开源任务管理器，数据完全自主掌控
zh.what: Vikunja 是一个功能全面的任务管理工具，支持看板、列表、表格等多种视图，以及团队协作、时间跟踪、文件附件等特性。它强调用户对数据的完全掌控，可自托管部署，也提供云端托管服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含后端服务（Go 编写）、前端 Web 应用、桌面客户端（Electron）以及移动端应用（通过 Flutter 实现），并提供完整的 API 文档和安装指南。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go 语言，支持 SQLite、PostgreSQL 和 MySQL 数据库；前端基于 Vue.js，桌面端使用 Electron，移动端使用 Flutter。
zh.hot: 本周新增 78 星，总星数 5258，位列 Go 语言周榜第 19 名。其自托管、数据自主的理念受到关注，且项目活跃，持续迭代。
uses: 个人用户希望完全掌控自己的任务数据，避免依赖第三方云服务
团队需要自建任务管理系统，并希望有看板、时间跟踪等高级功能
开发者想研究 Go 后端与前端分离的完整项目架构

en.tag: Self-hosted open-source task manager with full data ownership
en.what: Vikunja is a feature-rich task manager supporting kanban, list, table views, team collaboration, time tracking, file attachments, and more. It emphasizes full data ownership, allowing self-hosting or using the hosted cloud service.
en.content: The repository includes a backend service written in Go, a frontend web app, a desktop client (Electron), and mobile apps (via Flutter), along with comprehensive API docs and installation guides.
en.stack: Backend in Go with SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL support; frontend built with Vue.js; desktop via Electron; mobile via Flutter.
en.hot: Gained 78 stars this week, total 5258, ranking #19 on the Go weekly trending. Its self-hosting and data ownership philosophy attracts attention, with active development.
uses: Individuals who want full control over their task data without relying on third-party cloud services
Teams needing a self-hosted task management system with advanced features like kanban and time tracking
Developers interested in studying a full-stack project with Go backend and separate frontend

zh.tag: 让 AI 编码助手写出符合现代 Go 规范的代码
zh.what: JetBrains 官方项目，为 AI 编码代理提供一套规则，使其生成代码时优先使用现代 Go 语言特性和标准库 API（如 slices.Contains、cmp.Or 等）。它解决了模型训练数据滞后和频率偏差导致的过时代码问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含 FEATURES.md（完整特性列表及示例）和面向不同代理（Junie、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor）的安装说明，通过 marketplace 或 skills.sh 分发。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Go 编写，要求 Go 1.25+，通过 go install 安装 CLI，不修改用户项目。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1213 星，位列趋势榜第 4，因为 AI 编码日益普及，开发者急需让代理生成符合现代实践的代码。
uses: 使用 AI 编码助手（如 Junie、Claude Code）的 Go 开发者，希望生成更符合现代规范的代码。
团队希望统一 Go 代码风格，减少人工审查中纠正过时写法的工作量。
对 Go 新特性（如 Go 1.26 的 errors.AsType）感兴趣的开发者，可参考特性列表学习。

en.tag: Guidelines to make AI coding agents write modern Go code
en.what: An official JetBrains project providing guidelines for AI coding agents to generate modern Go code, preferring recent language features and stdlib APIs like slices.Contains and cmp.Or. It addresses outdated code caused by training data lag and frequency bias.
en.content: Contains FEATURES.md with a complete list of features and examples, plus installation instructions for various agents (Junie, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) via marketplace or skills.sh.
en.stack: Primarily Go-based, requires Go 1.25+, installs a CLI via go install, and never modifies user projects.
en.hot: Gained 1213 stars this week, ranking #4 on trending, as AI coding adoption grows and developers seek to ensure agents produce modern code.
uses: Go developers using AI coding assistants like Junie or Claude Code to generate more idiomatic code.
Teams aiming to standardize Go code style and reduce manual review effort for outdated patterns.
Developers interested in learning new Go features (e.g., errors.AsType from Go 1.26) via the feature list.

zh.tag: 为AI代理打造的即时、并发、安全、轻量级沙箱服务
zh.what: CubeSandbox 是一个高性能的沙箱服务，基于 RustVMM 和 KVM 构建，为 AI 代理提供硬件级隔离的运行环境。它能在 60 毫秒内创建沙箱，内存开销小于 5MB，支持单节点部署和轻松扩展到多节点集群。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的沙箱服务实现，包括 RustVMM 和 KVM 集成、E2B 兼容的 API、Python SDK（PyPI 包）、文档、快速入门指南和变更日志。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，底层依赖 RustVMM 和 KVM 实现硬件级虚拟化。提供 Python SDK，兼容 E2B SDK。
zh.hot: 凭借极快的启动速度（60ms）和极低的内存开销（<5MB），以及 E2B 兼容性，迅速获得开发者关注，GitHub 日榜 Go 语言第 2 名，star 数已超 1.1 万。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要安全、隔离的环境来执行代码或运行工具，确保代理行为可控。
平台工程师：构建多租户沙箱服务，用于代码执行、数据处理或安全测试。
教育场景：为学生提供安全的编程练习环境，避免影响宿主机。

en.tag: Instant, concurrent, secure & lightweight sandbox service for AI agents
en.what: CubeSandbox is a high-performance sandbox service built on RustVMM and KVM, providing hardware-isolated runtime environments for AI agents. It can create a sandbox in under 60ms with less than 5MB memory overhead, supporting single-node deployment and easy scaling to multi-node clusters.
en.content: The repository contains the full sandbox service implementation, including RustVMM and KVM integration, E2B-compatible API, Python SDK (PyPI package), documentation, quickstart guide, and changelog.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging RustVMM and KVM for hardware-level virtualization. Provides a Python SDK and is compatible with the E2B SDK.
en.hot: With ultra-fast startup (60ms) and low memory overhead (<5MB), plus E2B compatibility, it quickly gained developer attention, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending for Go and amassing over 11k stars.
uses: AI agent developers: need secure, isolated environments to execute code or run tools, ensuring agent behavior is controlled.
Platform engineers: build multi-tenant sandbox services for code execution, data processing, or security testing.
Educational scenarios: provide students with safe programming practice environments without affecting the host machine.

zh.tag: 自托管 CPA/CLIProxyAPI 管理面板与 AI 网关可观测性仪表盘
zh.what: 这是一个自托管的 CPA/CLIProxyAPI 管理面板，提供 AI 网关的可观测性仪表盘，用于监控请求、用量、成本、配额、失败和账户健康。它支持管理提供商、凭证、OAuth、插件和配置，并将请求历史、成本分析和账户自动化数据存储在本地。
zh.content: 仓库包含仪表盘、请求监控、用量分析、凭证管理和健康检查等界面，以及文档和 Docker 部署配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，支持 Docker 部署，前端可能使用 Web 技术构建。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 日榜上排名第六，拥有 3033 颗星，因其解决了 AI 网关管理中的关键痛点，如成本追踪和账户健康监控，受到开发者关注。
uses: 适用于使用 CPA/CLIProxyAPI 的开发者，需要监控 AI 请求成本和配额。
适合管理多个 AI 提供商凭证和账户健康的管理员。
用于需要本地存储请求历史和成本分析的企业或团队。

en.tag: Self-hosted CPA/CLIProxyAPI management panel and AI gateway observability dashboard
en.what: It is a self-hosted management panel for CPA/CLIProxyAPI, offering an AI gateway observability dashboard for requests, usage, cost, quota, failures, and account health. It manages providers, credentials, OAuth, plugins, and configuration while keeping persistent request history, cost analytics, and account automation in local storage.
en.content: The repository includes dashboard, request monitoring, usage analytics, credential management, and health inspection interfaces, along with documentation and Docker deployment configuration.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, supports Docker deployment, and the frontend is likely built with web technologies.
en.hot: Ranked 6th on GitHub Trending with 3033 stars, it gained attention for addressing key pain points in AI gateway management, such as cost tracking and account health monitoring.
uses: For developers using CPA/CLIProxyAPI who need to monitor AI request costs and quotas.
For administrators managing multiple AI provider credentials and account health.
For enterprises or teams requiring local storage of request history and cost analytics.

zh.tag: 可扩展的覆盖网络工具，兼顾性能、简单与安全
zh.what: Nebula 是一个可扩展的覆盖网络工具，旨在让分布在世界各地的计算机无缝连接。它基于 Noise 协议框架，使用证书认证节点身份，并通过灯塔节点实现 NAT 穿透，支持从少量到数万台设备的组网。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Nebula 的核心代码，包括证书管理、加密通信、安全组、灯塔节点等模块，以及适用于 Linux、Windows、macOS、FreeBSD 等平台的构建文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Noise 协议框架、椭圆曲线 Diffie-Hellman 密钥交换和 AES-256-GCM 加密。
zh.hot: Nebula 在 GitHub 上拥有 18k+ stars，今日新增 25 个，位列 Go 趋势榜第五，因其高性能、简单易用和安全性受到广泛关注。
uses: 适用于需要跨地域、跨云服务商安全组网的开发者和运维人员。
适合构建分布式系统或边缘计算场景，需要低延迟、高安全性的网络连接。
可用于个人或企业快速搭建虚拟专用网络，替代传统 VPN 方案。

en.tag: A scalable overlay networking tool focusing on performance, simplicity, and security
en.what: Nebula is a scalable overlay networking tool that enables seamless connection of computers worldwide. Built on the Noise Protocol Framework, it uses certificates for node authentication and lighthouse nodes for NAT traversal, supporting networks from a few to tens of thousands of devices.
en.content: The repository contains the core code of Nebula, including modules for certificate management, encrypted communication, security groups, lighthouse nodes, and build files for Linux, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging the Noise Protocol Framework, Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman key exchange, and AES-256-GCM encryption.
en.hot: With over 18k stars and 25 new stars today, ranking 5th on the Go trending list, Nebula gains attention for its high performance, simplicity, and security.
uses: For developers and operators needing secure networking across regions and cloud providers.
Ideal for distributed systems or edge computing requiring low-latency, high-security connections.
Can be used to quickly set up virtual private networks for individuals or enterprises, replacing traditional VPN solutions.

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 编程代理会话搜索与分析工具
zh.what: AgentsView 是一个本地优先的工具，用于浏览、搜索和跟踪所有 AI 编程代理（如 Claude Code、Codex 等 20 多种）的会话记录和成本。它无需账户，所有数据都存储在本地，提供 Web UI 和命令行接口。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 Go 编写的二进制文件，提供 serve、daemon、session、usage 等子命令，支持 SQLite 存储、S3 集成、Docker 部署，以及桌面应用（macOS/Windows）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 SQLite 数据库，支持 S3 兼容对象存储，提供 Docker 镜像和 Homebrew 安装方式。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编程代理的普及，开发者需要统一管理多个代理的会话和成本，AgentsView 提供了本地优先的解决方案，因此在 GitHub 上迅速获得关注，今日新增 142 星。
uses: 使用多个 AI 编程代理（如 Claude Code、Codex）的开发者，希望集中查看会话历史和 token 消耗。
需要监控 AI 编程成本并生成使用报告的个人或团队。
对数据隐私敏感，希望所有会话数据保留在本地的用户。
希望通过 S3 同步或 Docker 部署实现跨设备会话管理的用户。

en.tag: Local-first session search, analytics, and token usage stats for AI coding agents
en.what: AgentsView is a local-first tool for browsing, searching, and tracking sessions and costs across all your AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, and 20+ others). No accounts required; all data stays local, with a web UI and CLI.
en.content: The repo contains a Go binary with subcommands like serve, daemon, session, usage; supports SQLite storage, S3 integration, Docker deployment, and a desktop app (macOS/Windows).
en.stack: Primarily Go, with SQLite database, S3-compatible object storage support, Docker image, and Homebrew cask.
en.hot: With the rise of AI coding agents, developers need a unified way to manage sessions and costs across multiple agents; AgentsView offers a local-first solution, gaining rapid traction with 142 stars today.
uses: Developers using multiple AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) who want a unified view of session history and token usage.
Individuals or teams needing to monitor AI coding costs and generate usage reports.
Privacy-conscious users who want all session data to remain local.
Users who want cross-device session management via S3 sync or Docker deployment.

zh.tag: 为智能体系统打造的毫秒级模型路由网关
zh.what: 这是一个模型路由器，专为智能体系统设计，能在50毫秒内将每个提示词路由到最合适的模型。只需更改端点，即可降低40-70%的成本。

zh.stack: 主要使用Go语言开发，可能依赖HTTP框架和并发处理库，以支持低延迟路由。

适合对API响应时间敏感的生产环境，要求毫秒级路由决策。
适合希望快速集成并降低LLM调用成本的企业团队，只需简单端点变更。

en.tag: A millisecond-level model router for agentic systems
en.what: It is a model router for agentic systems, routing every prompt to the right model in under 50ms. By simply changing an endpoint, you can cut costs by 40-70%.

Production environments sensitive to API response time, requiring millisecond-level routing decisions.
Teams looking to quickly integrate and reduce LLM call costs with a simple endpoint change.

zh.tag: 基于 WireGuard 的零配置安全组网工具
zh.what: Tailscale 是一个基于 WireGuard 协议的组网工具，旨在让用户轻松创建和管理私有网络。它提供了跨平台的守护进程和命令行工具，支持多种操作系统，并集成了双因素认证（2FA）以增强安全性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Tailscale 的大部分开源代码，包括核心守护进程 tailscaled 和命令行工具 tailscale。此外，还提供了构建脚本和文档，便于用户自行编译和打包。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，要求最新的 Go 版本（当前为 Go 1.27）。构建时可以使用官方 Go 分支或标准 Go，并提供了 build_dist.sh 脚本以嵌入版本信息。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的 WireGuard 组网方案之一，Tailscale 凭借其易用性和安全性吸引了大量用户，本周新增 445 个 star，总 star 数达到 36089，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: 个人用户：在多台设备间建立私有网络，实现远程访问和文件共享。
开发团队：构建安全的开发环境，简化服务间的通信和部署。
系统管理员：管理跨地域的服务器集群，实现统一的安全访问策略。

en.tag: Zero-config secure networking built on WireGuard
en.what: Tailscale is a networking tool based on the WireGuard protocol, designed to let users easily create and manage private networks. It provides cross-platform daemons and CLI tools, supports multiple operating systems, and integrates two-factor authentication (2FA) for enhanced security.
en.content: This repository contains the majority of Tailscale's open-source code, including the core daemon tailscaled and the CLI tool tailscale. It also includes build scripts and documentation for users to compile and package themselves.

uses: Individual users: Create a private network across multiple devices for remote access and file sharing.
Development teams: Build secure development environments, simplifying inter-service communication and deployment.
System administrators: Manage geographically distributed server clusters with unified secure access policies.

zh.tag: 跨平台开源备份工具，支持加密、压缩与去重
zh.what: Kopia 是一款快速且安全的开源备份/恢复工具，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。它允许用户创建加密快照，并将其保存到本地、网络或云存储中，提供 CLI 和 GUI 两种界面。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Kopia 的完整源代码、文档、图标资源以及用于构建和测试的配置文件。项目采用 Go 编写，并提供了详细的安装指南和用户文档。

uses: 个人用户需要可靠且加密的备份解决方案，保护重要文件和数据。
系统管理员或 IT 专业人员希望自动化备份流程，并集成到现有脚本或 CI/CD 管道中。
对数据隐私有高要求的企业或组织，需要端到端加密和合规性备份。

en.tag: Cross-platform open-source backup tool with encryption, compression, and deduplication
en.what: Kopia is a fast and secure open-source backup/restore tool for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It lets users create encrypted snapshots of their data and save them to local, network, or cloud storage, with both CLI and GUI available.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, icons, and build/test configuration files for Kopia. The project is written in Go and includes detailed installation guides and user documentation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with dependencies on encryption libraries, storage backend adapters, and GUI frameworks (such as Fyne or similar).
en.hot: Kopia has over 14k stars on GitHub, with 66 new stars this week, ranking #15 on the Go weekly trending list. Its popularity stems from offering enterprise-grade features like end-to-end encryption and deduplication, while being free, open-source, and cross-platform.
uses: Individuals needing a reliable and encrypted backup solution to protect important files and data.
System administrators or IT professionals looking to automate backup processes and integrate with existing scripts or CI/CD pipelines.
Enterprises or organizations with high data privacy requirements, needing end-to-end encryption and compliance-friendly backups.

zh.tag: 分布式存储系统，支持对象存储、文件系统与 Iceberg 表
zh.what: SeaweedFS 是一个简单且高度可扩展的分布式文件系统，旨在存储数十亿文件并快速服务。它通过一个统一的二进制文件同时提供 S3 对象存储、POSIX 文件系统和 Iceberg 表（数据湖）功能，所有数据存储在同一套存储之上。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心的 weed 二进制文件、文档（wiki）、示例配置、Docker 镜像支持，以及客户端库（如 Java、Go 等）。项目采用 Apache 2.0 许可，并接受 Patreon 赞助。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 gRPC 进行通信，支持多种存储后端（如本地磁盘、云存储）。提供 S3 API 兼容接口和 FUSE 挂载支持。
zh.hot: 本周新增 137 颗星，总星数达 34,465，位列 Go 语言周榜第 19 名。其独特的 O(1) 磁盘访问设计和多协议支持吸引了大量关注。
uses: 需要存储海量小文件并追求高吞吐的场景，如日志存储、图片存储等。
希望同时使用对象存储和文件系统，并需要与 S3 兼容的应用。
构建数据湖或需要 Iceberg 表格式支持的大数据平台。

en.tag: Distributed storage for S3 objects, POSIX FS, and Iceberg tables
en.what: SeaweedFS is a simple and highly scalable distributed file system designed to store billions of files and serve them fast. A single weed binary provides an S3 object store, a POSIX file system, and a lakehouse with Iceberg tables, all over the same data.
en.content: The repository contains the core weed binary, documentation (wiki), example configurations, Docker image support, and client libraries (e.g., Java, Go). It is Apache-2.0 licensed and accepts sponsors via Patreon.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, uses gRPC for communication, supports multiple storage backends (local disk, cloud storage). Provides S3-compatible API and FUSE mount support.
en.hot: Gained 137 stars this week, reaching 34,465 total, ranking 19th on the Go weekly trending list. Its unique O(1) disk access design and multi-protocol support attract significant attention.
uses: Scenarios requiring massive small file storage with high throughput, such as log or image storage.
Applications needing both object storage and a file system with S3 compatibility.
Data lake platforms that require Iceberg table format support.

zh.tag: AI 原生网络安全作战系统，集规划、执行、审计于一体

安全分析师通过可视化工作流和证据回放，审计和复盘安全事件。
开发者或研究者探索 AI 原生安全工具链，集成 MCP 和 RAG 技术。
企业安全运营中心（SOC）用于统一管理漏洞、WebShell 和知识库。

en.tag: AI-native cybersecurity system of action integrating planning, execution, and audit
en.what: CyberStrikeAI is an AI-native cybersecurity platform built in Go that turns intent into governed execution and evidence into operational memory. It connects planning, execution, human oversight, evidence, and replay in one auditable workspace for authorized security operations.
en.content: The repository contains the full platform code, including dashboard, web console, task management, vulnerability management, WebShell management, MCP management, knowledge base, skills management, and agent management modules. It also includes documentation, security model, and hardening guides.
en.stack: Primarily built with Go, integrating Eino-powered agents, MCP-native tools, RAG knowledge, visual workflows, and attack-chain modeling and analysis.

Security analysts auditing and replaying security incidents via visual workflows and evidence replay.
Developers or researchers exploring AI-native security toolchains, integrating MCP and RAG technologies.
Enterprise Security Operations Centers (SOC) for unified management of vulnerabilities, WebShells, and knowledge bases.

zh.tag: 把文档变成可查询RAG、自主推理Agent和自维护Wiki的LLM知识平台
zh.what: WeKnora是腾讯开源的LLM知识平台，将原始文档转化为可查询的RAG、自主推理的Agent和自维护的Wiki。它支持多源数据导入、树状文件夹视图、块编辑与版本回滚，并提供交互式知识图谱。

zh.stack: 主语言为Go，基于LLM能力构建，涉及RAG、ReAct Agent、MCP工具集成、向量检索等技术。支持多种文档格式和外部服务（如飞书、Notion、RSS）。

智能客服与问答系统：利用RAG快速问答能力，构建基于私有知识的对话机器人。
复杂任务自动化：通过ReAct Agent编排检索、工具调用和网络搜索，完成多步骤分析。

en.tag: Open-source LLM knowledge platform turning documents into queryable RAG, autonomous agent, and self-maintaining Wiki
en.what: WeKnora is an open-source LLM knowledge platform from Tencent that transforms raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki. It supports multi-source ingestion, tree-structured folder views, chunk editing with revision history, and an interactive knowledge graph.
en.content: The repository contains the full framework code, architecture docs, API reference, developer guide, and multi-language READMEs (EN, CN, JA, KO). Key features include RAG-based Q&A, ReAct Agent, Wiki mode, knowledge graph, multi-source ingestion (Feishu, Notion, Yuque, RSS, etc.), and website embed widgets.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, built on LLM capabilities, incorporating RAG, ReAct Agent, MCP tool integration, and vector retrieval. Supports various document formats and external services like Feishu, Notion, and RSS.
en.hot: Quickly gained over 20k stars with 105 new stars today, ranking #5 on GitHub Go daily trending. Its ability to auto-convert documents into interactive knowledge graphs and self-maintaining wikis addresses enterprise knowledge management pain points, drawing significant developer attention.

Intelligent customer service and Q&A systems: Leverage RAG-based quick Q&A to build chatbots grounded in private knowledge.
Complex task automation: Use ReAct Agent to orchestrate retrieval, tool calls, and web search for multi-step analysis.
Personal knowledge management: Import personal documents to generate knowledge graphs and wikis for learning and research.

zh.tag: 云边一体的分布式应用可移植运行时
zh.what: Dapr 是一个可移植的运行时，用于构建云和边缘的分布式应用，结合事件驱动架构与工作流编排。它提供构建块 API，简化微服务开发，并支持持久执行和 AI 代理等场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Dapr 运行时核心代码（用 Go 编写），提供状态管理、发布订阅、服务调用、绑定、工作流等构建块，以及 CLI、文档和示例。
