zh.hot: Dapr 拥有 26k+ stars，作为 CNCF 项目持续活跃，本周新增 36 stars，因其在分布式应用和 AI 代理领域的实用性而备受关注。
uses: 微服务开发者：使用 Dapr 构建块快速实现分布式系统能力，无需关心底层基础设施。
云原生团队：在 Kubernetes 或边缘环境中部署可移植、事件驱动的应用。
AI 应用开发者：利用 Dapr 的持久执行和状态管理支持 AI 代理工作流。

en.tag: Portable runtime for distributed apps across cloud and edge
en.what: Dapr is a portable runtime for building distributed applications across cloud and edge, combining event-driven architecture with workflow orchestration. It provides building block APIs to simplify microservices development and supports durable execution and AI agents.
en.content: The repository contains the core Dapr runtime written in Go, offering building blocks like state management, pub/sub, service invocation, bindings, workflows, along with CLI, docs, and samples.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging gRPC, HTTP, and pluggable components (e.g., state stores, message brokers), with SDKs for multiple languages.
en.hot: With over 26k stars, Dapr remains active as a CNCF project, gaining 36 stars this week, popular for its utility in distributed apps and AI agents.
uses: Microservices developers: quickly implement distributed system capabilities using Dapr building blocks without worrying about underlying infrastructure.
Cloud-native teams: deploy portable, event-driven applications in Kubernetes or edge environments.
AI application developers: leverage Dapr's durable execution and state management for AI agent workflows.

zh.tag: 轻量级服务器监控平台，支持 Docker 统计、历史数据与告警
zh.what: Beszel 是一个轻量级的服务器监控平台，提供 Docker 统计、历史数据和告警功能。它拥有友好的 Web 界面，配置简单，开箱即用，并支持自动备份、多用户、OAuth 认证和 API 访问。
zh.content: 仓库包含两个主要组件：hub（基于 PocketBase 的 Web 应用，提供仪表盘）和 agent（运行在被监控系统上，收集指标）。支持 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络、负载、温度等指标，并提供截图和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，hub 基于 PocketBase，agent 独立运行。支持 Docker/Podman，可通过 Docker 镜像部署，使用 SQLite 存储数据。
zh.hot: 凭借轻量级、简单易用和丰富的功能（如 Docker 统计、告警、多用户）在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本周新增 282 颗星，总星数达 24,566，位列 Go 语言周榜第 9 名。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队，需要轻量级服务器监控且不想部署重量级方案
使用 Docker 运行多个容器的用户，希望跟踪每个容器的资源使用历史
需要设置告警（如 CPU、内存、磁盘）并及时收到通知的运维人员
希望通过 OAuth 集成现有身份认证系统的企业用户

en.tag: Lightweight server monitoring with Docker stats, history, and alerts
en.what: Beszel is a lightweight server monitoring platform that includes Docker statistics, historical data, and alert functions. It has a friendly web interface, simple configuration, and is ready to use out of the box. It supports automatic backup, multi-user, OAuth authentication, and API access.
en.content: The repository contains two main components: the hub (a PocketBase-based web app providing a dashboard) and the agent (runs on monitored systems, collects metrics). It supports metrics like CPU, memory, disk, network, load, temperature, and includes screenshots and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, the hub is built on PocketBase, and the agent runs independently. Supports Docker/Podman, deployable via Docker images, uses SQLite for data storage.
en.hot: It has gained popularity on GitHub due to its lightweight nature, ease of use, and rich features (like Docker stats, alerts, multi-user). It gained 282 stars this week, reaching 24,566 total, ranking 9th on the Go weekly trending list.
uses: Individual developers or small teams needing lightweight server monitoring without heavyweight solutions
Users running multiple Docker containers who want to track resource usage history per container
Ops personnel who need to set alerts (e.g., CPU, memory, disk) and receive timely notifications
Enterprise users who want to integrate existing authentication via OAuth

zh.tag: Cloudflare 官方内网穿透隧道客户端
zh.what: cloudflared 是 Cloudflare Tunnel 的命令行客户端，通过守护进程将 Cloudflare 网络与你的源服务器（如 Web 服务器）连接起来。它允许 Cloudflare 将客户端请求通过该守护进程转发到你的源，而无需在防火墙上开放端口，保持源服务器尽可能封闭。此外，它还支持通过 Layer 4（如 SSH、RDP）访问受保护的源。
zh.content: 仓库包含 cloudflared 的源代码、构建脚本、文档链接以及发布说明。主要命令包括 `cloudflared tunnel` 用于管理隧道，`cloudflared access` 用于访问受保护的源。提供多种安装方式：二进制、Docker 镜像、Debian/RPM 包、Homebrew 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Cloudflare 的 API 和协议。构建支持 make 工具，需要 Go 环境。
zh.hot: 本周新增 101 颗星，总星数达 15524，位列 Go 周榜第 22。作为 Cloudflare 官方工具，它提供安全、无需开放端口的隧道方案，深受开发者和运维人员喜爱。
uses: 需要将本地服务安全暴露到公网的开发者，无需配置防火墙或公网 IP。
运维人员用于远程访问内网服务器，如通过 SSH 或 RDP 连接。
使用 Cloudflare 服务的网站管理员，希望通过 Tunnel 隐藏源站 IP 并增强安全性。

en.tag: Official Cloudflare Tunnel client for secure origin connectivity
en.what: cloudflared is the command-line client for Cloudflare Tunnel, a daemon that proxies traffic from the Cloudflare network to your origins. It enables Cloudflare to send client requests to your origin without opening firewall ports, keeping your origin as closed as possible. It also supports Layer 4 access (e.g., SSH, RDP) to protected origins.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, build scripts, documentation links, and release notes for cloudflared. Key commands include `cloudflared tunnel` for managing tunnels and `cloudflared access` for accessing protected origins. Installation options include standalone binaries, Docker images, Debian/RPM packages, and Homebrew.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging Cloudflare's APIs and protocols. Build uses make and requires a Go environment.
en.hot: Gained 101 stars this week, reaching a total of 15,524, ranking #22 on the Go weekly trending list. As an official Cloudflare tool, it offers a secure, no-open-port tunneling solution, popular among developers and DevOps.
uses: Developers who need to expose local services to the public securely without configuring firewalls or public IPs.
DevOps engineers for remote access to internal servers, such as SSH or RDP connections.
Website administrators using Cloudflare who want to hide origin IPs and enhance security via Tunnel.

zh.tag: Google 跨语言数据序列化标准
zh.what: Protocol Buffers（protobuf）是 Google 开发的语言中立、平台中立、可扩展的结构化数据序列化机制，用于高效编码和交换数据。它通过 .proto 文件定义数据结构，并生成多种语言的代码，广泛应用于 RPC 系统和数据存储。
zh.content: 仓库包含 protobuf 的完整实现，包括 C++ 编写的编译器（protoc）、各语言运行时库（如 C++、Java、Python、Go 等）、测试和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写编译器，支持 Bazel 和 CMake 构建系统，并依赖多种语言运行时。
zh.hot: 作为数据序列化的行业标准，protobuf 拥有超过 7 万星标，今日新增 96 星，持续受到开发者关注，因其高效、跨语言特性成为微服务和分布式系统的基石。
uses: 后端开发人员：在微服务间定义高效、版本兼容的通信协议。
数据工程师：用于大数据管道和存储格式（如与 gRPC 结合）。
跨语言团队：需要统一数据交换格式，支持多语言生成代码。

en.tag: Google's cross-language data serialization standard
en.what: Protocol Buffers (protobuf) is Google's language-neutral, platform-neutral, extensible mechanism for serializing structured data. It defines data structures in .proto files and generates code in multiple languages, widely used in RPC systems and data storage.
en.content: The repository contains the full implementation of protobuf, including the compiler (protoc) written in C++, runtime libraries for various languages (C++, Java, Python, Go, etc.), tests, and documentation.
en.stack: The compiler is primarily written in C++, supporting Bazel and CMake build systems, with dependencies on various language runtimes.
en.hot: As an industry standard for data serialization, protobuf has over 71k stars, with 96 added today, continuing to attract developers due to its efficiency and cross-language capabilities, making it a cornerstone of microservices and distributed systems.
uses: Backend developers: define efficient, version-tolerant communication protocols between microservices.
Data engineers: use in big data pipelines and storage formats (e.g., with gRPC).
Cross-language teams: need a unified data interchange format with multi-language code generation.

zh.tag: 基于 Vulkan 的 Direct3D 翻译层，让 Windows 游戏在 Linux 上流畅运行
zh.what: DXVK 是一个基于 Vulkan 的 Direct3D 8/9/10/11 翻译层，允许使用 Wine 在 Linux 上运行 3D 应用程序。它将 Direct3D API 调用转换为 Vulkan，从而提供更好的性能和兼容性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 DXVK 的源代码、构建脚本和文档。主要组件是 DLL 文件（d3d8.dll, d3d9.dll, d3d10core.dll, d3d11.dll, dxgi.dll），用户将其复制到 Wine 前缀中并配置 DLL 覆盖即可使用。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Vulkan API 和 Wine 环境。构建系统采用 Meson，支持多种平台。
zh.hot: DXVK 是 Linux 游戏生态的关键组件，被 Steam Play、Lutris 等工具广泛使用。尽管今日新增 star 不多，但长期积累的 17972 个 star 反映了其在 Linux 玩家中的高认可度。
uses: Linux 玩家希望通过 Wine 运行 Windows 游戏，获得更好的性能和兼容性。
游戏开发者或测试人员需要在 Linux 上测试 Direct3D 游戏。
使用 Steam Play、Lutris、Bottles 等工具的用户，这些工具自动集成 DXVK。

en.tag: Vulkan-based translation layer for Direct3D, enabling Windows games on Linux
en.what: DXVK is a Vulkan-based translation layer for Direct3D 8/9/10/11, allowing 3D applications to run on Linux via Wine. It translates Direct3D API calls to Vulkan, offering better performance and compatibility.
en.content: The repository contains source code, build scripts, and documentation for DXVK. The main components are DLL files (d3d8.dll, d3d9.dll, d3d10core.dll, d3d11.dll, dxgi.dll) that users copy into a Wine prefix and configure DLL overrides.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on Vulkan API and Wine environment. Build system uses Meson, supporting multiple platforms.
en.hot: DXVK is a key component in the Linux gaming ecosystem, widely used by Steam Play, Lutris, and other tools. Despite modest daily star growth, its 17,972 stars reflect high recognition among Linux gamers.
uses: Linux gamers who want to run Windows games via Wine with better performance and compatibility.
Game developers or testers who need to test Direct3D games on Linux.
Users of Steam Play, Lutris, Bottles, etc., which integrate DXVK automatically.

zh.tag: Google 官方 C++ 测试与模拟框架
zh.what: GoogleTest 是 Google 的 C++ 测试框架，用于编写和运行单元测试。它支持自动测试发现、丰富的断言、死亡测试、参数化测试等，并集成了 GoogleMock 用于模拟对象。
zh.content: 仓库包含 GoogleTest 和 GoogleMock 的源码、文档、示例以及构建配置。文档托管在 GitHub Pages 上，提供用户指南和入门教程。
zh.stack: 基于 C++，要求 C++17 或更高版本（1.18.x 分支）。计划依赖 Abseil 库。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方测试框架，拥有近 3.9 万 Star，是 C++ 社区的事实标准，持续维护并发布新版本。
uses: C++ 开发者编写单元测试，确保代码质量
需要模拟对象进行依赖隔离的测试场景
在 CI/CD 流程中集成自动化测试
学习 xUnit 测试框架设计的最佳实践

en.tag: Google's official C++ testing and mocking framework
en.what: GoogleTest is Google's C++ testing framework for writing and running unit tests. It supports automatic test discovery, rich assertions, death tests, parameterized tests, and integrates GoogleMock for mocking.
en.content: The repository contains source code, documentation, examples, and build configuration for GoogleTest and GoogleMock. Docs are hosted on GitHub Pages with user guide and primer.
en.stack: Built on C++, requires C++17 or later (1.18.x branch). Plans to depend on Abseil.
en.hot: As Google's official testing framework, it has nearly 39k stars, is the de facto standard in C++ community, and is actively maintained with new releases.
uses: C++ developers writing unit tests to ensure code quality
Scenarios requiring mocking objects for dependency isolation
Integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
Learning best practices of xUnit test framework design

zh.tag: 高性能内存数据存储，兼容 Redis 与 Memcached
zh.what: Dragonfly 是一个现代化的内存数据存储，专为现代应用负载设计。它完全兼容 Redis 和 Memcached API，无需修改代码即可迁移。相比传统内存存储，吞吐量提升 25 倍，资源消耗降低 80%。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心引擎源码、文档、基准测试、构建指南以及多语言 README。还提供了 Docker 镜像和云服务入口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Linux 内核特性如 epoll 和 io_uring。支持 Docker 部署，并提供 Helm charts 用于 Kubernetes。
zh.hot: 作为 Redis 和 Memcached 的现代替代品，凭借惊人的性能提升和资源节省，在 C++ 社区持续火爆，今日新增 77 星，总星数达 31150。
uses: 需要高吞吐、低延迟缓存服务的后端开发团队，可无缝替代 Redis。
希望在降低基础设施成本的同时提升性能的运维和架构师。
对内存数据库内部实现感兴趣的 C++ 开发者，可阅读源码学习。

en.tag: High-performance in-memory data store, Redis & Memcached compatible
en.what: Dragonfly is a modern in-memory data store built for modern application workloads. It is fully compatible with Redis and Memcached APIs, requiring no code changes to adopt. Compared to legacy in-memory datastores, it delivers 25X more throughput and uses up to 80% less resources.
en.content: The repository contains core engine source code, documentation, benchmarks, build guides, and multi-language READMEs. It also provides Docker images and a cloud service entry point.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, leveraging Linux kernel features like epoll and io_uring. Supports Docker deployment and provides Helm charts for Kubernetes.
en.hot: As a modern replacement for Redis and Memcached, it gains popularity in the C++ community due to its impressive performance gains and resource savings, with 77 new stars today and 31,150 total.
uses: Backend teams needing high-throughput, low-latency caching, seamlessly replacing Redis.
Ops and architects aiming to cut infrastructure costs while boosting performance.
C++ developers interested in the internals of in-memory databases for learning.

zh.tag: 强大易用的跨平台截图工具
zh.what: Flameshot 是一款功能强大且易于使用的开源截图软件，支持 GNU/Linux、Windows 和 macOS。它提供丰富的标注、编辑和分享功能，用户可以通过图形界面或命令行快速截取屏幕并添加箭头、文字、高亮等元素。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、文档、安装包配置（如 Snap、Flatpak）以及多语言翻译资源。项目采用 C++ 编写，主要目录包括 src（核心逻辑）、data（图标和预览图）和 docs（用户手册）。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 和 Qt 框架开发，支持跨平台构建，使用 CMake 作为构建系统，并集成 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 3 万 Star，本周新增 65 个，因其简洁易用且功能丰富而广受好评，是 Linux 用户最喜爱的截图工具之一。
uses: 日常办公或开发中需要快速截图并标注说明的用户
寻找开源、跨平台截图替代品的个人或团队
需要命令行截图和自动化脚本的开发者

en.tag: Powerful yet simple cross-platform screenshot tool
en.what: Flameshot is a powerful yet simple open-source screenshot software for GNU/Linux, Windows, and macOS. It offers rich annotation, editing, and sharing features, allowing users to capture the screen and add arrows, text, highlights, and more via GUI or CLI.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, documentation, packaging configs (e.g., Snap, Flatpak), and translation resources. Written in C++, key directories include src (core logic), data (icons and previews), and docs (user manual).
en.stack: Built with C++ and Qt framework, cross-platform, using CMake as the build system and GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: With over 30k stars and 65 new this week, it's widely praised for its simplicity and rich features, making it one of the most beloved screenshot tools among Linux users.
uses: Users who need quick screenshot capture and annotation for daily work or development
Individuals or teams seeking an open-source, cross-platform screenshot alternative
Developers who require CLI screenshot and automation scripting

zh.tag: 微软官方 WinUI 现代 Windows UI 框架
zh.what: WinUI 是微软推出的现代 UI 框架，提供丰富的控件和样式，用于构建高性能的 Windows 应用程序。当前版本 WinUI 3 作为 Windows App SDK 的一部分发布，支持 Fluent Design，并可通过 .NET 或 C++ 开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含 WinUI 的源代码、文档、示例和 WinUI 3 Gallery 交互式演示，涵盖控件库、样式、工具和迁移指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 实现，基于 Windows App SDK，支持 C#/.NET 和 C++ 开发，面向 x86、x64 和 ARM 架构。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方 UI 框架，WinUI 是 Windows 应用开发的核心，本月新增 140 星，位列 C++ 月榜第 5，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: Windows 桌面应用开发者，希望使用现代 Fluent Design 构建应用
需要跨版本兼容（Windows 10 1809+）的 Win32 或 UWP 开发者
学习微软官方 UI 框架和 Windows App SDK 的学生或爱好者

en.tag: Microsoft's official WinUI framework for modern Windows apps
en.what: WinUI is Microsoft's modern UI framework with a rich set of controls and styles for building high-performance Windows apps. The current version, WinUI 3, ships as part of the Windows App SDK, embracing Fluent Design and supporting development with .NET or C++.
en.content: The repo contains the source code, documentation, samples, and the WinUI 3 Gallery interactive demo, covering control libraries, styles, tools, and migration guides.
en.stack: Primarily implemented in C++, built on the Windows App SDK, supporting C#/.NET and C++ development for x86, x64, and ARM architectures.
en.hot: As Microsoft's official UI framework, WinUI is central to Windows app development, gaining 140 stars this month and ranking 5th in the C++ monthly trending, showing sustained developer interest.
uses: Windows desktop app developers wanting modern Fluent Design
Win32 or UWP developers needing cross-version compatibility (Windows 10 1809+)
Students or enthusiasts learning Microsoft's official UI framework and Windows App SDK

zh.tag: 跨 GPU 的图形缩放与帧生成桥接工具
zh.what: OptiScaler 是一个允许在支持 DLSS2+/FSR2+/XeSS 的游戏中替换原生缩放器的工具，并能管理帧生成，包括通过实验性的 OptiFG 在 DX12 游戏中启用帧生成。它支持 DLSS2+/XeSS/FSR2+ 输入，并可将 DLSS 帧生成替换为 FSR3 帧生成。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 源代码、预编译的稳定版和夜间版发布包、详细的 Wiki 文档、Discord 社区链接以及捐赠渠道。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 开发，依赖图形 API 如 DX12 和 Vulkan，以及 DLSS/FSR/XeSS 等缩放技术。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上获得 10k+ 星标，今日新增 47 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第二。它解决了跨 GPU 缩放和帧生成的兼容性问题，受到游戏玩家和模组社区的广泛关注。
uses: 游戏玩家：在非原生支持的游戏中使用 FSR 或 XeSS 替换 DLSS，提升帧率或画质。
模组制作者：利用 Nukem 模组将 DLSS 帧生成转换为 FSR3，扩展硬件兼容性。
开发者：研究图形缩放和帧生成技术的实现，参考其跨平台兼容方案。

en.tag: Bridges upscaling/frame gen across GPUs, replacing native upscalers
en.what: OptiScaler is a tool that lets you replace upscalers in games that already support DLSS2+/FSR2+/XeSS, and manage frame generation, including enabling it in DX12 games via experimental OptiFG. It supports DLSS2+/XeSS/FSR2+ inputs and can replace DLSS frame gen with FSR3.
en.content: The repository contains C++ source code, precompiled stable and nightly releases, a comprehensive Wiki, Discord community link, and donation channels.
en.stack: Developed in C++, relies on graphics APIs like DX12 and Vulkan, and upscaling technologies such as DLSS, FSR, and XeSS.
en.hot: With over 10k stars and 47 new stars today, ranking #2 on the C++ trending list, it addresses cross-GPU upscaling and frame gen compatibility, gaining attention from gamers and modders.
uses: Gamers: Replace DLSS with FSR or XeSS in games that don't natively support them, improving FPS or quality.
Modders: Use the Nukem mod to convert DLSS frame gen to FSR3, extending hardware compatibility.
Developers: Study the implementation of upscaling and frame gen techniques, referencing its cross-platform compatibility approach.

zh.tag: 极简 C++ 即时模式 GUI 库，零依赖高性能
zh.what: Dear ImGui 是一个为 C++ 设计的极简图形用户界面库，采用即时模式（immediate mode）范式，输出优化的顶点缓冲区，可在任何启用 3D 管线的应用中渲染。它速度快、可移植、与渲染器无关，且无外部依赖，主要用于快速迭代和开发工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库源码（imgui.cpp/h 等）、示例（examples/）和文档（docs/），以及用于集成到各种渲染后端和平台的绑定。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 实现，无外部依赖，支持 OpenGL、DirectX、Vulkan 等渲染后端，并提供多种语言绑定。
zh.hot: 作为游戏和工具开发中事实标准的 GUI 库，拥有 76k+ star，长期活跃，今日新增 24 星，持续获得开发者青睐。
uses: 游戏引擎编辑器或调试工具开发者，需要快速构建可视化界面
图形程序员，用于创建内容创作工具或性能分析面板
需要轻量级、可嵌入 GUI 的桌面应用或工具链开发者

en.tag: Bloat-free immediate-mode GUI for C++ with minimal dependencies
en.what: Dear ImGui is a bloat-free graphical user interface library for C++. It uses an immediate-mode paradigm, outputs optimized vertex buffers that can be rendered anytime in a 3D-pipeline-enabled application. It is fast, portable, renderer agnostic, and self-contained (no external dependencies), designed for fast iterations and developer tools.
en.content: The repository contains core library source (imgui.cpp/h etc.), examples (examples/), and documentation (docs/), along with bindings for various rendering backends and platforms.
en.stack: Pure C++ implementation with no external dependencies, supports rendering backends like OpenGL, DirectX, Vulkan, and offers bindings for multiple languages.
en.hot: As the de facto standard GUI library for game and tool development, it has 76k+ stars, remains highly active, and gained 24 stars today, continuing to earn developer favor.
uses: Game engine editor or debug tool developers needing quick visual UI
Graphics programmers creating content creation tools or performance analysis panels
Desktop app or toolchain developers needing a lightweight embeddable GUI

zh.tag: Google 开源的 C++ 通用库，补充标准库
zh.what: Abseil 是 Google 内部 C++ 代码库的开源版本，旨在补充 C++ 标准库的不足。它提供标准库缺失的组件，或针对特殊需求提供替代实现，并已在 Google 生产环境中广泛测试和使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个库组件，如 base、algorithm、cleanup、container 等，每个组件位于独立的子目录中，并附有构建配置和文档。
zh.stack: 使用 C++17 编写，支持 Bazel 和 CMake 构建系统，依赖 C++ 标准库。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方开源库，拥有 18k+ stars，是 C++ 开发者的常用工具集，虽然今日新增不多，但长期稳定受欢迎。
uses: C++ 开发者需要标准库之外的实用工具时，可快速引入 Abseil 组件。
希望借鉴 Google 内部 C++ 最佳实践和代码风格的项目团队。
需要跨平台、高性能且经过生产验证的基础库的应用程序。

en.tag: Google's open-source C++ common libraries augmenting the standard library
en.what: Abseil is an open-source collection of C++ library code from Google's internal codebase, designed to augment the C++ standard library. It provides missing pieces or alternatives for special needs, extensively tested in production.
en.content: The repository contains multiple library components such as base, algorithm, cleanup, container, each in separate subdirectories with build configurations and documentation.
en.stack: Written in C++17, supports Bazel and CMake build systems, depends on the C++ standard library.
en.hot: As an official Google open-source library with 18k+ stars, it's a common toolkit for C++ developers. Although today's increment is small, it remains consistently popular.
uses: C++ developers needing utilities beyond the standard library can quickly adopt Abseil components.
Teams looking to follow Google's internal C++ best practices and coding style.
Applications requiring a cross-platform, high-performance, production-proven base library.

zh.tag: 智能家居互操作标准 Matter 的官方开源 SDK
zh.what: Matter（原 Project CHIP）旨在统一智能家居设备通信协议，让不同品牌设备能无缝协作。该仓库提供完整的参考实现，帮助制造商快速开发兼容 Matter 的设备，同时提升消费者的设备兼容性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Matter 协议栈的 C++ 实现、多平台示例（如 ESP32、EFR32、Android 等）以及丰富的文档和测试仪表盘。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，支持多种嵌入式平台和操作系统，依赖 Zephyr/FreeRTOS 等 RTOS，并集成 CI 自动化构建与测试。
zh.hot: 作为智能家居互操作标准的官方实现，持续获得关注，当前 8.9k star 且每日新增，反映了 Matter 生态的活跃。
uses: 智能家居设备制造商：快速实现 Matter 兼容，缩短产品上市时间。
嵌入式开发者：学习参考协议栈实现，适配新硬件平台。
测试与认证机构：利用测试用例和仪表盘验证设备互操作性。

en.tag: Official open-source SDK for Matter, the smart home interoperability standard
en.what: Matter (formerly Project CHIP) unifies smart home device communication protocols, enabling seamless interoperability across brands. This repository provides a full reference implementation, helping manufacturers build Matter-compatible devices and improving consumer compatibility.
en.content: The repo contains the Matter protocol stack in C++, multi-platform examples (e.g., ESP32, EFR32, Android), plus extensive docs and test dashboards.
en.stack: Primarily C++, supporting various embedded platforms and OSes, with dependencies on RTOS like Zephyr/FreeRTOS, and integrated CI for automated builds and tests.
en.hot: As the official implementation of the smart home interoperability standard, it maintains steady attention, with 8.9k stars and daily additions, reflecting the vibrant Matter ecosystem.
uses: Smart home device manufacturers: quickly achieve Matter compliance and shorten time-to-market.
Embedded developers: study the reference stack and port to new hardware platforms.
Testing and certification bodies: use test suites and dashboards to verify interoperability.

zh.tag: 开源 PS2 模拟器，让经典游戏在 PC 上重生
zh.what: PCSX2 是一款免费开源的 PlayStation 2 模拟器，通过模拟 PS2 硬件（MIPS CPU、解释器、动态重编译器和虚拟机）让 PC 能够运行 PS2 游戏。它支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，并提供了增强的画质和功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的模拟器源码、构建脚本、文档和翻译资源，支持稳定版与夜间版构建。项目持续更新，拥有活跃的社区和兼容性列表。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake 构建，并利用图形 API（如 Vulkan、OpenGL）进行渲染。
zh.hot: 作为最成熟的 PS2 模拟器，拥有超过 20 年开发历史，近期因兼容性提升和社区活跃而持续受到关注，周增 92 星。
uses: 怀旧玩家：在 PC 上重温 PS2 经典游戏，如《最终幻想 X》和《鬼泣 3》。
游戏开发者：测试游戏兼容性或研究主机模拟技术。
技术爱好者：学习模拟器架构、动态重编译和虚拟机实现。

en.tag: Open-source PS2 emulator to play classic games on PC
en.what: PCSX2 is a free and open-source PlayStation 2 emulator that emulates PS2 hardware using MIPS CPU interpreters, recompilers, and a virtual machine, enabling PC users to play PS2 games. It supports Windows, Linux, and macOS, with enhanced graphics and features.
en.content: The repository contains full emulator source code, build scripts, documentation, and translation resources, with stable and nightly builds. It is actively maintained with a vibrant community and compatibility list.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, built with CMake, and uses graphics APIs like Vulkan and OpenGL for rendering.
en.hot: As the most mature PS2 emulator with over 20 years of development, it remains popular due to improved compatibility and active community, gaining 92 stars this week.
uses: Retro gamers: replay classic PS2 titles like Final Fantasy X and Devil May Cry 3 on PC.
Game developers: test game compatibility or study console emulation techniques.
Tech enthusiasts: learn about emulator architecture, dynamic recompilation, and virtual machines.

zh.tag: 进程内分析型 SQL 数据库，极速查询 CSV/Parquet
zh.what: DuckDB 是一个高性能的分析型数据库系统，设计为快速、可靠、可移植且易于使用。它支持丰富的 SQL 方言，包括复杂子查询、窗口函数、复杂类型等，并可直接查询 CSV 和 Parquet 文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 DuckDB 的完整源代码、文档、扩展机制以及多种客户端（Python、R、Java、Wasm 等）的集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++17 编写，依赖 CMake 构建系统，支持 Python 3 等开发环境。
zh.hot: 作为进程内分析数据库的标杆，DuckDB 凭借其极简部署和高性能查询，在数据科学领域迅速走红，star 数已突破 4 万，今日新增 69 个。
uses: 数据科学家和分析师，希望在 Python 或 R 环境中快速分析大型数据集，无需单独部署数据库服务器。
数据工程师，需要将 CSV/Parquet 文件直接作为 SQL 查询源，简化数据管道。
应用开发者，希望嵌入分析能力到现有应用中，提供轻量级 OLAP 功能。

en.tag: In-process analytical SQL database, blazing fast queries on CSV/Parquet
en.what: DuckDB is a high-performance analytical database system designed to be fast, reliable, portable, and easy to use. It supports a rich SQL dialect including complex subqueries, window functions, complex types, and can directly query CSV and Parquet files.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, extension mechanisms, and integrations for multiple clients (Python, R, Java, Wasm, etc.).
en.stack: Primarily written in C++17, built with CMake, and supports Python 3 for development.
en.hot: As a benchmark for in-process analytical databases, DuckDB has gained rapid popularity in data science due to its minimal deployment and high-performance queries, with over 40k stars and 69 new today.
uses: Data scientists and analysts who want to quickly analyze large datasets in Python or R without deploying a separate database server.
Data engineers who need to query CSV/Parquet files directly as SQL sources to simplify data pipelines.
Application developers who want to embed analytical capabilities into existing applications for lightweight OLAP functionality.

zh.tag: 快速本地神经语音合成引擎
zh.what: Piper 是一个快速、本地的神经文本转语音（TTS）引擎，通过嵌入 espeak-ng 进行音素化处理，支持多种语言和声音。它提供命令行、Web 服务器、Python API 以及 C/C++ API，方便集成到各种应用中。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心引擎的 C++ 实现、Python 绑定、命令行工具、HTTP 服务器、预训练声音模型，以及训练新声音的脚本和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 espeak-ng 进行音素化，通过 onnxruntime 运行神经网络模型。提供 Python 包 piper-tts，支持多种平台。
zh.hot: Piper 在 GitHub 上获得 5466 颗星，本周新增 146 颗，位列 C++ 周榜第 15，因其快速、本地、隐私友好的 TTS 特性，被 Home Assistant、NVDA 等知名项目采用，社区活跃。
uses: 智能家居爱好者：在 Home Assistant 中本地生成语音提示，无需云服务。
无障碍软件开发者：为 NVDA 等屏幕阅读器提供高质量语音输出。
离线应用开发者：在无网络环境下集成 TTS，如教育软件或嵌入式设备。
语音研究者和爱好者：训练自定义声音，探索低资源语言的语音合成。

en.tag: Fast local neural TTS engine with espeak-ng phonemization
en.what: Piper is a fast, local neural text-to-speech (TTS) engine that embeds espeak-ng for phonemization, supporting multiple languages and voices. It provides a command-line interface, HTTP server, Python API, and C/C++ API for easy integration.
en.content: The repository includes the core engine in C++, Python bindings, CLI tools, an HTTP server, pre-trained voice models, and scripts and documentation for training new voices.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on espeak-ng for phonemization, and uses onnxruntime to run neural network models. Provides a Python package piper-tts, supporting multiple platforms.
en.hot: Piper has gained 5,466 stars on GitHub with 146 new stars this week, ranking #15 on the C++ weekly trending list. Its fast, local, privacy-friendly TTS features have led to adoption by well-known projects like Home Assistant and NVDA, fostering an active community.
uses: Smart home enthusiasts: generate local voice prompts in Home Assistant without cloud services.
Accessibility software developers: provide high-quality voice output for screen readers like NVDA.
Offline app developers: integrate TTS in offline environments, such as educational software or embedded devices.
Speech researchers and hobbyists: train custom voices and explore TTS for low-resource languages.

zh.tag: 一站式 3D 高斯泼溅工作站
zh.what: LichtFeld Studio 是一个原生的模块化工作站，用于训练、检查、编辑、自动化和导出 3D 高斯泼溅场景。它整合了模型训练、实时可视化、高斯编辑、导出、插件和自动化于一个工具链中。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 核心、GUI 可视化器、Python 插件系统、MCP 支持、文档和示例资源。提供 Windows 下载和源码构建指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 构建，集成 Python 插件和 MCP 协议，支持 COLMAP 数据集和 3D 高斯泼溅技术。
zh.hot: 本周新增 62 星，总星数达 3627，在 GitHub Trending C++ 周榜排名第四。因其一站式解决 3D 高斯泼溅全流程而受到关注。
uses: 3D 重建研究人员和开发者，需要训练和编辑高斯泼溅模型。
视觉特效和游戏开发者，需要导出高质量 3D 场景。
自动化工作流爱好者，希望通过 MCP 或 Python 插件扩展功能。

en.tag: All-in-one workstation for 3D Gaussian Splatting
en.what: LichtFeld Studio is a native modular workstation for training, inspecting, editing, automating, and exporting 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes. It combines model training, real-time visualization, gaussian editing, export, plugins, and automation into one toolchain.
en.content: The repository includes a C++ core, GUI visualizer, Python plugin system, MCP support, documentation, and sample assets. Offers Windows downloads and build-from-source instructions.
en.stack: Primarily built with C++, integrates Python plugins and MCP protocol, supports COLMAP datasets and 3D Gaussian Splatting.
en.hot: Gained 62 stars this week, reaching 3627 total, ranking #4 on GitHub Trending C++ weekly. It attracts attention for its all-in-one workflow for 3D Gaussian Splatting.
uses: 3D reconstruction researchers and developers needing to train and edit Gaussian Splatting models.
VFX and game developers needing to export high-quality 3D scenes.
Automation enthusiasts wanting to extend functionality via MCP or Python plugins.

zh.tag: 开源软件KVM：一套键鼠控制多台电脑
zh.what: Deskflow 是一款免费开源的键鼠共享软件，让你用一台电脑的键盘、鼠标或触控板控制附近的多台电脑，实现无缝协作。它相当于一个软件 KVM（不含视频切换），默认启用 TLS 加密，支持 Wayland 和剪贴板共享。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、跨平台构建配置（Windows/macOS/Linux）、安装包下载链接、详细的 README 文档以及社区讨论渠道（Matrix/IRC/GitHub Discussions）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 TLS 加密库、Wayland 协议支持，并提供多种安装方式（如 Homebrew tap、Flathub、MSVC Redistributable）。
zh.hot: 作为 Synergy 的活跃开源分支，Deskflow 持续获得关注，本周新增 198 颗星，总星数达 28.6k，位列 GitHub C++ 周榜第 18 名。其免费、安全且支持现代显示协议的特性吸引了大量多机办公用户。
uses: 多机办公用户：在台式机和笔记本之间共享键鼠，提升工作效率。
跨平台开发者：需要在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 之间无缝切换操作。
追求安全与隐私的用户：TLS 加密默认开启，确保输入数据安全。
开源爱好者：希望替代商业 KVM 软件，并参与社区贡献。

en.tag: Open-source software KVM: share one keyboard/mouse across multiple computers
en.what: Deskflow is a free and open-source keyboard and mouse sharing app that lets you control nearby computers using the keyboard, mouse, or trackpad of one computer, enabling seamless workflow. It acts as a software KVM (without video), with TLS encryption enabled by default, Wayland support, and clipboard sharing.
en.content: The repository contains the full C++ source code, cross-platform build configurations (Windows/macOS/Linux), download links for packages, detailed README documentation, and community channels (Matrix/IRC/GitHub Discussions).
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, with dependencies for TLS encryption, Wayland protocol support, and multiple installation methods (e.g., Homebrew tap, Flathub, MSVC Redistributable).
en.hot: As an active open-source fork of Synergy, Deskflow continues to gain traction, adding 198 stars this week for a total of 28.6k, ranking #18 on GitHub's C++ weekly trending. Its free, secure, and modern display protocol support appeals to multi-computer users.
uses: Multi-computer office workers: share keyboard and mouse between desktop and laptop for increased productivity.
Cross-platform developers: need seamless switching between Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Security-conscious users: TLS encryption is enabled by default to protect input data.
Open-source enthusiasts: looking to replace commercial KVM software and contribute to the community.

zh.tag: 离线语音AI全家桶，跨平台多语言支持
zh.what: sherpa-onnx 是一个基于下一代 Kaldi 和 onnxruntime 的离线语音处理工具包，支持语音识别、语音合成、说话人分离、语音增强、声源分离和 VAD 等功能。它无需互联网连接即可在本地运行，适用于嵌入式系统、移动端、桌面和服务器等多种平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 核心库、多种编程语言的 API 绑定（如 Python、Java、Go、Rust 等），以及针对 Flutter 和 Tauri 的预构建 demo 应用。还提供对多种 NPU（如 Rockchip、Qualcomm、Ascend）的支持，并附带详细的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 实现，依赖 onnxruntime 和下一代 Kaldi 技术。支持多种硬件架构（x86, ARM, RISC-V）和 NPU 加速，并提供跨语言绑定。
zh.hot: 本周新增 157 星，总星数达 1.46 万，位列 C++ 周榜第 21。其强大的离线能力和广泛的平台支持吸引了大量开发者，尤其是嵌入式与移动端场景。
uses: 嵌入式开发者：在 Raspberry Pi、RISC-V 等设备上实现离线语音识别与合成
移动应用开发者：为 Android/iOS 应用集成语音功能，无需网络连接
桌面与服务器应用：利用多语言 API 快速部署语音处理服务
AI 研究者：测试和评估多种语音任务模型，支持 NPU 加速

en.tag: Offline speech AI toolkit: ASR, TTS, VAD, diarization, etc., cross-platform & multi-language
en.what: sherpa-onnx is an offline speech processing toolkit built on next-gen Kaldi and onnxruntime, supporting speech-to-text, text-to-speech, speaker diarization, speech enhancement, source separation, and VAD. It runs locally without internet, targeting embedded systems, mobile, desktop, and servers.
en.content: The repo includes a C++ core library, API bindings for 12+ languages (Python, Java, Go, Rust, etc.), and pre-built demo apps for Flutter and Tauri. It also supports various NPUs (Rockchip, Qualcomm, Ascend) with comprehensive docs and examples.
en.stack: Implemented in C++, leveraging onnxruntime and next-gen Kaldi. Supports multiple architectures (x86, ARM, RISC-V) and NPU acceleration, with bindings for many languages.
en.hot: Gained 157 stars this week, reaching 14.6k total, ranking #21 on C++ weekly. Its robust offline capabilities and broad platform support attract developers, especially for embedded and mobile use.
uses: Embedded developers: implement offline ASR/TTS on Raspberry Pi, RISC-V, etc.
Mobile app developers: integrate speech features into Android/iOS apps without internet.
Desktop/server developers: deploy speech services using multi-language APIs.
AI researchers: evaluate models for various speech tasks with NPU acceleration.

zh.tag: DHH 打造的精致现代 Linux 发行版
zh.what: Omarchy 是一个由 DHH（Ruby on Rails 创始人）打造的 Linux 发行版，注重美观、现代和明确的观点。它提供了一套完整的桌面环境，包括终端、编辑器、AI 工具等，并配有详尽的用户手册。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 manual/ 目录，内含 51 篇 Markdown 格式的手册章节，涵盖入门、导航、应用、配置等主题。此外还有安装脚本和配置文件，用于构建和定制系统。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Shell 脚本进行系统配置和安装，依赖 Linux 生态中的各种开源工具（如 Neovim、终端模拟器等）。手册使用 Markdown 编写，并托管在 learn.omacom.io。
zh.hot: 凭借 DHH 的知名度和对美观、现代体验的强调，Omarchy 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本周新增 6475 星，总星数达 34824，登上趋势榜第三。
uses: 喜欢 DHH 风格、追求开箱即用且美观的 Linux 桌面用户
希望从 Mac/Windows 迁移到 Linux 并希望有完整指南的用户
对 Linux 发行版定制和配置感兴趣的开发者

en.tag: A beautiful, modern & opinionated Linux distro by DHH
en.what: Omarchy is a Linux distribution created by DHH (creator of Ruby on Rails), focusing on beauty, modernity, and strong opinions. It provides a complete desktop environment including terminal, editor, AI tools, and comes with an extensive user manual.
en.content: The repository contains a manual/ directory with 51 Markdown chapters covering topics like getting started, navigation, applications, and configuration. It also includes installation scripts and configuration files for building and customizing the system.
en.stack: Primarily uses Shell scripts for system configuration and installation, relying on various open-source tools from the Linux ecosystem (e.g., Neovim, terminal emulators). The manual is written in Markdown and hosted on learn.omacom.io.
en.hot: Thanks to DHH's fame and the emphasis on beautiful, modern experience, Omarchy quickly gained popularity on GitHub, adding 6,475 stars this week to reach 34,824 total, ranking #3 on the trending list.
uses: Linux desktop users who appreciate DHH's style and want a beautiful, out-of-the-box experience
Users migrating from Mac/Windows to Linux who want a comprehensive guide
Developers interested in customizing and configuring a Linux distribution

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的开源 Palantir，图原生上下文与可问责基础设施
zh.what: Semantica 是一个图原生的基础设施，用于构建上下文感知且可问责的 AI 系统。它支持企业数据接入、上下文图与知识图谱构建，并提供图分析与因果推理，内置完整的决策溯源，确保可解释、可追踪和可信赖。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Python 库、CLI 工具、文档与示例，支持 RDF 和 LPG 多语言图存储，遵循 W3C 标准，提供本体管理与决策智能模块。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.8+，依赖图数据库（如 RDF 三元组存储和属性图数据库），集成知识图谱与因果推理库，遵循 W3C 标准，提供开放 API 与 PyPI 分发。
zh.hot: 本月新增超 1 万 star，位居趋势榜第二，因其定位为“AI 代理的开源 Palantir”，切中高监管领域对可解释、可溯源 AI 的迫切需求，同时强调开放、治理与零厂商锁定。
uses: 企业 AI 团队：需要为代理系统提供可靠上下文与决策溯源，满足合规审计要求。
知识图谱开发者：希望利用 RDF/LPG 标准构建可互操作的知识模型，并进行图分析与推理。
高监管行业（金融、医疗、政务）：要求 AI 决策可解释、可追踪，降低风险并提升信任。
AI 基础设施研究者：探索图原生架构与因果推理在 AI 系统中的应用，构建可问责的智能体。

en.tag: Open-source Palantir for AI agents: graph-native context & accountable AI infrastructure
en.what: Semantica is a graph-native infrastructure for building context-aware and accountable AI systems. It ingests enterprise data, extracts what matters, builds context and knowledge graphs, and runs graph analytics and causal reasoning with full decision provenance baked in, making AI explainable, traceable, and trustworthy by design.
en.content: The repository contains the core Python library, CLI tools, documentation, and examples, supporting polyglot graph storage with RDF and LPG, W3C standards, ontology management, and decision intelligence modules.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.8+, leveraging graph databases (RDF triple stores and property graphs), integrating knowledge graph and causal reasoning libraries, following W3C standards, with open APIs and PyPI distribution.
en.hot: With over 10k stars added this month and ranking #2 on the trending list, it's hot because it positions as the 'open-source Palantir for AI agents', addressing the urgent need for explainable and traceable AI in regulated domains, while emphasizing openness, governance, and zero vendor lock-in.
uses: Enterprise AI teams needing reliable context and decision provenance for agent systems to meet compliance and audit requirements.
Knowledge graph developers looking to build interoperable knowledge models using RDF/LPG standards with graph analytics and reasoning.
Regulated industries (finance, healthcare, government) requiring explainable and traceable AI decisions to reduce risk and build trust.
AI infrastructure researchers exploring graph-native architectures and causal reasoning for accountable intelligent agents.

zh.tag: Claude 社区插件市场，只读镜像，每日同步
zh.what: 这是 Claude Cowork 和 Claude Code 的社区插件市场仓库，包含可安装的插件列表。它由 Anthropic 内部审核流程同步，所有插件都经过安全扫描和批准。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含一个 marketplace.json 文件，列出了所有社区插件及其元数据。此外还有 README 说明如何使用和提交插件。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 Python，但仓库本身是静态 JSON 数据，由自动化流程同步。
zh.hot: 今日新增 190 星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜，因为 Claude 插件生态正在快速增长，开发者需要官方认可的插件来源。
uses: Claude Code 用户：通过命令行快速安装社区插件，扩展功能。
插件开发者：提交插件到官方市场，获得分发和曝光。
企业团队：在受控环境中使用经过安全审核的插件。

en.tag: Read-only mirror of Claude community plugin marketplace, synced nightly
en.what: This is the community plugin marketplace for Claude Cowork and Claude Code, containing a list of installable plugins. It is synced from Anthropic's internal review pipeline, and all plugins have passed security scanning and approval.
en.content: The repository mainly contains a marketplace.json file listing all community plugins with their metadata, plus a README explaining how to use and submit plugins.
en.stack: Primary language is Python, but the repo itself is static JSON data synced by automated processes.
en.hot: Gained 190 stars today and hit the trending list, as the Claude plugin ecosystem is rapidly growing and developers need an official source for plugins.
uses: Claude Code users: quickly install community plugins via CLI to extend functionality.
Plugin developers: submit plugins to the official marketplace for distribution and visibility.
Enterprise teams: use security-reviewed plugins in controlled environments.

zh.tag: 自改进递归语言模型智能体，面向编码与长时自主任务
zh.what: Prime Agent 是一个开源的编码与研究智能体，专为通用和长期运行的任务设计。它基于递归语言模型（RLM）和持续框架（Continual Harness）两个核心抽象，使智能体能在持久会话中自我改进。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心智能体包、文档、CI 配置和二进制构建脚本。核心是持久化 Python REPL 环境，支持文件操作、shell 命令、子代理调用和上下文管理。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，但核心控制环境是 Python。依赖包括持续框架、RLM 实现和相关验证器。
zh.hot: 本月新增近 2 万 star，位居 GitHub Trending 月榜第三，因其创新的自我改进机制和面向长时任务的实用性而备受关注。
uses: 开发者用于自动化编码工作流，如代码生成、重构和测试。
研究人员用于长期自主研究任务，如数据收集和实验运行。
需要持久化上下文和可复用子代理的复杂任务场景。

en.tag: Self-improving RLM agent for coding workflows and long-running autonomous tasks
en.what: Prime Agent is an open-source coding and research agent designed for general and long-running tasks. It is built around two core abstractions: the Recursive Language Model (RLM) and the Continual Harness, enabling self-improvement within persistent sessions.
en.content: The repository contains core agent packages, documentation, CI configs, and binary build scripts. The core is a persistent Python REPL environment supporting file operations, shell commands, subagent calls, and context management.
en.stack: Primary language is TypeScript, but the core control environment is Python. Dependencies include the Continual Harness, RLM implementation, and related verifiers.
en.hot: With nearly 20k stars added this month, ranking #3 on GitHub Trending monthly, it gains attention for its innovative self-improvement mechanism and practicality for long-running tasks.
uses: Developers automating coding workflows like code generation, refactoring, and testing.
Researchers conducting long-running autonomous tasks such as data gathering and experiment runs.
Complex scenarios requiring persistent context and reusable subagents.

zh.tag: AI 代理的自进化上下文数据库，统一记忆、知识与技能
zh.what: OpenViking 是一个为 AI 代理设计的开源上下文数据库，将记忆、资源和技能统一为一个虚拟文件系统（viking:// 协议），代理可以通过 ls、tree、find 等命令浏览自己的上下文，而不是查询黑盒向量存储。内容被处理为三层（L0 摘要、L1 概览、L2 细节），并按需加载，每次检索都会留下可观察和调试的轨迹。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OpenViking 的核心实现，包括虚拟文件系统、三层内容处理管道、检索轨迹记录，以及 OpenViking Studio 在线演示环境。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 开发，可能依赖向量数据库、文件系统抽象和 AI 代理框架，具体技术栈未在摘要中详述。
zh.hot: OpenViking 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得 28,893 颗星，今日新增 239 颗，位列 Python 趋势榜第 9 名。其创新的上下文管理方式（将记忆、知识和技能统一为文件系统）吸引了大量关注，解决了 AI 代理上下文管理的痛点。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要高效管理代理上下文、记忆和技能的场景。
RAG 应用构建者：希望用文件系统方式替代传统向量检索的团队。
研究与教育：用于探索代理上下文管理的新范式。

en.tag: Self-evolving context database for AI agents, unifying memory, knowledge RAG, and skills
en.what: OpenViking is an open-source context database for AI agents, unifying memories, resources, and skills into one virtual filesystem under the viking:// protocol, so agents can browse their context with ls, tree, and find instead of querying a black-box vector store. Content is processed into three tiers (L0 abstract, L1 overview, L2 details) and loaded on demand, with every retrieval leaving a traceable trajectory for debugging.
en.content: The repository contains the core implementation of OpenViking, including the virtual filesystem, three-tier content processing pipeline, retrieval trajectory logging, and the OpenViking Studio live demo environment.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Python, likely leveraging vector databases, filesystem abstractions, and AI agent frameworks, though the exact stack is not detailed in the summary.
en.hot: OpenViking has quickly gained traction on GitHub with 28,893 stars and 239 new stars today, ranking #9 on the Python trending list. Its innovative approach to context management—unifying memory, knowledge, and skills into a filesystem—has attracted significant attention, addressing a key pain point in AI agent context handling.
uses: AI agent developers: scenarios requiring efficient management of agent context, memory, and skills.
RAG application builders: teams looking to replace traditional vector retrieval with a filesystem approach.
Research and education: for exploring new paradigms in agent context management.

zh.tag: GPT-Image2 工业级提示词引擎与模板库
zh.what: 这是一个为 GPT-Image2 图像生成模型打造的提示词工程资源库，包含 500+ 逆向工程案例和 20+ 工业级模板，将提示词视为代码进行管理和复用。项目提供可视化网站用于浏览和复制提示词，并持续更新。
zh.content: 仓库包含数据目录（案例图片与提示词）、源码（网站前端）、模板库、技能提炼文档，以及多语言 README。
zh.stack: 主要基于 JavaScript，可能使用前端框架（如 React/Vue）构建可视化网站，依赖 GitHub Pages 或类似服务部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 500+ 逆向工程案例和 20+ 工业级模板，为 GPT-Image2 用户提供高质量提示词参考，今日新增 409 星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: AI 图像生成爱好者：快速获取高质量提示词，提升生成效果。
提示词工程师：学习逆向工程案例，提炼可复用的技能。
产品团队：将提示词作为代码管理，实现工业化生成流程。

en.tag: Industrial prompt engine & template library for GPT-Image2
en.what: This is a prompt engineering resource library for the GPT-Image2 image generation model, featuring 500+ reverse-engineered cases and 20+ industrial templates, treating prompts as code for management and reuse. It provides a visual website for browsing and copying prompts, with continuous updates.
en.content: The repository contains data directories (case images and prompts), source code (website frontend), template library, skill extraction docs, and multilingual README.
en.stack: Primarily based on JavaScript, likely using a frontend framework (e.g., React/Vue) for the visual website, deployed via GitHub Pages or similar.
en.hot: With 500+ reverse-engineered cases and 20+ industrial templates, it offers high-quality prompt references for GPT-Image2 users, gaining 409 stars today and trending on GitHub.
uses: AI image generation enthusiasts: quickly obtain high-quality prompts to improve output.
Prompt engineers: learn from reverse-engineered cases and extract reusable skills.
Product teams: manage prompts as code for industrial generation workflows.

zh.tag: X 平台 For You 信息流核心算法开源
zh.what: 该仓库包含 X（原 Twitter）For You 信息流中决定用户看到哪些帖子的核心代码。它结合用户关注的内容（网络内）和通过机器学习检索发现的内容（网络外），经过过滤和排序后，使用 Transformer 模型对帖子进行排名。
zh.content: 仓库包含系统架构文档、请求路径和标注路径说明，以及多个组件目录，如 home-mixer（含评分器、过滤器、参数）、可见性过滤、模型训练代码和合成数据生成代码。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，涉及机器学习模型（如 Transformer）、参数配置、过滤逻辑和实验框架。依赖包括用于模型训练的 Phoenix 模型相关代码。
zh.hot: 作为 X 平台核心算法的开源实现，吸引了大量关注，GitHub 星标超过 3.2 万，月榜第 11 名。其透明化举措和近期更新（如巴西选举过滤）引发热议。
uses: 对推荐系统、信息流排序感兴趣的开发者，可研究其架构和实现细节。
希望了解 X 平台内容过滤和排名机制的研究者或记者。
需要参考大规模生产级算法工程实践的工程师。

en.tag: Open-source core algorithm powering X's For You feed
en.what: This repository contains the core code that determines which posts a viewer sees in the For You feed on X. It combines in-network content from followed accounts with out-of-network content discovered via ML-based retrieval, filters based on various inputs, and ranks posts using a transformer model.
en.content: The repo includes system architecture docs, request and labeling path explanations, and component directories like home-mixer (with scorers, filters, params), visibility filtering, model training code, and synthetic data generation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, involving ML models (e.g., Transformer), parameter configuration, filtering logic, and experimentation frameworks. Dependencies include Phoenix model training code and synthetic data generation.
en.hot: As the open-source implementation of X's core algorithm, it has attracted significant attention with over 32k stars, ranking 11th on the monthly trending. Its transparency and recent updates (e.g., Brazil election filter) spark discussions.
uses: Developers interested in recommendation systems and feed ranking can study its architecture and implementation details.
Researchers or journalists wanting to understand X's content filtering and ranking mechanisms.
Engineers seeking reference for large-scale production-grade algorithm engineering practices.

zh.tag: 用知识图谱增强的代码库 RAG 引擎
zh.what: Code-Graph-RAG 是一个面向多语言代码库的 RAG 系统，利用 Tree-sitter 解析代码并构建知识图谱，支持用自然语言查询、理解和编辑代码。它统一了混合语言 monorepo 的图模式，让 AI 能深入理解代码结构。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心解析器、图构建模块、查询接口、Agentic QA 基准测试工具，以及重复代码检测功能。提供 CLI 和 Python API，支持与主流 LLM 集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 Tree-sitter 进行代码解析，Memgraph 作为图数据库，支持多种 LLM 后端。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编程助手普及，开发者需要更精准的代码理解工具。该项目将知识图谱与 RAG 结合，解决多语言仓库的复杂查询问题，上线不久即获近 5000 star，日增 20，登上 Python 趋势榜。
uses: 大型 monorepo 的开发者，需要快速定位和理解跨语言代码依赖。
AI 编程工具团队，希望增强代码检索和编辑的准确性。
代码质量工程师，利用重复代码检测和知识图谱分析架构。

en.tag: Knowledge-graph-powered RAG engine for codebases
en.what: Code-Graph-RAG is a RAG system for multi-language codebases. It parses code with Tree-sitter, builds a knowledge graph in Memgraph, and lets you query, edit, and optimize code in plain English. It unifies mixed-language monorepos under a single graph schema.
en.content: The repo includes core parser, graph builder, query interface, agentic QA benchmark harness, and duplicate code detection. It offers CLI and Python API, with integrations for major LLMs.
en.stack: Primarily Python, using Tree-sitter for parsing, Memgraph as the graph database, and supports multiple LLM backends.
en.hot: As AI coding assistants proliferate, developers need more precise code understanding. This project combines knowledge graphs with RAG to solve complex queries in multi-language repos, gaining nearly 5k stars quickly and trending on Python daily.
uses: Developers in large monorepos needing to quickly locate and understand cross-language dependencies.
AI coding tool teams aiming to enhance code retrieval and editing accuracy.
Code quality engineers using duplicate detection and graph-based architecture analysis.

zh.tag: 苹果芯片上原生多 token 预测加速的本地 LLM 运行器
zh.what: MTPLX 是一个原生 Mac 应用和命令行工具，用于在 Apple Silicon 上运行本地大语言模型。它利用模型内置的多 token 预测（MTP）头，通过自推测解码和精确拒绝采样，在保持输出分布不变的情况下显著加速生成。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Mac 应用（DMG 下载）和命令行工具（brew/pip 安装），提供模型推荐、自动下载、引擎配置、风扇控制等功能。内置针对 Qwen 3.8 27B 等模型的优化版本，并附有详细的 README 和文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.11+，使用 MLX 框架，依赖 Apple Silicon 的 Metal 性能。应用层采用原生 Mac 技术，CLI 支持 Homebrew 和 pip 安装。
zh.hot: 本月新增 714 星，总星数 1824，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜（Python）第 18 名。其宣称的 2 倍加速和无需外部草稿模型的特性，吸引了大量 Apple Silicon 用户的关注。
uses: 在 Mac 上本地运行 LLM 的开发者，希望获得更快的推理速度而不牺牲输出质量。
需要离线或隐私保护的 AI 编码助手，特别是使用 Qwen 3.8 27B 等模型的场景。
对推测解码技术感兴趣的研究者，希望参考其实现或进行二次开发。

en.tag: Native multi-token prediction LLM runner for Apple Silicon, ~2x faster
en.what: MTPLX is a native Mac app and CLI for running local LLMs on Apple Silicon. It leverages built-in multi-token prediction (MTP) heads to speculatively draft and verify multiple tokens per step, achieving up to 2.24x speedup while preserving the exact output distribution.
en.content: The repo provides a full Mac app (DMG) and CLI (brew/pip), featuring hardware checking, model recommendation, auto-download, engine setup, and fan control. It includes optimized builds for models like Qwen 3.8 27B, along with comprehensive docs.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.11+ with the MLX framework, leveraging Apple Silicon's Metal performance. The app uses native Mac technologies, and the CLI is installable via Homebrew or pip.
en.hot: Gained 714 stars this month (total 1824), ranking #18 on GitHub Trending (Python) monthly. Its claimed ~2x speedup and no-external-drafter design have attracted significant attention from Apple Silicon users.
uses: Developers running LLMs locally on Macs who want faster inference without compromising output quality.
AI coding assistants needing offline/private operation, especially with models like Qwen 3.8 27B.
Researchers interested in speculative decoding techniques for reference or further development.

zh.tag: 14MB 端侧模型，手机/穿戴/家居/机器人皆可跑
zh.what: Needle 2 是一个 45M 参数的开放模型，专为工具调用、设备使用和结构化提取设计。整个模型打包成单个 14MB 的二进制文件，运行完整会话仅需约 28MB 内存。它基于 Simple Attention Network 架构，并采用 Cactus Quants 压缩至 CQ2 位，内置推理引擎。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包，提供推理、LoRA 微调和导出功能。模型权重已嵌入引擎，无需额外文件，推理时无网络请求。还包含工具检索、置信度门控和 256-token 滑动窗口等特性。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch 等，使用 Simple Attention Network 架构，Hadamard MLP、GQA 注意力、engram 键值记忆。推理引擎从 Hugging Face 获取并缓存。
zh.hot: 在 GitHub 日榜上新增 248 星，总星数 3730，因其极小的体积（14MB）和高效的端侧性能而备受关注，在基准测试中与更大的模型（如 FunctionGemma 270M）互有胜负，但体积小 5 到 70 倍。
uses: 端侧 AI 开发者：在手机、可穿戴设备等资源受限环境中部署工具调用模型。
智能家居与机器人：为设备提供本地智能，无需云端依赖。
LoRA 微调研究者：在小型模型上进行高效微调实验。

en.tag: 14MB on-device model for phones, wearables, smart home, and robots
en.what: Needle 2 is an open 45M-parameter model for tool calling, device use, and structured extraction. The entire model is a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in about 28MB of RAM. It is built on the Simple Attention Network architecture, compressed to CQ2-bit with Cactus Quants, and baked into its own engine.
en.content: The repository contains the Python package for inference, LoRA fine-tuning, and export. Weights are baked into the engine, no separate model files needed, and inference does no network calls. Features include tool retrieval, confidence gating, and a 256-token sliding window.
en.stack: Python-based, with dependencies like PyTorch. Uses Simple Attention Network architecture with Hadamard MLP, GQA attention, and engram key-value memory. The inference engine is fetched from Hugging Face and cached.
en.hot: Gained 248 stars today, total 3730, trending on GitHub. It's hot due to its tiny size (14MB) and efficient on-device performance, trading wins with larger models like FunctionGemma 270M while being 5-70x smaller.
uses: On-device AI developers: deploying tool-calling models in resource-constrained environments like phones and wearables.
Smart home and robotics: providing local intelligence for devices without cloud dependency.
LoRA fine-tuning researchers: experimenting with efficient fine-tuning on small models.

zh.tag: 一个菜单栏图标，替代十几个付费 Mac 应用
zh.what: Vorssaint 是一个免费开源的 macOS 菜单栏工具包，将音量控制、系统监控、窗口管理等多种实用功能整合到一个菜单栏图标中。它旨在替代多个付费应用，提供简洁统一的用户体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Swift 项目源码，包括菜单栏面板（如混音器、系统监控、窗口控制）、文档、CI 配置和发布资源。
zh.stack: 使用 Swift 开发，面向 macOS 14+ 和 Apple Silicon，采用 GPL-3.0 许可证，并依赖 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1.1 万星，总星数达 1.5 万，因其免费开源、功能强大且替代多个付费应用而广受欢迎，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: 希望减少付费 Mac 应用数量、追求性价比的用户
需要快速访问音量、系统监控和窗口管理的效率工作者
对开源和隐私保护有要求的 macOS 用户

en.tag: One menu bar icon replacing a dozen paid Mac apps
en.what: Vorssaint is a free and open-source macOS menu bar toolkit that consolidates volume control, system monitoring, window management, and other utilities into a single menu bar icon. It aims to replace multiple paid apps with a clean, unified experience.
en.content: The repository contains the full Swift project source, including menu bar panels (mixer, system monitor, window controls), documentation, CI config, and release assets.
en.stack: Built with Swift, targeting macOS 14+ and Apple Silicon, licensed under GPL-3.0, and uses GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: Gained 11k stars this month, reaching 15k total, popular for being free, open-source, and replacing multiple paid apps, trending on GitHub.
uses: Users wanting to reduce paid Mac apps and seek cost-effectiveness
Productivity workers needing quick access to volume, system monitoring, and window controls
macOS users who value open-source and privacy

zh.tag: 统一 AI 开发与部署平台，含 MAX 框架与 Mojo 语言
zh.what: Modular Platform 是一个开源平台，旨在统一 AI 开发与部署流程，包含 MAX 框架（用于模型推理和部署）和 Mojo 语言（一种面向 AI 的高性能编程语言）。它提供从模型编译、优化到服务部署的完整工具链，并支持 OpenAI 兼容的端点。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Mojo 编译器、Mojo 标准库、MAX 加速器库、MAX 推理服务器、MAX 模型流水线以及大量代码示例。目录结构清晰，分为 /KGEN、/mojo、/max 等模块，方便开发者浏览和贡献。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Mojo 语言编写，同时涉及 Python（用于 MAX 的 Python API）和 C++（底层内核）。依赖 LLVM 等编译器基础设施，并遵循 Apache 2.0 许可证（含 LLVM 例外）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 268 星，总星数 27933，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。Mojo 语言和 MAX 框架的独特定位吸引了大量 AI 开发者，其高性能和统一平台理念备受关注。
uses: AI 开发者：使用 Mojo 语言编写高性能 AI 模型，或利用 MAX 框架进行模型部署和推理。
MLOps 工程师：通过 MAX 推理服务器快速搭建 OpenAI 兼容的模型服务。
研究人员：在 MAX 流水线中集成自定义模型架构，并利用加速器库优化性能。
开源贡献者：参与 Mojo 标准库、MAX 加速器库等模块的开发和改进。

en.tag: Unified AI development & deployment platform, including MAX framework and Mojo language
en.what: The Modular Platform is an open-source platform that unifies AI development and deployment, including the MAX framework for model inference and deployment, and the Mojo language, a high-performance programming language for AI. It provides a complete toolchain from model compilation and optimization to service deployment, with OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
en.content: The repo contains the Mojo compiler, Mojo standard library, MAX accelerator library, MAX inference server, MAX model pipelines, and numerous code examples. The directory structure is clear, with modules like /KGEN, /mojo, /max, making it easy to navigate and contribute.
en.stack: Primarily written in Mojo, with Python for MAX's Python API and C++ for low-level kernels. It relies on LLVM and other compiler infrastructure, and is licensed under Apache 2.0 with LLVM exceptions.
en.hot: With 268 stars added today and 27,933 total, it tops the GitHub Trending daily chart. The unique positioning of Mojo and MAX attracts AI developers, drawing attention to its high performance and unified platform concept.
uses: AI developers: Use Mojo to write high-performance AI models or leverage MAX for deployment and inference.
MLOps engineers: Quickly set up OpenAI-compatible model serving with the MAX inference server.
Researchers: Integrate custom model architectures in MAX pipelines and optimize performance with the accelerator library.
Open-source contributors: Contribute to the Mojo standard library, MAX accelerator library, and more.

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 代理工作台，日志即运行时
zh.what: Apache Maka 是一个本地优先的 AI 代理工作台，用于实际工作而非仅仅回答问题。它通过受控权限检查项目、执行工具、生成工件，并将模型消息和工具调用记录为可恢复的执行事实。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（Electron + React）、终端 TUI 和 CLI（maka, maka run）、评估工具（maka eval run），以及核心的 Runtime Host 和 Runtime Event Log 实现。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，桌面端基于 Electron 和 React，支持多种模型连接（云 API、本地模型或兼容网关），并包含本地工具如 Read、Write、Edit、Bash、Glob 和 Grep。
zh.hot: 今日新增 460 星，登上 TypeScript 趋势榜第 7，因其本地优先、日志即运行时的创新架构，以及 Apache 孵化项目的背书，吸引了关注 AI 代理可靠性和可恢复性的开发者。
uses: 日常 AI 辅助开发：在本地项目中安全地让代理读写文件、执行命令。
需要可审计、可恢复的 AI 代理工作流的团队，用于记录和回溯每次工具调用。
AI 代理评估：使用 maka eval 进行可复现的基准测试。
偏好本地优先、数据不出机器的隐私敏感用户。

en.tag: Local-first AI agent workspace with log-as-runtime architecture
en.what: Apache Maka is a local-first AI agent workspace built for real work. It inspects projects, executes tools, produces artifacts with controlled permissions, and preserves model messages and tool calls as recoverable execution facts.
en.content: The repo includes a desktop app (Electron + React), a terminal TUI and CLI (maka, maka run), an evaluation tool (maka eval run), and the core Runtime Host and Runtime Event Log implementation.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Electron and React for the desktop app, supporting multiple model connections (cloud API, local model, or compatible gateway), and local tools including Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, and Grep.
en.hot: With 460 stars added today and ranking #7 on the TypeScript trending list, its local-first, log-as-runtime architecture and Apache incubation status attract developers focused on AI agent reliability and recoverability.
uses: Daily AI-assisted development: let agents safely read/write files and run commands in local projects.
Teams needing auditable and recoverable AI agent workflows, with logs of every tool call.
AI agent evaluation: use maka eval for reproducible benchmark experiments.
Privacy-conscious users preferring local-first, data-stays-on-machine solutions.

zh.tag: 免费公共 API 大全，开发者资源宝库
zh.what: 这是一个由社区维护的免费公共 API 集合，涵盖动物、动漫、反恶意软件、艺术与设计、认证与授权、区块链、书籍、商业、日历、云存储与文件等众多领域。它为开发者提供了丰富的 API 资源，方便他们快速查找和集成到自己的项目中。
zh.content: 仓库以 README 为主，按类别列出所有 API，每个 API 包含名称、描述、认证方式、是否支持 HTTPS 和 CORS 等信息。此外，还包含贡献指南和 API 提交要求。

zh.tag: 本地运行与训练大模型和扩散模型的桌面应用

zh.stack: 基于 Python 构建，依赖 PyTorch 等深度学习框架，支持多种模型架构。桌面应用可能使用 Electron 或类似技术打包。

代理工具用户：将本地模型与 Claude Code、Codex 等集成，构建自动化工作流。

zh.tag: macOS 菜单栏原生 LLM 推理服务器，支持连续批处理与 SSD 缓存
zh.what: oMLX 是一个专为 Apple Silicon 优化的 LLM 推理服务器，提供连续批处理和分层 KV 缓存，将热数据保存在内存、冷数据存储在 SSD，并支持跨请求复用缓存。用户可通过 macOS 菜单栏直接管理模型、切换上下文长度，并监控性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 macOS 应用（.dmg 安装包）、Homebrew 安装支持、CLI 工具（~/.omlx/bin/omlx）以及可选的 MCP 支持。还提供多语言 README（中/英/韩/日）和基准测试页面。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 3.11-3.13，针对 Apple Silicon 优化，可能包含自定义内核（如 GLM-5.2 / MiniMax M3）。支持 Homebrew 安装，可选安装 MCP 依赖。
zh.hot: 针对 Mac 用户痛点：在便利性和控制力之间取得平衡，通过菜单栏管理 LLM 服务器，并利用 SSD 缓存实现长上下文复用，适合本地 AI 开发。Star 数近 1.9 万，今日新增 78，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 8 名。
uses: Mac 用户希望在本地运行 LLM，并通过菜单栏轻松管理模型和上下文
开发者使用 Claude Code 等工具进行真实编码，需要跨请求缓存以提升效率

通过 Homebrew 或 CLI 集成到自动化工作流（如 Apple Shortcuts）

en.tag: Native macOS menu bar LLM inference server with continuous batching & SSD caching
en.what: oMLX is an LLM inference server optimized for Apple Silicon, featuring continuous batching and tiered KV caching that persists hot data in memory and cold data on SSD, enabling cache reuse across requests. Users can manage models, switch context lengths, and monitor performance directly from the macOS menu bar.
en.content: The repository includes a full macOS app (.dmg installer), Homebrew installation support, a CLI shim (~/.omlx/bin/omlx), and optional MCP support. It also provides multilingual READMEs (EN/ZH/KO/JA) and a benchmarks page.
en.stack: Primarily Python 3.11-3.13, optimized for Apple Silicon, possibly with custom kernels (e.g., GLM-5.2 / MiniMax M3). Supports Homebrew installation, with optional MCP dependencies.
en.hot: Addresses Mac users' pain point: balancing convenience and control by managing LLM servers from the menu bar, with SSD caching for long-context reuse, ideal for local AI development. With ~19k stars and +78 today, it ranks #8 on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Mac users who want to run LLMs locally and manage models/context from the menu bar
Developers using tools like Claude Code for real coding, needing cross-request caching for efficiency
Power users who need flexible control over memory/SSD caching and auto-swapping models
Those integrating with automation workflows via Homebrew or CLI (e.g., Apple Shortcuts)

自媒体运营者：批量生成不同主题的视频，用于多平台分发和测试。

zh.tag: 把技术书 PDF 变成 Claude Code 技能，按需加载、即问即答
zh.what: book-to-skill 能将任何技术书籍、文档文件夹或资料集合转化为统一的代理技能（Agent Skill），供 GitHub Copilot CLI、Amp 或 Claude Code 等工具使用。它提取书中的框架、决策规则和反模式，生成按章节组织的文件，使代理能按需加载相关章节并基于真实内容回答，避免幻觉。

学习爱好者：把 PDF 书籍变成按需问答的私人导师
团队：将内部文档或规范转化为统一技能，供 AI 助手使用
AI 工具用户：在 Claude Code、Copilot CLI 等环境中增强代理能力

en.tag: Turn any technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill — on-demand, no hallucination
en.what: book-to-skill converts any technical book, document folder, or collection of sources into a unified agent skill for use with GitHub Copilot CLI, Amp, or Claude Code. uses: Developers: turn technical books into interactive agent skills for on-the-fly reference while coding
Learners: convert PDF books into on-demand Q&A personal tutors

en.tag: Local-first self-evolving cross-platform content discovery agent
en.what: OpenBiliClaw is a local-first, private, open-source, self-evolving cross-platform AI content discovery agent. It understands your cross-platform usage, feedback, and conversations to continuously deepen your profile, then proactively finds content across Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, YouTube, X, Zhihu, Reddit, and the open web.
en.content: The repository contains the full agent backend (Python), a DSH client plugin for DeepSeek Harness integration, and a Flutter mobile client (separate repo). It supports Chrome extension, multi-platform installers, with Gitee mirror and domestic cloud drive downloads.
en.stack: Primarily Python 3.11+, integrates with DeepSeek Harness plugin system, offers Flutter mobile client (Android/iOS/Web/desktop), and supports Chrome extension.
en.hot: Gained 1,604 stars this month, reaching 3,206 total, ranking #22 on GitHub Trending monthly (Python). Its local-first, privacy-preserving, and cross-platform self-evolving features resonate with users seeking personalized recommendations and AI agents.
uses: Users who want cross-platform personalized content recommendations while prioritizing privacy and local execution.
Developers looking to integrate content discovery into DeepSeek Harness or other AI workflows.
Researchers or enthusiasts interested in self-evolving agents and user profiling techniques.
Users who want a unified content discovery and bookmarking experience on mobile or desktop.

zh.tag: 免费AI编码代理，多产品覆盖终端、桌面、网页与云端
zh.what: Freebuff 是一套免费的AI编码代理产品，包括桌面端、CLI、Web、云和聊天五种形态，无需订阅或API密钥即可使用。它通过专用代理和模型选择帮助用户编码、构建和研究。

zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，CLI 通过 npm 安装，支持多种模型（如 DeepSeek、GPT-5.6 Luna 等），桌面端可集成本地 Claude Code 和 Codex 代理。
zh.hot: 免费且无需API密钥的AI编码工具，提供多产品覆盖和多种模型选择，今日新增105星，登上GitHub趋势榜。
uses: 开发者：在终端或桌面端快速进行AI辅助编码
全栈开发者：使用Web版构建和部署完整应用

en.tag: Free AI coding agent suite across terminal, desktop, web, and cloud
en.what: Freebuff is a suite of free AI coding agents available as desktop, CLI, web, cloud, and chat products, requiring no subscription or API key. It uses specialized agents and a choice of models to assist with coding, building, and research.
en.content: The repository includes product documentation, quick start guides, model catalog details, and descriptions/links for each product (Desktop, CLI, Web, Cloud, Chat).
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, CLI installable via npm, supports multiple models (DeepSeek, GPT-5.6 Luna, etc.), and Desktop can integrate local Claude Code and Codex agents.
en.hot: Free AI coding tool with no API key required, offering multi-product coverage and model variety; gained 105 stars today and hit the GitHub trending list.

Full-stack developers: build and ship apps with the Web version
Researchers: AI-driven research and thinking via Chat
Teams: run cloud agents on GitHub repositories for collaboration

zh.tag: 为编码代理打造的极简 Web GUI
zh.what: T3 Code 是一个轻量级的 Web 图形界面，用于运行和管理多个编码 AI 代理（如 Codex、Claude、Cursor、OpenCode）。它让开发者无需离开浏览器即可与这些代理交互，简化了编码工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Web 应用源码、桌面应用构建配置、CLI 工具以及文档（入门指南、远程访问、架构概览等）。支持通过 npx 快速运行或安装桌面应用。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Vite+（Vite 的增强版）构建，依赖各代理的 CLI 工具（Codex CLI、Claude Code 等）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 413 星，总星数 14459，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 18。它填补了多代理统一管理界面的空白，吸引了大量对 AI 编码工具感兴趣的开发者。
uses: 希望在一个界面中切换多个 AI 编码助手的开发者
需要远程访问编码代理的团队或个人
探索 AI 辅助编程工作流的早期采用者

en.tag: A minimal web GUI for coding agents
en.what: T3 Code is a lightweight web GUI for running and managing multiple coding AI agents (e.g., Codex, Claude, Cursor, OpenCode). It allows developers to interact with these agents without leaving the browser, streamlining the coding workflow.
en.content: The repo contains the web app source code, desktop app build config, CLI tool, and documentation (getting started, remote access, architecture overview, etc.). It can be run quickly via npx or installed as a desktop app.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Vite+ (enhanced Vite), depends on each agent's CLI tool (Codex CLI, Claude Code, etc.).
en.hot: Gained 413 stars this week, total 14459, ranked #18 on TypeScript weekly trending. It fills the gap for a unified multi-agent management UI, attracting many developers interested in AI coding tools.
uses: Developers who want to switch between multiple AI coding assistants in one interface
Teams or individuals needing remote access to coding agents
Early adopters exploring AI-assisted programming workflows

zh.tag: 企业级 AI 代理工作台，基于 Cloudflare Workers
zh.what: Cloudflare OS 是一个面向企业内部的 AI 生产力环境，员工可以通过代理聊天界面让 AI 代理执行任务，并利用沙箱环境创建和分享小型应用。它提供安全框架 Gatekeepers，确保非技术用户也能安全使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 v2 重写代码，提供本地运行和部署到 Cloudflare 账户的选项。包含代理聊天 UI、应用开发沙箱、安全框架等核心组件，以及文档和示例工作区。

zh.hot: 本月新增近万 star，因其将 AI 代理与安全沙箱结合，为企业提供可定制的 AI 工作系统，吸引大量关注。
uses: 企业内部员工日常使用 AI 代理辅助工作，如生成幻灯片、修复文档错误。
开发者基于此框架构建定制化的公司级 AI 操作系统。
技术团队评估和部署安全的 AI 代理环境。

en.tag: Enterprise AI agent workspace built on Cloudflare Workers
en.what: Cloudflare OS is an AI productivity environment for enterprises, where employees can delegate tasks to AI agents via chat and build/share small apps in a sandbox. It includes a security framework called Gatekeepers to keep non-technical users safe.
en.content: The repo contains the full v2 rewrite, with options to run locally or deploy to your Cloudflare account. It includes the agent chat UI, app development sandbox, security framework, plus docs and sample workspaces.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, runs on Cloudflare Workers and workerd, managed via pnpm, supports local dev and cloud deployment.
en.hot: Gained ~9.5k stars in a month, as it offers a customizable AI agent workspace with security, appealing to enterprises.
uses: Enterprise employees using AI agents for daily tasks like slide creation and doc fixing.
Developers building customized company AI OS on this framework.
Tech teams evaluating secure AI agent deployment.

zh.tag: AI 代理团队级记忆中枢，沉淀对话、文档与代码为可复用资产
zh.what: TencentDB Agent Memory 是一个为 AI 代理设计的团队级记忆中枢，将对话、文档和代码转化为四种可复用的记忆资产（聊天记忆、技能、LLM 维基、代码图谱），并支持跨代理和框架的治理、共享与装备。它旨在减少重复工作，让代理在团队中持续积累知识。
zh.content: 仓库包含部署脚本（一键启动 memory-core、memory-hub 和 proxy）、核心服务代码、迁移工具，以及详细的安装文档（中英文）。提供面板用于管理记忆资产。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，依赖 Node.js >=22.16，支持 OpenClaw 和 Hermes 等代理框架，使用 TencentDB 作为存储后端。
zh.hot: 今日新增 1057 星，总星数达 16543，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。其“团队记忆”理念切中 AI 代理协作痛点，且提供一键部署，迅速吸引开发者关注。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为代理添加持久记忆，减少重复上下文输入。
团队协作场景：共享代理记忆，提升团队知识复用效率。
个人开发者：构建“一人公司”式的代理团队，自动化工作流。
研究爱好者：探索代理记忆管理与跨框架集成。

en.tag: Team-level memory hub for AI agents, turning conversations, docs, and code into reusable assets
en.what: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI agents, transforming conversations, docs, and code into four reusable memory assets (Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, Code-Graph) that are governed, shared, and equipped across agents and frameworks. It aims to reduce repetitive work by enabling agents to accumulate knowledge persistently.
en.content: The repo includes deployment scripts (one-click start for memory-core, memory-hub, and proxy), core service code, migration tools, and detailed installation docs (EN/CN). A panel is provided for managing memory assets.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, requires Node.js >=22.16, supports agent frameworks like OpenClaw and Hermes, and uses TencentDB as the storage backend.
en.hot: Gained 1,057 stars today, reaching 16,543 total, and topped the GitHub Trending daily chart. Its 'team memory' concept addresses the pain point of AI agent collaboration, and one-click deployment quickly attracts developers.
uses: AI agent developers: add persistent memory to agents, reducing repetitive context input.
Team collaboration: share agent memory to improve knowledge reuse efficiency.
Solo developers: build a 'one-person company' agent team for automated workflows.
Researchers/enthusiasts: explore agent memory management and cross-framework integration.

zh.tag: 把人的思维方式蒸馏成 Agent 可复用的技能档案
zh.what: Distilly 是一个本地优先的工具，用于将一个人的原始材料、工作习惯、判断力和表达风格转化为带版本管理的“Agent 人物档案”。这些档案可以在运行期间临时调用，也可以作为长期的主机技能安装，存储权始终保留在本地，无需额外的模型 API 密钥。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 工具、插件系统以及多个主机兼容层（如 Codex、OpenClaw、Hermes）。默认分支为 distilly-plugin，提供开发者预览版，包含五个 MCP 工具，并支持多语言文档。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，要求 Node.js 22.19+ 或 24，使用 pnpm 管理依赖，构建后通过 CLI 与 MCP 协议集成到 Codex 等宿主。
zh.hot: 24k+ stars，本月新增 3741，因其将个人知识蒸馏为 Agent 技能的理念新颖，且本地优先、无需额外 API key，吸引大量开发者关注。
uses: 希望将个人工作方法沉淀为 AI 助手可复用技能的开发者或知识工作者
需要为团队或客户创建定制化 Agent 行为档案的 AI 应用构建者
对本地优先、数据自主可控的 AI 工具链感兴趣的技术爱好者

en.tag: Distill how people think into reusable Skills for any Agent or Bot
en.what: Distilly is a local-first tool that turns a person's source material, working habits, judgment, and voice into a versioned 'Person Profile for Agents'. The profile can be recalled temporarily during a run or installed as a long-lived host Skill, with storage authority staying local and no extra model API key required.
en.content: The repo includes a CLI tool, plugin system, and compatibility layers for multiple hosts (Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes). The default branch is distilly-plugin, offering a Developer Preview with five MCP tools and multi-language docs.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, requires Node.js 22.19+ or 24, uses pnpm for dependencies, and integrates with hosts like Codex via CLI and MCP protocol.
en.hot: With 24k+ stars and 3,741 added this month, it's hot for its novel concept of distilling personal knowledge into Agent skills, plus local-first design and no extra API key needed.
uses: Developers or knowledge workers who want to turn personal working methods into reusable AI assistant skills
AI application builders who need to create customized agent behavior profiles for teams or clients
Tech enthusiasts interested in local-first, data-sovereign AI toolchains

zh.tag: 自托管个人图书馆与阅读平台
zh.what: BookOrbit 是一个自托管的图书馆和阅读平台，支持电子书、PDF、有声书和漫画。它提供网页阅读器、Kobo 和 KOReader 支持，并同步阅读进度、高亮和状态。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务端和前端代码，提供仪表盘、书架管理、阅读统计、成就系统、OPDS 和 Send-to-Kindle 等功能，并支持多用户和 OIDC/SSO 认证。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于现代 Web 技术栈构建，支持 Docker 部署，并集成多种第三方服务（如 Crowdin 翻译、Codecov 覆盖率）。
zh.hot: BookOrbit 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 248 星，总星数达 2613，因其自托管、跨设备同步和丰富功能而备受关注。
uses: 喜欢自托管服务的阅读爱好者，希望完全掌控自己的书籍数据。
需要在不同设备（如 Kobo、KOReader）间无缝同步阅读进度的用户。
注重隐私和自主权的用户，希望避免依赖商业云服务。
开发者或技术爱好者，希望扩展或定制自己的阅读平台。

en.tag: Self-hosted library and reading platform for ebooks, PDFs, audiobooks, and comics
en.what: BookOrbit is a self-hosted library and reading platform for ebooks, PDFs, audiobooks, and comics. It offers a web reader, Kobo and KOReader support, and syncs progress, highlights, and reading status across devices.
en.content: The repository contains full server and frontend code, featuring a dashboard, bookshelf management, reading stats, achievements, OPDS and Send-to-Kindle delivery, multi-user accounts with OIDC/SSO, and automatic sync to Hardcover, Readwise, and StoryGraph.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on modern web technologies, supports Docker deployment, and integrates with third-party services like Crowdin for translation and Codecov for coverage.
en.hot: BookOrbit is rapidly gaining popularity on GitHub with 248 stars today and 2,613 total, thanks to its self-hosted nature, cross-device sync, and rich feature set.
uses: Reading enthusiasts who prefer self-hosted services and want full control over their book data.
Users who need seamless reading progress sync across devices like Kobo and KOReader.
Privacy-conscious individuals who want to avoid relying on commercial cloud services.
Developers or tech enthusiasts looking to extend or customize their reading platform.

zh.tag: 开源智能体操作系统，让 AI 代理自主运行
zh.what: elizaOS 是一个开源的 TypeScript 框架和产品栈，用于构建和运行自主 AI 代理。它提供核心运行时、Eliza 应用、CLI、云服务和原生桥接，支持从聊天、语音到设备控制等多种能力。
zh.content: 该仓库是一个 monorepo，包含核心运行时、Eliza 应用、CLI、云服务、原生桥接和第一方插件。可引导的 Linux 和 Android 发行版在单独的 elizaOS/os 仓库中。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，依赖 Bun 和 Node.js，使用 Turbo 进行构建，支持子模块和补丁。
zh.hot: 本周新增 115 颗星，总星数达 19064，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（TypeScript）第 19 名。其“智能体操作系统”的定位和全栈能力吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者：使用 CLI 和文档构建自定义 AI 代理或插件
企业：通过 Eliza Cloud 部署和管理 AI 代理
个人用户：下载 Eliza 应用用于个人助理、自动化等场景
研究者：探索自主代理和操作系统级集成的可能性

en.tag: Open-source agentic operating system for autonomous AI agents
en.what: elizaOS is an open-source TypeScript framework and product stack for building and running autonomous AI agents. It provides a core runtime, the Eliza app, CLI, cloud services, and native bridges, enabling capabilities from chat and voice to device control.
en.content: This repository is a monorepo containing the core runtime, the Eliza app, the CLI, cloud services, native bridges, and first-party plugins. Bootable Linux and Android distributions live in a separate elizaOS/os repository.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Bun and Node.js dependencies, built using Turbo, supporting submodules and patches.
en.hot: Gained 115 stars this week, reaching 19,064 total, ranking #19 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) weekly. Its positioning as an 'agentic operating system' with full-stack capabilities attracts many developers.

Enterprises: deploy and manage AI agents via Eliza Cloud
Individuals: download the Eliza app for personal assistant, automation, etc.
Researchers: explore autonomous agents and OS-level integration

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理轻松调用上万网页抓取工具的 MCP 服务器
zh.what: Apify MCP 服务器是一个中间层，将 AI 代理（如 Claude、Cursor）与 Apify Store 上数千个现成的爬虫和自动化工具连接起来。它支持通过 OAuth 从 Claude.ai 或 VS Code 等客户端直接连接，并支持流式 HTTP 传输。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MCP 服务器的 TypeScript 源码、文档、配置示例，以及指向托管服务 mcp.apify.com 的说明。还支持代理支付（agentic payments）和多种客户端集成。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，使用 Model Context Protocol (MCP) SDK，支持 OAuth 和流式 HTTP。依赖 Apify 平台及其 Actor 生态系统。
zh.hot: 本月新增 3473 星，总星数达 6086，跻身 TypeScript 趋势榜第 16 名。AI 代理需要实时网页数据，而 Apify 提供了现成的抓取工具，正好满足需求。
uses: 开发者想要为 AI 代理添加网页数据抓取能力，无需自己编写爬虫。
使用 Claude、Cursor 等 MCP 客户端的用户，需要从社交媒体、电商等网站提取结构化数据。
需要自动化数据采集流程，并希望与 AI 工作流集成的团队。

en.tag: MCP server enabling AI agents to use thousands of web scrapers via Apify
en.what: The Apify MCP server is a middleware that connects AI agents (like Claude, Cursor) to thousands of ready-made scrapers and automation tools on Apify Store. It supports OAuth for connecting from clients like Claude.ai or VS Code, and uses Streamable HTTP transport.
en.content: The repo contains TypeScript source code, docs, config examples, and instructions for the hosted service at mcp.apify.com. It also supports agentic payments and integration with various MCP clients.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses the Model Context Protocol (MCP) SDK, supports OAuth and Streamable HTTP. Depends on the Apify platform and its Actor ecosystem.
en.hot: Gained 3473 stars this month, reaching 6086 total, ranking #16 on TypeScript trending. AI agents need real-time web data, and Apify offers ready-made scrapers, perfectly meeting the demand.
uses: Developers who want to add web scraping capabilities to AI agents without writing crawlers themselves.
Users of MCP clients like Claude or Cursor who need structured data from social media, e-commerce, etc.
Teams that need to automate data collection and integrate it with AI workflows.

zh.tag: 开源免费AI网关，单端点聚合264家模型提供商并智能压缩省token
zh.what: OmniRoute 是一个开源的免费 AI 网关，通过单一 API 端点聚合了 264+ 家模型提供商（含 90+ 免费 tier），让你能把 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等主流编程工具无缝接入免费的 Claude、GPT 或 Gemini。它内置 RTK+Caveman 双层压缩算法，可自动减少 15%–95% 的 token 消耗，并支持智能故障自动回退、MCP/A2A 协议以及多模态接口。
zh.content: 仓库包含可直接部署的网关核心、Web 管理后台（Dashboard）、PWA 与桌面端应用，以及详细的路由策略配置、免费额度文档和 Provider 接入模板。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 全栈构建，网关层采用 Node.js 高并发架构，前端提供 React 驱动的 Dashboard 与 PWA，并支持 Desktop 端封装。
zh.hot: 本周新增 3,605 Star、总星数突破 1.8 万并登上 GitHub 周榜第 16 名，反映出开发者对「零成本调用多模型」的强烈需求——聚合 90+ 免费提供商与高达 95% 的 token 压缩能力，直接切中了 AI 应用落地时的成本焦虑。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小型团队 —— 想用 Claude/GPT/Gemini 但预算有限，通过免费 tier 聚合实现零成本调用。
AI 编程工具重度用户 —— 将 Cursor、Cline、Claude Code 等 IDE 插件的底层模型切换到免费提供商。
网关/中间件自建者 —— 需要统一端点管理多模型路由、自动容灾和 token 压缩的企业内部 AI 基础设施。

en.tag: Open-source AI gateway aggregating 264 providers with token compression and auto-fallback
en.what: OmniRoute is an open-source free AI gateway that aggregates 264+ providers—including 90+ free tiers—behind a single API endpoint, letting you plug Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot and other tools into free Claude, GPT or Gemini instances. It features RTK+Caveman stacked compression to cut token usage by 15–95%, alongside smart auto-fallback, MCP/A2A support, and multimodal APIs.
en.content: The repo ships with a deployable gateway core, a web admin dashboard, PWA and desktop apps, plus routing strategy configs, free-tier documentation, and provider integration templates.
en.stack: Built entirely in TypeScript on a Node.js backend for high-concurrency gateway operations, with a React-based web dashboard and PWA, plus desktop packaging.
en.hot: It gained 3,605 stars this week, reaching 18.4k total and hitting #16 on GitHub Trending, as developers rush to cut AI costs—aggregating 90+ free providers and slashing token usage by up to 95% directly addresses the biggest barrier to shipping AI apps.
uses: Indie devs & small teams —— Access Claude/GPT/Gemini at zero cost by pooling 90+ free tiers instead of paid APIs.
Power users of AI coding tools —— Redirect Cursor, Cline, Claude Code and Copilot to free model backends via one endpoint.
Platform builders —— Those needing a unified gateway with auto-fallback, routing strategies, and token compression for internal AI infra.

zh.tag: 隐私优先的开源简历生成器
zh.what: Reactive Resume 是一款免费开源的简历生成器，简化了创建、更新和分享简历的流程。它提供多种模板，用户填写信息后即可导出为 PDF，无需注册账户即可使用基本功能。该应用以隐私为核心，用户完全拥有自己的数据，且支持自托管。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端应用（apps/web）、后端服务（apps/server）以及相关文档，采用 monorepo 结构。支持 Docker 部署，提供多语言界面，并集成了赞助商展示。

zh.hot: 该项目拥有超过 4 万星标，今日新增 255 星，位列 GitHub 趋势榜（TypeScript）第 5 名。其隐私保护、开源免费和自托管特性吸引了大量用户，且持续更新维护。
uses: 求职者：快速制作专业简历并导出 PDF，无需注册。
注重隐私的用户：希望完全掌控个人数据，可自托管部署。
开发者：可定制和扩展简历生成器，或贡献代码。

en.tag: Privacy-first open-source resume builder
en.what: Reactive Resume is a free and open-source resume builder that simplifies creating, updating, and sharing resumes. It offers templates, lets you fill in details and export to PDF, no account required for basic use. Built with privacy as a core principle, it gives users complete ownership of their data and can be self-hosted.
en.content: The repository contains a frontend app (apps/web), backend server (apps/server), and documentation, structured as a monorepo. It supports Docker deployment, offers multi-language UI, and includes sponsor showcases.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, frontend built with React (Next.js), backend with NestJS, databases support PostgreSQL and MongoDB, and Docker for containerized deployment.
en.hot: With over 40k stars and 255 new stars today, it ranks #5 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript). Its privacy-first, open-source, free, and self-hostable features attract many users, and it is actively maintained.
uses: Job seekers: quickly create professional resumes and export to PDF without registration.
Privacy-conscious users: want full control over personal data and can self-host.
Developers: can customize and extend the resume builder or contribute code.

zh.tag: 开源低代码平台，构建内部工具与AI代理
zh.what: ToolJet 是一个开源的低代码平台，用于快速构建内部工具、仪表盘、业务应用和工作流。它提供可视化拖拽界面，支持连接数据库、API 和 SaaS 应用，并集成了 AI 能力，可生成应用和智能代理。

zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，基于 React 和 Node.js 构建。支持 Docker、Kubernetes 等部署方式，并集成多种数据库和 API。
